arabic: اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ
transliteration: Allahumma qinee AAathabaka yawma tabAAathu AAibadak.
translation: O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the day Your servants are resurrected.
search: For protection and help from Allah For protection and help from Allah اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ Allahumma qinee AAathabaka yawma tabAAathu AAibadak. O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the day Your servants are resurrected. Abu Dawud: 5045

category: For protection and help from Allah
categoryEn: For protection and help from Allah
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشَرَكِهِ وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى نَفْسِي سُوءًا أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ
transliteration: Allaahumma faatiras-samaawaati wal’ardhi, Aalimal-ghaybi wash-shahaadati, laa ‘ilaaha ‘illaa ‘Anta, rabba kulli shai’in wa malīkahu, ‘a’oothu bika min sharri nafsee, wa min sharrish-shaytaani wa sharakihi, wa ‘an ‘aqtarifa ‘alaa nafsee soo’an, ‘aw ‘ajurrahu ‘ilaa Muslimin
translation: O Allah, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the seen, there is none worthy of worship except You, Lord of everything and its Owner, I seek refuge in You from the evil of my soul and from the evil of Shaitan and his Shirk, or that I should do some evil to myself or bring it upon a Muslim.
search: For protection and help from Allah For protection and help from Allah اللَّهُمَّ فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشَرَكِهِ وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى نَفْسِي سُوءًا أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ Allaahumma faatiras-samaawaati wal’ardhi, Aalimal-ghaybi wash-shahaadati, laa ‘ilaaha ‘illaa ‘Anta, rabba kulli shai’in wa malīkahu, ‘a’oothu bika min sharri nafsee, wa min sharrish-shaytaani wa sharakihi, wa ‘an ‘aqtarifa ‘alaa nafsee soo’an, ‘aw ‘ajurrahu ‘ilaa Muslimin O Allah, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the seen, there is none worthy of worship except You, Lord of everything and its Owner, I seek refuge in You from the evil of my soul and from the evil of Shaitan and his Shirk, or that I should do some evil to myself or bring it upon a Muslim. At-Tirmidhi: 3529

category: For protection and help from Allah
categoryEn: For protection and help from Allah
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَاىَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي وَاحْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَىَّ وَمِنْ خَلْفِي وَعَنْ يَمِينِي وَعَنْ شِمَالِي وَمِنْ فَوْقِي وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي
transliteration: Allahumma inni as’alukal-’afwa wal-’afiyah fid-dunya wal-akhirah. Allahumma inni as’alukal-’afwa wal-’afiyah fi dini wa dunyaya wa ahli wa mali. Allahum-mastur ‘awrati, wa amin raw’ati wahfazni min bayni yadayya, wa min khalfi, wa ‘an yamini wa ‘an shimali, wa min fawqi, wa ‘audhu bika an ughtala min tahti
translation: O Allah, I ask You for forgiveness and well-being in this world and in the Hereafter. O Allah, I ask You for forgiveness and well-being in my religious and my worldly affairs. O Allah, conceal my faults, calm my fears, and protect me from before me and behind me, from my right and my left, and from above me, and I seek refuge in You from being taken unaware from beneath me.
search: For protection and help from Allah For protection and help from Allah اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَاىَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي وَاحْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَىَّ وَمِنْ خَلْفِي وَعَنْ يَمِينِي وَعَنْ شِمَالِي وَمِنْ فَوْقِي وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي Allahumma inni as’alukal-’afwa wal-’afiyah fid-dunya wal-akhirah. Allahumma inni as’alukal-’afwa wal-’afiyah fi dini wa dunyaya wa ahli wa mali. Allahum-mastur ‘awrati, wa amin raw’ati wahfazni min bayni yadayya, wa min khalfi, wa ‘an yamini wa ‘an shimali, wa min fawqi, wa ‘audhu bika an ughtala min tahti O Allah, I ask You for forgiveness and well-being in this world and in the Hereafter. O Allah, I ask You for forgiveness and well-being in my religious and my worldly affairs. O Allah, conceal my faults, calm my fears, and protect me from before me and behind me, from my right and my left, and from above me, and I seek refuge in You from being taken unaware from beneath me. Ibn Majah: 3871

category: For protection and help from Allah
categoryEn: For protection and help from Allah
arabic: اَنَّ اللّٰہَ مَوۡلٰىکُمۡ ؕ نِعۡمَ الۡمَوۡلٰی وَ نِعۡمَ النَّصِیۡرُ
transliteration: Anna Allaha mawlakum ni’mal mawla wa ni’man naseer
translation: Know that Allah is your protector. Excellent is the protector, and Excellent is the helper.
search: For protection and help from Allah For protection and help from Allah اَنَّ اللّٰہَ مَوۡلٰىکُمۡ ؕ نِعۡمَ الۡمَوۡلٰی وَ نِعۡمَ النَّصِیۡرُ Anna Allaha mawlakum ni’mal mawla wa ni’man naseer Know that Allah is your protector. Excellent is the protector, and Excellent is the helper. Surah Al-Anfal - 8:40

arabic: رَّبِّ اَعُوۡذُ بِکَ مِنۡ ہَمَزٰتِ الشَّیٰطِیۡنِ وَ اَعُوۡذُ بِکَ رَبِّ اَنۡ یَّحۡضُرُوۡنِ
transliteration: Rabbi ‘a`outhubika min hamazaatish-shayaateeni, wa ‘a`outhu bika rabbi ‘ay-yahdhuroon
translation: My Lord! I seek refuge with You from the whisperings (suggestions) of the Shayatin (devils). And I seek refuge with You, My Lord! lest they may attend (or come near) me.
benefits: This dua was taught by Allah SWT to Prophet (SAW)
search: For protection from Satan/Shaytan For protection from Satan/Shaytan رَّبِّ اَعُوۡذُ بِکَ مِنۡ ہَمَزٰتِ الشَّیٰطِیۡنِ وَ اَعُوۡذُ بِکَ رَبِّ اَنۡ یَّحۡضُرُوۡنِ Rabbi ‘a`outhubika min hamazaatish-shayaateeni, wa ‘a`outhu bika rabbi ‘ay-yahdhuroon My Lord! I seek refuge with You from the whisperings (suggestions) of the Shayatin (devils). And I seek refuge with You, My Lord! lest they may attend (or come near) me. Surah Al-Mu'minoon - 23:97-98 This dua was taught by Allah SWT to Prophet (SAW)
benefitsAr: هذا الدعاء علمه الله سبحانه وتعالى للنبي صلى الله عليه وسلم

arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللّٰهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطانِ الرَّجِيْمِ
transliteration: A’oothu billaahi minash-Shaytaanir-rajeem
translation: I seek refuge with Allah against the Satan, the outcast.
search: For protection from Satan/Shaytan For protection from Satan/Shaytan أَعُوذُ بِاللّٰهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطانِ الرَّجِيْمِ A’oothu billaahi minash-Shaytaanir-rajeem I seek refuge with Allah against the Satan, the outcast. Sahih Al-Bukhari: 6115

category: For protection from the evil eye
categoryEn: For protection from the evil eye
arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللّٰهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
transliteration: A’oothu bikalimaatil-laahit-taammaati min sharri maa khalaqa
translation: I seek refuge in the Perfect Words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.
benefits: Prophet (S.A.W.) said "When anyone lands at a place, and says these words, nothing would harm him until he marches from that stopping place."
search: For protection from the evil eye For protection from the evil eye أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللّٰهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ A’oothu bikalimaatil-laahit-taammaati min sharri maa khalaqa I seek refuge in the Perfect Words of Allah from the evil of what He has created. Sahih Muslim: 2708 (a) Prophet (S.A.W.) said "When anyone lands at a place, and says these words, nothing would harm him until he marches from that stopping place."
benefitsAr: فقال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم: «من نزل منزلاً فقال هذه الكلمات لم يضره شيء حتى يخرج من موقفه هذا».

category: To keep your family safe from transgressors
categoryEn: To keep your family safe from transgressors
arabic: رَبِّ نَجِّنِیۡ وَ اَہۡلِیۡ مِمَّا یَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
transliteration: Rabbi najjinee waahlee mimma ya’maloon.
translation: My Lord! Save me and my family from what they do.
benefits: This dua was asked by Prophet Lut (AS).
search: To keep your family safe from transgressors To keep your family safe from transgressors رَبِّ نَجِّنِیۡ وَ اَہۡلِیۡ مِمَّا یَعۡمَلُوۡنَ Rabbi najjinee waahlee mimma ya’maloon. My Lord! Save me and my family from what they do. Surah Ash-Shu'araa - 26:169 This dua was asked by Prophet Lut (AS).
categoryAr: لتحافظ على سلامة عائلتك من المخالفين
benefitsAr: هذا الدعاء سأله النبي لوط (ع) .

arabic: أُعِيذُكُمَا بِكَلِمَاتِ اللّٰهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لاَمَّةٍ
transliteration: U’eethukumaa bikalimaatil-laahit-taammati min kulli shaytaanin wa haammatin, wa min kulli ‘aynin laammatin
translation: I seek protection for you in the Perfect Words of Allah from every devil and every beast, and from every envious blameworthy eye.
benefits: Seek protection by reciting this dua! Ibn'Abbas related that the Prophet Muhammad (SAW) used to seek Allah's protection for Al-Hassan and Al-Hussain by reciting this dua.
search: For your child's protection For your child's protection أُعِيذُكُمَا بِكَلِمَاتِ اللّٰهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لاَمَّةٍ U’eethukumaa bikalimaatil-laahit-taammati min kulli shaytaanin wa haammatin, wa min kulli ‘aynin laammatin I seek protection for you in the Perfect Words of Allah from every devil and every beast, and from every envious blameworthy eye. Abu Dawud: 4737 Seek protection by reciting this dua! Ibn'Abbas related that the Prophet Muhammad (SAW) used to seek Allah's protection for Al-Hassan and Al-Hussain by reciting this dua.
benefitsAr: اطلب الحماية من خلال قراءة هذا الدعاء! وعن ابن عباس أن النبي محمد (ص) كان يعوذ الحسن والحسين بهذا الدعاء.

arabic: رَبَّنَاۤ اَخۡرِجۡنَا مِنۡ ہٰذِہِ الۡقَرۡیَۃِ الظَّالِمِ اَہۡلُہَا وَ اجۡعَلۡ لَّنَا مِنۡ لَّدُنۡکَ وَلِیًّا وَّ اجۡعَلۡ لَّنَا مِنۡ لَّدُنۡکَ نَصِیۡرًا
transliteration: rabbana akhrijna min hathihialqaryati aththalimi ahluhawajAAal lana min ladunka waliyyan wajAAallana min ladunka naseera
translation: Our Lord! Rescue us from this town whose people are oppressors; and raise for us from You one who will protect, and raise for us from You one who will help.
benefits: This dua was asked by the early Muslims of the Makkah city when the Quruaish tribe oppressed them.
search: For protection from oppressors For protection from oppressors رَبَّنَاۤ اَخۡرِجۡنَا مِنۡ ہٰذِہِ الۡقَرۡیَۃِ الظَّالِمِ اَہۡلُہَا وَ اجۡعَلۡ لَّنَا مِنۡ لَّدُنۡکَ وَلِیًّا وَّ اجۡعَلۡ لَّنَا مِنۡ لَّدُنۡکَ نَصِیۡرًا rabbana akhrijna min hathihialqaryati aththalimi ahluhawajAAal lana min ladunka waliyyan wajAAallana min ladunka naseera Our Lord! Rescue us from this town whose people are oppressors; and raise for us from You one who will protect, and raise for us from You one who will help. Surah An-Nisa - 4:75 This dua was asked by the early Muslims of the Makkah city when the Quruaish tribe oppressed them.
benefitsAr: هذا الدعاء دعاه المسلمون الأوائل في مدينة مكة عندما ظلمتهم قبيلة قريش.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ عَضُدِي وَنَصِيرِي بِكَ أَحُولُ وَبِكَ أَصُولُ وَبِكَ أُقَاتِلُ
transliteration: Allaahumma ‘Anta ‘adhudee, wa ‘Anta naseeree, bika ‘ahoolu, wa bika ‘asoolu, wa bika ‘uqaatilu
translation: O Allah, You are my aid ane my support. By Your defend, by You I attack and by Your I fight.
search: For protection from oppressors For protection from oppressors اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ عَضُدِي وَنَصِيرِي بِكَ أَحُولُ وَبِكَ أَصُولُ وَبِكَ أُقَاتِلُ Allaahumma ‘Anta ‘adhudee, wa ‘Anta naseeree, bika ‘ahoolu, wa bika ‘asoolu, wa bika ‘uqaatilu O Allah, You are my aid ane my support. By Your defend, by You I attack and by Your I fight. Abu Dawud: 2632

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مُنْزِلَ الْكِتَابِ سَرِيعَ الْحِسَابِ اهْزِمِ الأَحْزَابَ اللَّهُمَّ اهْزِمْهُمْ وَزَلْزِلْهُمْ
transliteration: Allaahumma munzilal-kitaabi, saree’al-hisaabi-hzimil-’ahzaaba- Allaahumma-hzimhum wa zalzilhum
translation: Allah, Revealer of the Book, Swift to account, defeat the groups (of disbelievers). O Allah, defeat them and shake them.
search: Protect yourself from enemies Protect yourself from enemies اللَّهُمَّ مُنْزِلَ الْكِتَابِ سَرِيعَ الْحِسَابِ اهْزِمِ الأَحْزَابَ اللَّهُمَّ اهْزِمْهُمْ وَزَلْزِلْهُمْ Allaahumma munzilal-kitaabi, saree’al-hisaabi-hzimil-’ahzaaba- Allaahumma-hzimhum wa zalzilhum Allah, Revealer of the Book, Swift to account, defeat the groups (of disbelievers). O Allah, defeat them and shake them. Sahih Muslim: 1742 (b)

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِيهِمْ بِمَا شِئْتَ
transliteration: Allaahummak-fineehim bimaa shi’ta
translation: O Allah, suffice (i.e. protect) me against them however You wish.
search: For curbing fear For curbing fear اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِيهِمْ بِمَا شِئْتَ Allaahummak-fineehim bimaa shi’ta O Allah, suffice (i.e. protect) me against them however You wish. Sahih Muslim: 3005

arabic: لَّاۤ اِلٰہَ اِلَّاۤ اللّٰہُ
transliteration: Laa ‘ilaaha ‘illallaahu
translation: There is none worthy of worship but Allah.
search: For curbing fear For curbing fear لَّاۤ اِلٰہَ اِلَّاۤ اللّٰہُ Laa ‘ilaaha ‘illallaahu There is none worthy of worship but Allah. Sahih Al-Bukhari: 3346

arabic: عَلَی اللّٰہِ تَوَکَّلۡنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا لَا تَجۡعَلۡنَا فِتۡنَۃً  لِّلۡقَوۡمِ الظّٰلِمِیۡنَ وَ نَجِّنَا بِرَحۡمَتِکَ مِنَ الۡقَوۡمِ الۡکٰفِرِیۡنَ
transliteration: Alal Allahi thawakkalna rabbana la taj’alna fitnatal lil-qawmidh-Dhalimeen. Wa najjina bi-Rahmatika minal qawmil kafireen.
translation: Upon Allah do we rely. Our Lord, make us not [objects of] trial for the wrongdoing people. And save us by Your mercy from the disbelieving people.
search: Seek protection from wrongdoers Seek protection from wrongdoers عَلَی اللّٰہِ تَوَکَّلۡنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا لَا تَجۡعَلۡنَا فِتۡنَۃً  لِّلۡقَوۡمِ الظّٰلِمِیۡنَ وَ نَجِّنَا بِرَحۡمَتِکَ مِنَ الۡقَوۡمِ الۡکٰفِرِیۡنَ Alal Allahi thawakkalna rabbana la taj’alna fitnatal lil-qawmidh-Dhalimeen. Surah Yunus - 10:85-86

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أُشْرِكَ بِكَ وَأَنَا أَعْلَمُ،  وَأَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا لاَ أَعْلَمُ
transliteration: Allaahumma ‘innee ‘a’oothu bika ‘an ‘ushrika bika wa ‘anaa ‘a’lamu, wa ‘astaghfiruka limaa laa ‘a’lamu
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You lest I associate anything with You knowingly, and I seek Your forgiveness for what I know not.
search: For fear of committing Shirk For fear of committing Shirk اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أُشْرِكَ بِكَ وَأَنَا أَعْلَمُ،  وَأَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا لاَ أَعْلَمُ Allaahumma ‘innee ‘a’oothu bika ‘an ‘ushrika bika wa ‘anaa ‘a’lamu, wa ‘astaghfiruka limaa laa ‘a’lamu O Allah, I seek refuge in You lest I associate anything with You knowingly, and I seek Your forgiveness for what I know not. Al-Adab Al-Mufrad: 716

arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجۡعَلۡنَا مَعَ الۡقَوۡمِ الظّٰلِمِیۡنَ
transliteration: Rabbanaa Laa Taj-a’lnaa Ma – A’l Qawmiz’ Z’aalimeen
translation: Our Lord! Place us not with the people who are Zaalimoon (polytheists and wrong doers).
search: To be a pious Muslim To be a pious Muslim رَبَّنَا لَا تَجۡعَلۡنَا مَعَ الۡقَوۡمِ الظّٰلِمِیۡنَ Rabbanaa Laa Taj-a’lnaa Ma – A’l Qawmiz’ Z’aalimeen Our Lord! Place us not with the people who are Zaalimoon (polytheists and wrong doers). Surah Al-A'raf - 7:47

arabic: رَبِّ فَلَا تَجۡعَلۡنِیۡ فِی الۡقَوۡمِ الظّٰلِمِیۡنَ
transliteration: Rabbi fala tajAAalnee fee alqawmi aththalimeen
translation: My Lord, then do not place me among the wrongdoing people.
benefits: Allah taught this dua to Prophet (SAW).
search: To be a pious Muslim To be a pious Muslim رَبِّ فَلَا تَجۡعَلۡنِیۡ فِی الۡقَوۡمِ الظّٰلِمِیۡنَ Rabbi fala tajAAalnee fee alqawmi aththalimeen My Lord, then do not place me among the wrongdoing people. Surah Al-Mu'minoon - 23:94 Allah taught this dua to Prophet (SAW).
benefitsAr: وقد علم الله هذا الدعاء للنبي (ص).

arabic: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
transliteration: Bismil-lahil-lathee la yadurru maAAas-mihi shay-on fil-ardi wala fis-sama-i wahuwas-sameeAAul-AAaleem.
translation: In the name of Allah with whose name nothing is harmed on earth nor in the heavens and He is The All-Seeing, The All-Knowing.(three times)
benefits: Recite this dua three times

arabic: اَللّٰہُ لَاۤ اِلٰہَ اِلَّا ہُوَ اَلۡحَیُّ الۡقَیُّوۡمُ لَا تَاۡخُذُہٗ سِنَۃٌ وَّ لَا نَوۡمٌ  لَہٗ مَا فِی السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ مَا فِی الۡاَرۡضِ مَنۡ ذَا الَّذِیۡ یَشۡفَعُ عِنۡدَہٗۤ اِلَّا بِاِذۡنِہٖ  یَعۡلَمُ مَا بَیۡنَ اَیۡدِیۡہِمۡ وَ مَا خَلۡفَہُمۡ  وَ لَا یُحِیۡطُوۡنَ بِشَیۡءٍ مِّنۡ عِلۡمِہٖۤ اِلَّا بِمَا شَآءَ وَسِعَ کُرۡسِیُّہُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الۡاَرۡضَ  وَ لَا یَـُٔوۡدُہٗ حِفۡظُہُمَا  وَ ہُوَ الۡعَلِیُّ الۡعَظِیۡمُ
transliteration: Allaahu laa ‘ilaaha ‘illaa Huwal-Hayyul-Qayyoom, laa ta’khuthuhu sinatun wa laa nawm, lahu maa fis-samaawaati wa maafil-’ardh, man thal-lathee yashfa’u ‘indahu ‘illaa bi’ithnih, ya’lamu maa bayna ‘aydeehim wa maa khalfahum, wa laa yuheetoona bishay’im-min ‘ilmihi ‘illaa bimaa shaa’a, wasi’a kursiyyuhus-samaawaati wal’ardh, wa laa ya’ooduhu hifdhuhumaa, wa Huwal-’Aliyyul- ‘Adheem
translation: Allah! There is none worthy of worship but He, the Ever Living, the One Who sustains and protects all that exists. Neither slumber nor sleep overtakes Him. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is he that can intercede with Him except with His Permission? He knows what happens to them in this world, and what will happen to them in the Hereafter. And they will never compass anything of His Knowledge except that which He wills. His Throne extends over the heavens and the earth, and He feels no fatigue in guarding and preserving them. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.
benefits: The Prophet (SAW) said: 'When you are about to sleep, recite Ayatul Kursi till the end of the verse for there will remain over you a protection from Allah and no devil will draw near to you until morning'.

benefitsAr: قال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم: «إذا أردت النوم فاقرأ آية الكرسي إلى آخر الآية، فإنه لا يزال عليك ذمة من الله، ولا يقربنك شيطان حتى تصبح».

arabic:
[سُوۡرَةُ الإخلاص] 
 قُلۡ ہُوَ اللّٰہُ اَحَدٌ،  اَللّٰہُ الصَّمَدُ،  لَمۡ یَلِدۡ وَ لَمۡ یُوۡلَدۡوَ لَمۡ یَکُنۡ لَّہٗ  کُفُوًا اَحَدٌ 

[سُوۡرَةُ الفَلَق]
 قُلۡ اَعُوۡذُ بِرَبِّ الۡفَلَقِ،  مِنۡ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ،  وَ مِنۡ شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ اِذَا وَقَب،  وَ مِنۡ شَرِّ النَّفّٰثٰتِ فِی الۡعُقَدِ،  وَ مِنۡ شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ اِذَا حَسَدَ 

[سُوۡرَةُ  النَّاس]
 قُلۡ اَعُوۡذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ، مَلِکِ النَّاسِ، اِلٰہِ النَّاسِ، مِنۡ شَرِّ الۡوَسۡوَاسِ الۡخَنَّاسِ، الَّذِیۡ یُوَسۡوِسُ فِیۡ صُدُوۡرِ النَّاسِ، مِنَ الۡجِنَّۃِ وَ النَّاسِ
transliteration: [Surah Al-Ikhlas]Qul Huwa-llahu ‘Ahad, Allahus-Samad, Lam Yalid Wa Lam Yulad, Walam Yakul-La-Hu-Kufuwan ‘Ahad. [Surah Al-Falaq]Qul ‘A’udhu Bi-Rabbil-Falaq, Min Sharri Ma Khalaq, Wa Min Sharri Ghasiqin ‘Idha Waqab, Wa Min Sharri-Naffathati Fil-‘Uqadi, Wa Min Sharri Hasidin ‘Idha Hasad. [Surah An-Nas]Qul ‘A’udhu Bi-Rabbin-Nas, Malikin-Nas, Ilahin-Nas, Min-Sharril-Waswasil-Khan-Nas, Al-Ladhi Yuwas-wisu Fee Sudurin-Nas, Mina Al-Jinnati Wan-Nas.
translation: [Surah Al-Ikhlas] Say, He is Allah, [who is] One, Allah, the Eternal Refuge, He neither begets nor is born, Nor is there to Him any equivalent. [Surah Al-Falaq] Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak, From the evil of that which He created, And from the evil of darkness when it settles, And from the evil of the blowers in knots, And from the evil of an envier when he envies. [Surah An-Nas] Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, The Sovereign of mankind, The God of mankind, From the evil of the retreating whisperer, Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind, From among the jinn and mankind.

arabic: اَلۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰہِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا وَكَفَانَا وَآوَانَا فَكَمْ مِمَّنْ لاَ كَافِيَ لَهُ وَلاَ مُئْوِيَ
transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-lathee atAAamana wasaqana, wakafana, wa-awana, fakam mimman la kafiya lahu wala mu/wee.
translation: All praise is for Allah, Who fed us and gave us drink, and Who is sufficient for us and has sheltered us, for how many have none to suffice them or shelter them.

All praise is for Allah, Who fed us and gave us drink, and Who is sufficient for us and has sheltered us, for how many have none to suffice them or shelter them. Sahih Muslim: 2715

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الغَيْبِ والشَّهَادَةِ، فَاطِرَ السَّموَاتِ والأرْضِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ  شَیۡءٍ ومَلِيْكَهُ، أشْهَدُ أنْ لَا إلَهَ إلاَّ أنْتَ، أعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشِرْكِهِ
transliteration: Allahumma AAalimal-ghaybi washshahadah, fatiras-samawati wal-ard, rabba kulli shayin wamaleekah, ashhadu an la ilaha illa ant, aAAoothu bika min sharri nafsee wamin sharrish-shaytani washirkih
translation: O Allah Knower of the Unseen and the Seen, Originator of the heavens and the earth, Lord of everything and its Possessor, I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship except You, I seek refuge from You from the evil of my soul and from the evil of Shaitan and his Shirk.

At-Tirmidhi: 3392

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ نَفْسِي إِلَيْكَ، وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ، وَوَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِي إِلَيْكَ، وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ، رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً إِلَيْكَ، لاَ مَلْجَأَ وَلاَ مَنْجَا مِنْكَ إِلاَّ إِلَيْكَ، آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ، وَبِنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ
transliteration: Allahumma aslamtu nafsi ilaika wa fauwadtu `Amri ilaika, wa wajjahtu wajhi ilaika wa aljaatu zahri ilaika, reghbatan wa rahbatan ilaika. La maljaa wa la manja minka illa ilaika. Amantu bikitabikal-ladhi anzalta; wa nabiyyikalladhi arsalta
translation: O Allah! I have surrendered myself over to you and have turned my face towards You, and leave all my affairs to You and depend on You and put my trust in You expecting Your reward and fearing Your punishment. There is neither fleeing from You nor refuge but with You. I believe in the Book (Qur’an) which You have revealed and in Your Prophet (Muhammad) whom You have sent.

arabic: اَللّٰہُ لَاۤ اِلٰہَ اِلَّا ہُوَ اَلۡحَیُّ الۡقَیُّوۡمُ لَا تَاۡخُذُہٗ سِنَۃٌ وَّ لَا نَوۡمٌ  لَہٗ مَا فِی السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ مَا فِی الۡاَرۡضِ مَنۡ ذَا الَّذِیۡ یَشۡفَعُ عِنۡدَہٗۤ اِلَّا بِاِذۡنِہٖ  یَعۡلَمُ مَا بَیۡنَ اَیۡدِیۡہِمۡ وَ مَا خَلۡفَہُمۡ  وَ لَا یُحِیۡطُوۡنَ بِشَیۡءٍ مِّنۡ عِلۡمِہٖۤ اِلَّا بِمَا شَآءَ وَسِعَ کُرۡسِیُّہُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الۡاَرۡضَ  وَ لَا یَـُٔوۡدُہٗ حِفۡظُہُمَا  وَ ہُوَ الۡعَلِیُّ الۡعَظِیۡمُ
transliteration: Allaahu laa ‘ilaaha ‘illaa Huwal-Hayyul-Qayyoom, laa ta’khuthuhu sinatun wa laa nawm, lahu maa fis-samaawaati wa maafil-’ardh, man thal-lathee yashfa’u ‘indahu ‘illaa bi’ithnih, ya’lamu maa bayna ‘aydeehim wa maa khalfahum, wa laa yuheetoona bishay’im-min ‘ilmihi ‘illaa bimaa shaa’a, wasi’a kursiyyuhus-samaawaati wal’ardh, wa laa ya’ooduhu hifdhuhumaa, wa Huwal-’Aliyyul- ‘Adheem
translation: Allah! There is none worthy of worship but He, the Ever Living, the One Who sustains and protects all that exists. Neither slumber nor sleep overtakes Him. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is he that can intercede with Him except with His Permission? He knows what happens to them in this world, and what will happen to them in the Hereafter. And they will never compass anything of His Knowledge except that which He wills. His Throne extends over the heavens and the earth, and He feels no fatigue in guarding and preserving them. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.
benefits: The Prophet (SAW) said: 'When you are about to sleep, recite Ayatul Kursi till the end of the verse for there will remain over you a protection from Allah and no devil will draw near to you until morning'.

arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللّٰہِ  (33 times) الۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰہ  (33 times) اَللّٰہُ اَکۡبَر  (34 times)

translation: Glory be to Allah (33 times), Praise be to Allah (33 times), Allah is the greatest (34 times)
benefits: Prophet (S.A.W.) taught this Tasbih to his beloved daughter Fatima (R.A.) and advised her to recite it every day before sleeping.

arabic:
[سُوۡرَةُ الإخلاص] 
 قُلۡ ہُوَ اللّٰہُ اَحَدٌ،  اَللّٰہُ الصَّمَدُ،  لَمۡ یَلِدۡ وَ لَمۡ یُوۡلَدۡوَ لَمۡ یَکُنۡ لَّہٗ  کُفُوًا اَحَدٌ 

[سُوۡرَةُ الفَلَق]
 قُلۡ اَعُوۡذُ بِرَبِّ الۡفَلَقِ،  مِنۡ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ،  وَ مِنۡ شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ اِذَا وَقَب،  وَ مِنۡ شَرِّ النَّفّٰثٰتِ فِی الۡعُقَدِ،  وَ مِنۡ شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ اِذَا حَسَدَ 

[سُوۡرَةُ  النَّاس]
 قُلۡ اَعُوۡذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ، مَلِکِ النَّاسِ، اِلٰہِ النَّاسِ، مِنۡ شَرِّ الۡوَسۡوَاسِ الۡخَنَّاسِ، الَّذِیۡ یُوَسۡوِسُ فِیۡ صُدُوۡرِ النَّاسِ، مِنَ الۡجِنَّۃِ وَ النَّاسِ
transliteration: [Surah Al-Ikhlas]Qul Huwa-llahu ‘Ahad, Allahus-Samad, Lam Yalid Wa Lam Yulad, Walam Yakul-La-Hu-Kufuwan ‘Ahad. [Surah Al-Falaq]Qul ‘A’udhu Bi-Rabbil-Falaq, Min Sharri Ma Khalaq, Wa Min Sharri Ghasiqin ‘Idha Waqab, Wa Min Sharri-Naffathati Fil-‘Uqadi, Wa Min Sharri Hasidin ‘Idha Hasad. [Surah An-Nas]Qul ‘A’udhu Bi-Rabbin-Nas, Malikin-Nas, Ilahin-Nas, Min-Sharril-Waswasil-Khan-Nas, Al-Ladhi Yuwas-wisu Fee Sudurin-Nas, Mina Al-Jinnati Wan-Nas.
translation: [Surah Al-Ikhlas] Say, He is Allah, [who is] One, Allah, the Eternal Refuge, He neither begets nor is born, Nor is there to Him any equivalent. [Surah Al-Falaq] Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak, From the evil of that which He created, And from the evil of darkness when it settles, And from the evil of the blowers in knots, And from the evil of an envier when he envies. [Surah An-Nas] Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, The Sovereign of mankind, The God of mankind, From the evil of the retreating whisperer, Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind, From among the jinn and mankind.
benefits: Whenever the Prophet (S.A.W.) went to bed every night, he used to cup his hands together and blow over it after reciting these three Surahs and then rub his hands over whatever parts of his body he was able to rub, starting with his head, face and front of his body. He used to do that three times.

benefitsAr: وكان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم إذا أوى إلى فراشه كل ليلة جمع يديه ثم نفث عليهما بعد قراءة هذه السور الثلاث، ثم يفرك بيديه ما استطاع أن يفركه من جسده، يبدأ برأسه ووجهه وما أقبل من جسده. وكان يفعل ذلك ثلاث مرات.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْماً نَافِعاً،  وَرِزْقاً طَيِّباً،  وَعَمَلاً مُتَقَبَّلاً
transliteration: Allaahumma ‘innee ‘as’aluka ‘ilman naafi’an, wa rizqan tayyiban, wa ‘amalan mutaqabbalan
translation: O Allah, I ask You for knowledge that is of benefit, a good provision, and deeds that will be accepted.
benefits: Prophet (S.A.W.) used to recite this dua everday immediately after Fajr Prayer.

Ibn Majah: 925 Prophet (S.A.W.) used to recite this dua everday immediately after Fajr Prayer.
benefitsAr: وكان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يدعو بهذا الدعاء كل يوم بعد صلاة الفجر مباشرة.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
transliteration: Allaahumma ‘innee ‘as’alukal-jannata wa ‘a’oothu bika minan-naar
translation: O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and seek Your protection from the Fire.
search: Everyday Duas Everyday Duas اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ Allaahumma ‘innee ‘as’alukal-jannata wa ‘a’oothu bika minan-naar O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and seek Your protection from the Fire. Abu Dawud: 792
categoryAr: الدعاء بعد التشهد الأخير قبل السلام

arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللّٰهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللّٰهُ وَاللّٰهُ اَکۡبَرُ
transliteration: Subhaanallaahi, Walhamdu lillaahi, Wala Illaha Illallahu, Wallaahu ‘Akbar
translation: Glory is to Allah, praise is to Allah, there is no god but Allah and Allah is the Most Great.
benefits: This dua is very close to Prophet Muhammad (SAW). The Prophet (SAW) said: 'Saying this dua is more beloved to me than everything the sun has risen over (i.e the whole world).'

benefitsAr: هذا الدعاء قريب جدًا من النبي محمد (ص). قال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم: "هذا الدعاء أحب إلي من كل شيء طلعت عليه الشمس".

arabic: لَّاۤ اِلٰہَ  اِلَّاۤ اَنۡتَ سُبۡحٰنَکَ  اِنِّیۡ کُنۡتُ مِنَ الظّٰلِمِیۡنَ
transliteration: Laa ‘ilaaha ‘illaa ‘Anta subhaanaka ‘innee kuntu minadh-dhaalimeen
translation: There is none worthy of worship but You, glory is to You. Surely, I was among the wrongdoers.
benefits: Prophet Yunus supplicate this Dua to Allah when he was in the belly of the whale.

benefitsAr: النبي يونس دعا الله بهذا الدعاء وهو في بطن الحوت.

arabic: بِسۡمِ اللّٰہِ  الرَّحۡمٰنِ الرَّحِیۡمِ
transliteration: Bismi-llahi r-raḥmani r-raḥim
translation: In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.

arabic: رَبَّنَاۤ اٰتِنَا فِی الدُّنۡیَا حَسَنَۃً وَّ فِی الۡاٰخِرَۃِ حَسَنَۃً وَّ قِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
transliteration: Rabbanaaa Aatinaa Fiddunyaa H’asanah Wa Fil Aakhirati H’asanah Wa Qinaa A’d’aaban Naar
translation: Our Lord! Give us in this world that which is good and in the Hereafter that which is good, and save us from the torment of the Fire!
benefits: This is the Prophet's (SAW) most read supplication to Allah. It is a comprehensive dua which contains everything we need for this world and the hereafter. We can recite this dua at all times.

benefitsAr: هذا هو أكثر دعاء النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قراءة إلى الله. وهو دعاء شامل فيه كل ما نحتاجه في الدنيا والآخرة. يمكننا أن نقرأ هذا الدعاء في كل الأوقات.

arabic: رَبَّنَاۤ اِنَّکَ جَامِعُ النَّاسِ لِیَوۡمٍ لَّا رَیۡبَ فِیۡہِ ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰہَ لَا یُخۡلِفُ الۡمِیۡعَادَ
transliteration: Rabbana innaka jami’unnasi li-Yawmil la rayba fi innAllaha la yukhliful mi’aad
translation: Our Lord, surely You will gather the people for a Day about which there is no doubt. Indeed, Allah does not fail in His promise.
search: For success in this world and aakhira For success in this world and aakhira رَبَّنَاۤ اِنَّکَ جَامِعُ النَّاسِ لِیَوۡمٍ لَّا رَیۡبَ فِیۡہِ ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰہَ لَا یُخۡلِفُ الۡمِیۡعَادَ Rabbana innaka jami’unnasi li-Yawmil la rayba fi innAllaha la yukhliful mi’aad Our Lord, surely You will gather the people for a Day about which there is no doubt. Indeed, Allah does not fail in His promise. Surah Al-Imran - 3:9

arabic: قُلۡ ہُوَ اللّٰہُ اَحَدٌ،  اَللّٰہُ الصَّمَدُ،  لَمۡ یَلِدۡ وَ لَمۡ یُوۡلَدۡوَ لَمۡ یَکُنۡ لَّہٗ  کُفُوًا اَحَدٌ
transliteration: [Surah Al-Ikhlas]Qul Huwa-llahu ‘Ahad, Allahus-Samad, Lam Yalid Wa Lam Yulad, Walam Yakul-La-Hu-Kufuwan ‘Ahad.
translation: [Surah Al-Ikhlas]Say, "He is Allah, [who is] One, Allah, the Eternal Refuge, He neither begets nor is born, Nor is there to Him any equivalent."
benefits: Prophet (S.A.W.) said that reciting Surah Al-Ikhlas (Surah No. 112) one time is equal to one third of the Quran.
search: Reward of One-Third of Quran Reward of One-Third of Quran قُلۡ ہُوَ اللّٰہُ اَحَدٌ،  اَللّٰہُ الصَّمَدُ،  لَمۡ یَلِدۡ وَ لَمۡ یُوۡلَدۡوَ لَمۡ یَکُنۡ لَّہٗ  کُفُوًا اَحَدٌ [Surah Al-Ikhlas]Qul Huwa-llahu ‘Ahad, Allahus-Samad, Lam Yalid Wa Lam Yulad, Walam Yakul-La-Hu-Kufuwan ‘Ahad. [Surah Al-Ikhlas]Say, "He is Allah, [who is] One, Allah, the Eternal Refuge, He neither begets nor is born, Nor is there to Him any equivalent." Sahih Al-Bukhari: 5015 Prophet (S.A.W.) said that reciting Surah Al-Ikhlas (Surah No. 112) one time is equal to one third of the Quran.
benefitsAr: قال النبي (ص) إن قراءة سورة الإخلاص (سورة رقم 112) مرة واحدة تعدل ثلث القرآن.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْماً نَافِعاً،  وَرِزْقاً طَيِّباً،  وَعَمَلاً مُتَقَبَّلاً
transliteration: Allaahumma ‘innee ‘as’aluka ‘ilman naafi’an, wa rizqan tayyiban, wa ‘amalan mutaqabbalan
translation: O Allah, I ask You for knowledge that is of benefit, a good provision, and deeds that will be accepted.
search: For Rizq (sustenance) For Rizq (sustenance) اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْماً نَافِعاً،  وَرِزْقاً طَيِّباً،  وَعَمَلاً مُتَقَبَّلاً Allaahumma ‘innee ‘as’aluka ‘ilman naafi’an, wa rizqan tayyiban, wa ‘amalan mutaqabbalan O Allah, I ask You for knowledge that is of benefit, a good provision, and deeds that will be accepted. Ibn Majah: 925

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَارْحَمْنِي وَعَافِنِي وَاهْدِنِي وَارْزُقْنِي
transliteration: Allaahum-maghfir lee, warhamnee, wa ‘aafinee, wahdinee, warzuqnee
translation: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, guide me, heal me, and provide for me.
search: For Rizq (sustenance) For Rizq (sustenance) اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَارْحَمْنِي وَعَافِنِي وَاهْدِنِي وَارْزُقْنِي Allaahum-maghfir lee, warhamnee, wa ‘aafinee, wahdinee, warzuqnee O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, guide me, heal me, and provide for me. Abu Dawud: 850

arabic: اَللّٰہُ لَطِیۡفٌۢ بِعِبَادِہٖ یَرۡزُقُ مَنۡ یَّشَآءُ وَ ہُوَ الۡقَوِیُّ الۡعَزِیۡزُ
transliteration: Allahu lateefun biAAibadihiyarzuqu man yashao wahuwa alqawiyyu alAAazeez
translation: Allah is very Gracious and Kind to His slaves. He gives provisions to whom He wills. And He is the All-Strong, the All-Mighty.
search: For Rizq (sustenance) For Rizq (sustenance) اَللّٰہُ لَطِیۡفٌۢ بِعِبَادِہٖ یَرۡزُقُ مَنۡ یَّشَآءُ وَ ہُوَ الۡقَوِیُّ الۡعَزِیۡزُ Allahu lateefun biAAibadihiyarzuqu man yashao wahuwa alqawiyyu alAAazeez Allah is very Gracious and Kind to His slaves. He gives provisions to whom He wills. And He is the All-Strong, the All-Mighty. Surah Ash-Shuraa - 42:19

arabic: رَبَّنَاۤ اَنۡزِلۡ عَلَیۡنَا مَآئِدَۃً مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ تَکُوۡنُ لَنَا عِیۡدًا لِّاَوَّلِنَا وَ اٰخِرِنَا وَ اٰیَۃً مِّنۡکَ ۚ وَ ارۡزُقۡنَا وَ اَنۡتَ خَیۡرُ الرّٰزِقِیۡنَ
transliteration: Rabbana anzil 'alayna ma'idatam minas-Samai takoonu lana 'idal li-awwa-lina wa aakhirina wa ayatam-minka war-zuqna wa anta Khayrul-Raziqeen
translation: O Allah our Lord! Send us from heaven a table set (with viands), that there may be for us - for the first and the last of us - a solemn festival and a sign from thee; and provide for our sustenance, for thou art the best Sustainer (of our needs).
search: For Rizq (sustenance) For Rizq (sustenance) رَبَّنَاۤ اَنۡزِلۡ عَلَیۡنَا مَآئِدَۃً مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ تَکُوۡنُ لَنَا عِیۡدًا لِّاَوَّلِنَا وَ اٰخِرِنَا وَ اٰیَۃً مِّنۡکَ ۚ وَ ارۡزُقۡنَا وَ اَنۡتَ خَیۡرُ الرّٰزِقِیۡنَ Rabbana anzil 'alayna ma'idatam minas-Samai takoonu lana 'idal li-awwa-lina wa aakhirina wa ayatam-minka war-zuqna wa anta Khayrul-Raziqeen O Allah our Lord! Send us from heaven a table set (with viands), that there may be for us - for the first and the last of us - a solemn festival and a sign from thee; and provide for our sustenance, for thou art the best Sustainer (of our needs). Surah Al-Ma'ida - 5:114

arabic: رَبِّ اِنِّیۡ لِمَاۤ اَنۡزَلۡتَ اِلَیَّ مِنۡ خَیۡرٍ فَقِیۡرٌ
transliteration: Rabbi innee lima anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqeer
translation: My Lord! Truly, I am in need of whatever good that You bestow on me!
search: When you are in need When you are in need رَبِّ اِنِّیۡ لِمَاۤ اَنۡزَلۡتَ اِلَیَّ مِنۡ خَیۡرٍ فَقِیۡرٌ Rabbi innee lima anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqeer My Lord! Truly, I am in need of whatever good that You bestow on me! Surah Al-Qasas - 28:24

arabic: اللّٰہُمَّ مٰلِکَ الۡمُلۡکِ تُؤۡتِی الۡمُلۡکَ مَنۡ تَشَآءُ وَ تَنۡزِعُ الۡمُلۡکَ مِمَّنۡ تَشَآءُ ۫ وَ تُعِزُّ مَنۡ تَشَآءُ وَ تُذِلُّ مَنۡ تَشَآءُ ؕ بِیَدِکَ الۡخَیۡرُ ؕ اِنَّکَ عَلٰی کُلِّ شَیۡءٍ قَدِیۡرٌ، تُوۡلِجُ الَّیۡلَ فِی النَّہَارِ وَ تُوۡلِجُ النَّہَارَ فِی الَّیۡلِ ۫ وَ تُخۡرِجُ الۡحَیَّ مِنَ الۡمَیِّتِ وَ تُخۡرِجُ الۡمَیِّتَ مِنَ الۡحَیِّ ۫ وَ تَرۡزُقُ مَنۡ تَشَآءُ بِغَیۡرِ حِسَابٍ
transliteration: allahumma malika almulkitu/tee almulka man tashao watanziAAu almulka mimman tashaowatuAAizzu man tashao watuthillu man tashaobiyadika alkhayru innaka AAala kulli shay-in qadeer. Tooliju allayla fee annahariwatooliju annahara fee allayli watukhriju alhayyamina almayyiti watukhriju almayyita mina alhayyi watarzuquman tashao bighayri hisab.
translation: O Allah! Possessor of the kingdom, You give the kingdom to whom You will, and You take the kingdom from whom You will, and You endue with honour whom You will, and You humiliate whom You will. In Your Hand is the good. Verily, You are Able to do all things. You make the night to enter into the day, and You make the day to enter into the night (i.e. increase and decrease in the hours of the night and the day during winter and summer), You bring the living out of the dead, and You bring the dead out of the living. And You give wealth and sustenance to whom You will, without limit (measure or account).
search: For praising Allah For praising Allah اللّٰہُمَّ مٰلِکَ الۡمُلۡکِ تُؤۡتِی الۡمُلۡکَ مَنۡ تَشَآءُ وَ تَنۡزِعُ الۡمُلۡکَ مِمَّنۡ تَشَآءُ ۫ وَ تُعِزُّ مَنۡ تَشَآءُ وَ تُذِلُّ مَنۡ تَشَآءُ ؕ بِیَدِکَ الۡخَیۡرُ ؕ اِنَّکَ عَلٰی کُلِّ شَیۡءٍ قَدِیۡرٌ، تُوۡلِجُ الَّیۡلَ فِی النَّہَارِ وَ تُوۡلِجُ النَّہَارَ فِی الَّیۡلِ ۫ وَ تُخۡرِجُ الۡحَیَّ مِنَ الۡمَیِّتِ وَ تُخۡرِجُ الۡمَیِّتَ مِنَ الۡحَیِّ ۫ وَ تَرۡزُقُ مَنۡ تَشَآءُ بِغَیۡرِ حِسَابٍ allahumma malika almulkitu/tee almulka man tashao watanziAAu almulka mimman tashaowatuAAizzu man tashao watuthillu man tashaobiyadika alkhayru innaka AAala kulli shay-in qadeer. Tooliju allayla fee annahariwatooliju annahara fee allayli watukhriju alhayyamina almayyiti watukhriju almayyita mina alhayyi watarzuquman tashao bighayri hisab. O Allah! Possessor of the kingdom, You give the kingdom to whom You will, and You take the kingdom from whom You will, and You endue with honour whom You will, and You humiliate whom You will. In Your Hand is the good. Verily, You are Able to do all things. You make the night to enter into the day, and You make the day to enter into the night (i.e. increase and decrease in the hours of the night and the day during winter and summer), You bring the living out of the dead, and You bring the dead out of the living. And You give wealth and sustenance to whom You will, without limit (measure or account). Surah Al-Imran - 3:26-27

arabic: وَ مَا تَوۡفِیۡقِیۡۤ اِلَّا بِاللّٰہِ ؕعَلَیۡہِ تَوَکَّلۡتُ وَ اِلَیۡہِ اُنِیۡبُ
transliteration: Wama tawfeeqee illa billahiAAalayhi tawakkaltu wa-ilayhi oneeb
translation: My success is not but through Allah. Upon him I have relied, and to Him I return.
benefits: Prophet Shuaib (AS) recited this dua.
search: For success For success وَ مَا تَوۡفِیۡقِیۡۤ اِلَّا بِاللّٰہِ ؕعَلَیۡہِ تَوَکَّلۡتُ وَ اِلَیۡہِ اُنِیۡبُ Wama tawfeeqee illa billahiAAalayhi tawakkaltu wa-ilayhi oneeb My success is not but through Allah. Upon him I have relied, and to Him I return. Surah Hud - 11:88 Prophet Shuaib (AS) recited this dua.
benefitsAr: قرأ النبي شعيب (ع) هذا الدعاء.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ وَالْفَقْرِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
transliteration: Allahumma AAafinee fee badanee, allahumma AAafinee fee samAAee, allahumma AAafinee fee basaree, la ilaha illa anta. Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika minal-kufri, walfaqri, Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika min AAathabil-qabri, la ilaha illa anta.
translation: O Allah, grant my body health, O Allah, grant my hearing health, O Allah, grant my sight health. None has the right to be worshipped except You. O Allah, I take refuge with You from disbelief and poverty, and I take refuge with You from the punishment of the grave. None has the right to be worshipped except You.
benefits: Recite this dua three times
search: For a healthy life For a healthy life اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ وَالْفَقْرِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ Allahumma AAafinee fee badanee, allahumma AAafinee fee samAAee, allahumma AAafinee fee basaree, la ilaha illa anta. Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika minal-kufri, walfaqri, Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika min AAathabil-qabri, la ilaha illa anta. O Allah, grant my body health, O Allah, grant my hearing health, O Allah, grant my sight health. None has the right to be worshipped except You. O Allah, I take refuge with You from disbelief and poverty, and I take refuge with You from the punishment of the grave. None has the right to be worshipped except You. Abu Dawud: 5090 Recite this dua three times
benefitsAr: اقرأ هذا الدعاء ثلاث مرات

arabic: لَا بَأْسَ طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللّٰهُ
transliteration: Laa ba’sa tahoorun ‘inshaa’Allaah.
translation: Do not worry, it will be a purification (for you), Allah willing.
benefits: Prophet (S.A.W.) used to say this Dua whenever He (S.A.W.) visited a an ailing person.
search: When Visiting the Sick When Visiting the Sick لَا بَأْسَ طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللّٰهُ Laa ba’sa tahoorun ‘inshaa’Allaah. Do not worry, it will be a purification (for you), Allah willing. Sahih Al-Bukhari: 3616 Prophet (S.A.W.) used to say this Dua whenever He (S.A.W.) visited a an ailing person.
benefitsAr: وكان النبي (ص) يقول هذا الدعاء كلما عاد (ص) مريضا.

arabic: أَسْأَلُ اللّٰهَ الْعَظِيمَ رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ أَنْ يَشْفِيَكَ
transliteration: As’alullaahal-’Adheema Rabbal-’Arshil-’Adheemi ‘an yashfiyaka.
translation: I ask Allah who is the Lofty and the Lord of the Mighty Throne that He cures you (Prophet Mohammad (SAW.) said that by reciting this dua seven times, the ill person will regain his health and if death occurs then that (death) is a different issue (i.e. death is written it cannot be prevented))
benefits: Recite seven times.
search: When Visiting the Sick When Visiting the Sick أَسْأَلُ اللّٰهَ الْعَظِيمَ رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ أَنْ يَشْفِيَكَ As’alullaahal-’Adheema Rabbal-’Arshil-’Adheemi ‘an yashfiyaka. I ask Allah who is the Lofty and the Lord of the Mighty Throne that He cures you (Prophet Mohammad (SAW.) said that by reciting this dua seven times, the ill person will regain his health and if death occurs then that (death) is a different issue (i.e. death is written it cannot be prevented)) At-Tirmidhi: 2083 Recite seven times.
benefitsAr: يقرأ سبع مرات.

arabic: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ، أَعُوذُ بِعِزَّةِ اللّٰهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأُحَاذِرُ. (سَبْعَ مَرَّاتٍ)
transliteration: Bismillah, A’udhu bi’izzatil-lahi wa qudratihi min sharri ma ajidu wa uhadhiru.
translation: In the Name of Allah, I seek refuge in the might and power of Allah from the evil of what I feel and what I fear.
benefits: Get relief from pain by placing your hand on the problem area and reciting the dua (seven times).
search: To alleviate pain To alleviate pain بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ، أَعُوذُ بِعِزَّةِ اللّٰهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأُحَاذِرُ. (سَبْعَ مَرَّاتٍ) Bismillah, A’udhu bi’izzatil-lahi wa qudratihi min sharri ma ajidu wa uhadhiru. In the Name of Allah, I seek refuge in the might and power of Allah from the evil of what I feel and what I fear. Ibn Majah: 3522 Get relief from pain by placing your hand on the problem area and reciting the dua (seven times).
benefitsAr: تخلص من الألم بوضع يدك على مكان المشكلة وقراءة الدعاء (سبع مرات).

category: Upon seeing someone going through a trial or tribulation
categoryEn: Upon seeing someone going through a trial or tribulation
arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي مِمَّا ابْتَلاَكَ بِهِ وَفَضَّلَنِي عَلَى كَثِيرٍ مِمَّنْ خَلَقَ تَفْضِيلاً
transliteration: Alhamdu lillaahil-lathee ‘aafaanee mimmab-talaaka bihi wa fadhdhalanee ‘alaa katheerin mimman khalaqa tafdheela
translation: Praise is to Allah Who has spared me what He has afflicted you with, and preferred me greatly above much of what He has created.
search: Upon seeing someone going through a trial or tribulation Upon seeing someone going through a trial or tribulation الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي مِمَّا ابْتَلاَكَ بِهِ وَفَضَّلَنِي عَلَى كَثِيرٍ مِمَّنْ خَلَقَ تَفْضِيلاً Alhamdu lillaahil-lathee ‘aafaanee mimmab-talaaka bihi wa fadhdhalanee ‘alaa katheerin mimman khalaqa tafdheela Praise is to Allah Who has spared me what He has afflicted you with, and preferred me greatly above much of what He has created. Ibn Majah: 3892
categoryAr: عند رؤية شخص يمر بتجربة أو محنة

category: If you fall on hard times
categoryEn: If you fall on hard times
arabic: اَنِّیۡ مَسَّنِیَ الضُّرُّ وَ اَنۡتَ اَرۡحَمُ الرّٰحِمِیۡنَ
transliteration: Annee massaniya addurru waanta arhamuarrahimeen
translation: Indeed, adversity has touched me, and you are the Most Merciful of the merciful.
benefits: Read this dua in times of sickness! Prophet Ayyob (AS) recited this dua when he was suffering from a terrible disease that spread all over his body.
search: If you fall on hard times If you fall on hard times اَنِّیۡ مَسَّنِیَ الضُّرُّ وَ اَنۡتَ اَرۡحَمُ الرّٰحِمِیۡنَ Annee massaniya addurru waanta arhamuarrahimeen Indeed, adversity has touched me, and you are the Most Merciful of the merciful. Surah Al-Anbiya - 21:83 Read this dua in times of sickness! Prophet Ayyob (AS) recited this dua when he was suffering from a terrible disease that spread all over his body.
benefitsAr: إقرأ هذا الدعاء في وقت المرض! قرأ النبي أيوب (ع) هذا الدعاء عندما كان يعاني من مرض رهيب انتشر في جميع أنحاء جسده.

category: When you are nearing your death

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَارْحَمْنِي وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالرَّفِيقِ الأَعْلَى

arabic: لَا اِلٰہَ اِلَّا اللّٰہُ وَاللّٰهُ اَکۡبَرُ، لَا اِلٰہَ اِلَّا اللّٰہُ وَحْدَهُ، لَا اِلٰہَ اِلَّا اللّٰہُ لَا شَرِيۡکَ لَهُ، لَا اِلٰہَ اِلَّا اللّٰہُ لَهُ الْمُلْکُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، لَا اِلٰہَ اِلَّا اللّٰہُ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ اِلَّا بِاللّٰہِِ
transliteration: Laa ‘ilaaha ‘illallaahu wallaahu ‘Akbar, laa ‘ilaaha ‘illallaahu wahdahu, laa ‘ilaaha ‘illallaahu laa shareeka lahu, laa ‘ilaaha ‘illallaahu lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu, laa ‘ilaaha ‘illallaahu wa laa hawla wa laa quwwata ‘illaa billaah
translation: There is none worthy of worship but Allah, Allah is the Most Great. None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone. None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, Who has no partner. There is none worthy of worship but Allah, His is the dominion and His is the praise. There is none worthy of worship but Allah, there is no power and no might but by Allah.
search: When you are nearing your death When you are nearing your death لَا اِلٰہَ اِلَّا اللّٰہُ وَاللّٰهُ اَکۡبَرُ، لَا اِلٰہَ اِلَّا اللّٰہُ وَحْدَهُ، لَا اِلٰہَ اِلَّا اللّٰہُ لَا شَرِيۡکَ لَهُ، لَا اِلٰہَ اِلَّا اللّٰہُ لَهُ الْمُلْکُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، لَا اِلٰہَ اِلَّا اللّٰہُ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ اِلَّا بِاللّٰہِِ Laa ‘ilaaha ‘illallaahu wallaahu ‘Akbar, laa ‘ilaaha ‘illallaahu wahdahu, laa ‘ilaaha ‘illallaahu laa shareeka lahu, laa ‘ilaaha ‘illallaahu lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu, laa ‘ilaaha ‘illallaahu wa laa hawla wa laa quwwata ‘illaa billaah There is none worthy of worship but Allah, Allah is the Most Great. None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone. None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, Who has no partner. There is none worthy of worship but Allah, His is the dominion and His is the praise. There is none worthy of worship but Allah, there is no power and no might but by Allah. Ibn Majah: 3794

arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الدِّيَارِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللّٰهُ بِكُمْ لاَحِقُونَ نَسْأَلُ اللّٰهَ لَنَا وَلَكُمُ الْعَافِيَةَ
transliteration: Assalaamu ‘alaykum ‘ahlad-diyaari, minal-mu’mineena walmuslimeena, wa ‘innaa ‘in shaa’ Allaahu bikum laahiqoona [wa yarhamullaahul-mustaqdimeena minnaa walmusta’khireena] ‘as’alullaaha lanaa wa lakumul- ‘aafiyata.
translation: Oh Muslims residing here, salaams on you, by the will of Allah we will also be coming to you. We seek safety for us and you.
search: When visiting graves When visiting graves السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الدِّيَارِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللّٰهُ بِكُمْ لاَحِقُونَ نَسْأَلُ اللّٰهَ لَنَا وَلَكُمُ الْعَافِيَةَ Assalaamu ‘alaykum ‘ahlad-diyaari, minal-mu’mineena walmuslimeena, wa ‘innaa ‘in shaa’ Allaahu bikum laahiqoona [wa yarhamullaahul-mustaqdimeena minnaa walmusta’khireena] ‘as’alullaaha lanaa wa lakumul- ‘aafiyata. Oh Muslims residing here, salaams on you, by the will of Allah we will also be coming to you. We seek safety for us and you. Ibn Majah: 1547

arabic: [سُوۡرَةُ الفَلَق]  قُلۡ اَعُوۡذُ بِرَبِّ الۡفَلَقِ،  مِنۡ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ،  وَ مِنۡ شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ اِذَا وَقَب،  وَ مِنۡ شَرِّ النَّفّٰثٰتِ فِی الۡعُقَدِ،  وَ مِنۡ شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ اِذَا حَسَدَ [سُوۡرَةُ  النَّاس]  ۡقُلۡ اَعُوۡذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ، مَلِکِ النَّاسِ، اِلٰہِ النَّاسِ، مِنۡ شَرِّ الۡوَسۡوَاسِ الۡخَنَّاسِ، الَّذِیۡ یُوَسۡوِسُ فِیۡ صُدُوۡرِ النَّاسِ، مِنَ الۡجِنَّۃِ وَ النَّاسِ
transliteration: [Surah Al-Falaq]Qul ‘A’udhu Bi-Rabbil-Falaq, Min Sharri Ma Khalaq, Wa Min Sharri Ghasiqin ‘Idha Waqab, Wa Min Sharri-Naffathati Fil-‘Uqadi, Wa Min Sharri Hasidin ‘Idha Hasad. [Surah An-Nas]Qul ‘A’udhu Bi-Rabbin-Nas, Malikin-Nas, Ilahin-Nas, Min-Sharril-Waswasil-Khan-Nas, Al-Ladhi Yuwas-wisu Fee Sudurin-Nas, Mina Al-Jinnati Wan-Nas.
translation: [Surah Al-Falaq]Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak, From the evil of that which He created, And from the evil of darkness when it settles, And from the evil of the blowers in knots, And from the evil of an envier when he envies." [Surah An-Nas]Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, The Sovereign of mankind, The God of mankind, From the evil of the retreating whisperer, Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind, From among the jinn and mankind."
benefits: Whenever Prophet (S.A.W.) became sick, he would recite these two surahs and then blow his breath over his body.

[Surah An-Nas]Qul ‘A’udhu Bi-Rabbin-Nas, Malikin-Nas, Ilahin-Nas, Min-Sharril-Waswasil-Khan-Nas, Al-Ladhi Yuwas-wisu Fee Sudurin-Nas, Mina Al-Jinnati Wan-Nas. [Surah Al-Falaq]Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak, From the evil of that which He created, And from the evil of darkness when it settles, And from the evil of the blowers in knots, And from the evil of an envier when he envies." [Surah An-Nas]Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, The Sovereign of mankind, The God of mankind, From the evil of the retreating whisperer, Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind, From among the jinn and mankind." Sahih Al-Bukhari: 5016 Whenever Prophet (S.A.W.) became sick, he would recite these two surahs and then blow his breath over his body.
benefitsAr: وكان النبي (ص) إذا مرض قرأ هاتين السورتين ثم نفث على جسده.

arabic: رَبَّنَا اغۡفِرۡ لِیۡ وَ لِوَالِدَیَّ وَ لِلۡمُؤۡمِنِیۡنَ یَوۡمَ یَقُوۡمُ الۡحِسَابُ
transliteration: Rabbanaghfir Lee Wa Liwaalidayya Wa Lil-Mu’mineena Yawma Yaqoomul H’isaab
translation: Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers the Day the account is established.
search: For forgiveness for your parents and all Muslims For forgiveness for your parents and all Muslims رَبَّنَا اغۡفِرۡ لِیۡ وَ لِوَالِدَیَّ وَ لِلۡمُؤۡمِنِیۡنَ یَوۡمَ یَقُوۡمُ الۡحِسَابُ Rabbanaghfir Lee Wa Liwaalidayya Wa Lil-Mu’mineena Yawma Yaqoomul H’isaab Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers the Day the account is established. Surah Ibraheem - 14:41

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّیۡ ظَلَمۡتُ نَفۡسِیۡ فَاغۡفِرۡ لِیۡ فَغَفَرَ لَہٗ ؕ اِنَّہٗ ہُوَ الۡغَفُوۡرُ الرَّحِیۡمُ، قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَاۤ اَنۡعَمۡتَ عَلَیَّ فَلَنۡ اَکُوۡنَ ظَہِیۡرًا لِّلۡمُجۡرِمِیۡنَ، رَبِّ نَجِّنِیۡ مِنَ الۡقَوۡمِ الظّٰلِمِیۡنَ
transliteration: Qala Rabbi innee thalamtunafsee faghfir lee faghafara lahu innahu huwa alghafooruarraheem Qala Rabbi bima anAAamtaAAalayya falan akoona thaheeran lilmujrimeen Rabbi najjinee mina alqawmi aththalimeen
translation: He said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, so forgive me," and He forgave him. Indeed, He is the Forgiving, the Merciful. He said, "My Lord, for the favor You bestowed upon me, I will never be an assistant to the criminals. My Lord, save me from the wrong doing people.
search: Make Dua for your parents Make Dua for your parents قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّیۡ ظَلَمۡتُ نَفۡسِیۡ فَاغۡفِرۡ لِیۡ فَغَفَرَ لَہٗ ؕ اِنَّہٗ ہُوَ الۡغَفُوۡرُ الرَّحِیۡمُ، قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَاۤ اَنۡعَمۡتَ عَلَیَّ فَلَنۡ اَکُوۡنَ ظَہِیۡرًا لِّلۡمُجۡرِمِیۡنَ، رَبِّ نَجِّنِیۡ مِنَ الۡقَوۡمِ الظّٰلِمِیۡنَ Qala Rabbi innee thalamtunafsee faghfir lee faghafara lahu innahu huwa alghafooruarraheem Qala Rabbi bima anAAamtaAAalayya falan akoona thaheeran lilmujrimeen Rabbi najjinee mina alqawmi aththalimeen He said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, so forgive me," and He forgave him. Indeed, He is the Forgiving, the Merciful. He said, "My Lord, for the favor You bestowed upon me, I will never be an assistant to the criminals. My Lord, save me from the wrong doing people. Surah Al-Qasas - 28:16-17, 21

arabic: رَبِّ اجۡعَلۡنِیۡ مُقِیۡمَ الصَّلٰوۃِ وَ مِنۡ ذُرِّیَّتِیۡ، رَبَّنَا وَ تَقَبَّلۡ دُعَآءِ
transliteration: Rabbij-A’lnee Muqeemas’ S’alaati Wa Min D’urrriyyatee Rabbanaa Wa Taqabbal Du-A’aa
translation: O my Lord! Make me one who performs As-Salaat (Iqaamat-as-Salaat), and (also) from my offspring, our Lord! And accept my invocation.
search: Make Dua for your parents Make Dua for your parents رَبِّ اجۡعَلۡنِیۡ مُقِیۡمَ الصَّلٰوۃِ وَ مِنۡ ذُرِّیَّتِیۡ، رَبَّنَا وَ تَقَبَّلۡ دُعَآءِ Rabbij-A’lnee Muqeemas’ S’alaati Wa Min D’urrriyyatee Rabbanaa Wa Taqabbal Du-A’aa O my Lord! Make me one who performs As-Salaat (Iqaamat-as-Salaat), and (also) from my offspring, our Lord! And accept my invocation. Surah Ibraheem - 14:40

arabic: رَّبِّ ارۡحَمۡہُمَا کَمَا رَبَّیٰنِیۡ صَغِیۡرًا
transliteration: Rabbi  irhamhuma kama rabbayani sagheera
translation: My Lord, have mercy upon them (parents) as they brought me up [when i was] small.
search: Make Dua for your parents Make Dua for your parents رَّبِّ ارۡحَمۡہُمَا کَمَا رَبَّیٰنِیۡ صَغِیۡرًا Rabbi  irhamhuma kama rabbayani sagheera My Lord, have mercy upon them (parents) as they brought me up [when i was] small. Surah Al-Isra - 17:24

arabic: رَبَّنَا ہَبۡ لَنَا مِنۡ اَزۡوَاجِنَا وَ ذُرِّیّٰتِنَا قُرَّۃَ اَعۡیُنٍ وَّ اجۡعَلۡنَا لِلۡمُتَّقِیۡنَ اِمَامًا
transliteration: Rabbana Hablana min azwaajina wadhurriy-yatina, qurrata ‘ayioni wa-jalna lil-muttaqeena Imaama
translation: O my Lord! Grant unto us wives and offspring who will be the comfort of our eyes, and give us (the grace) to lead the righteous.
search: For a blissful family For a blissful family رَبَّنَا ہَبۡ لَنَا مِنۡ اَزۡوَاجِنَا وَ ذُرِّیّٰتِنَا قُرَّۃَ اَعۡیُنٍ وَّ اجۡعَلۡنَا لِلۡمُتَّقِیۡنَ اِمَامًا Rabbana Hablana min azwaajina wadhurriy-yatina, qurrata ‘ayioni wa-jalna lil-muttaqeena Imaama O my Lord! Grant unto us wives and offspring who will be the comfort of our eyes, and give us (the grace) to lead the righteous. Surah Al-Furqan - 25:74

arabic: رَبِّ ہَبۡ لِیۡ مِنۡ لَّدُنۡکَ ذُرِّیَّۃً طَیِّبَۃً ۚ اِنَّکَ سَمِیۡعُ الدُّعَآءِ
transliteration: Rabbi Hab Lee Mil Ladunka D’urriyyatan T’ayyibah Innaka Samee-u’d Du’aa
translation: O my Lord! Grant me from You, a good offspring. You are indeed the All-Hearer of invocation.
benefits: Read this dua if you are having trouble having a child! Prophet Zakaria (AS) recited this dua, praying to Allah to grant him a child when he attained old age.
search: Asking Allah to grant you a child Asking Allah to grant you a child رَبِّ ہَبۡ لِیۡ مِنۡ لَّدُنۡکَ ذُرِّیَّۃً طَیِّبَۃً ۚ اِنَّکَ سَمِیۡعُ الدُّعَآءِ Rabbi Hab Lee Mil Ladunka D’urriyyatan T’ayyibah Innaka Samee-u’d Du’aa O my Lord! Grant me from You, a good offspring. You are indeed the All-Hearer of invocation. Surah Al-Imran - 3:38 Read this dua if you are having trouble having a child! Prophet Zakaria (AS) recited this dua, praying to Allah to grant him a child when he attained old age.
benefitsAr: إقرأ هذا الدعاء إذا كنت تواجه مشكلة في إنجاب طفل! وقد قرأ النبي زكريا (عليه السلام) هذا الدعاء، داعيا الله أن يرزقه ولدا عند بلوغه سن الرشد.

arabic: رَبِّ لَا تَذَرۡنِیۡ فَرۡدًا وَّ اَنۡتَ خَیۡرُ الۡوٰرِثِیۡنَ
transliteration: Rabbi Laa Tad’arnee Fardaw wa Anta Khayrul Waaritheen
translation: O My Lord! Leave me not single (childless), though You are the Best of the inheritors.

transliteration: Qaalat rab bibni lee 'indaka baitan fil jannati
translation: My Lord! Build me a house in Paradise near You

transliteration: Qadarullaahu wa maa shaa’afa’ala
translation: It is the Decree of Allah and He does whatever He wills.
