arabic: اِنَّا لِلّٰہِ وَ اِنَّاۤ اِلَیۡہِ رٰجِعُوۡنَ، اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي وَأَخْلِفْ لِي خَيْرًا مِنْهَا
transliteration: Innaa lillaahi wa ‘innaa ‘ilayhi raaji’oon, Allaahumma’-jurni fee museebatee wa ‘akhliflee khayran minhaa
translation: We are from Allah and unto Him we return. O Allah take me out of my plight and bring to me after it something better.
search: When stricken by tragedy When stricken by tragedy اِنَّا لِلّٰہِ وَ اِنَّاۤ اِلَیۡہِ رٰجِعُوۡنَ، اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي وَأَخْلِفْ لِي خَيْرًا مِنْهَا Innaa lillaahi wa ‘innaa ‘ilayhi raaji’oon, Allaahumma’-jurni fee museebatee wa ‘akhliflee khayran minhaa We are from Allah and unto Him we return. O Allah take me out of my plight and bring to me after it something better. Sahih Muslim: 918 (b)

arabic: حَسۡبُنَا اللّٰہُ وَ نِعۡمَ الۡوَکِیۡلُ
transliteration: Hasbunallaahu wa ni’amal-wakeel
translation: Allah is sufficient for us and the best of those on whom to depend.
search: When stricken by tragedy When stricken by tragedy حَسۡبُنَا اللّٰہُ وَ نِعۡمَ الۡوَکِیۡلُ Hasbunallaahu wa ni’amal-wakeel Allah is sufficient for us and the best of those on whom to depend. Surah Al-Imran 3:173

arabic: حَسۡبُنَا اللّٰہُ وَ نِعۡمَ الۡوَکِیۡلُ
transliteration: Hasbunallaahu wa ni’amal-wakeel
translation: Allah is sufficient for us and the best of those on whom to depend.
search: For seeking Allah's help For seeking Allah's help حَسۡبُنَا اللّٰہُ وَ نِعۡمَ الۡوَکِیۡلُ Hasbunallaahu wa ni’amal-wakeel Allah is sufficient for us and the best of those on whom to depend. Surah Al-Imran 3:173

arabic: اِنَّمَاۤ اَشۡکُوۡا بَثِّیۡ وَ حُزۡنِیۡۤ  اِلَی اللّٰہِ وَ اَعۡلَمُ مِنَ اللّٰہِ مَا لَا تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
transliteration: Innama ashkoo baththee wahuzneeila Allahi waaAAlamu mina Allahi ma lataAAlamoon
translation: I only complain of my suffering and my grief to Allah, and I know from Allah that which you do not know.
benefits: Prophet Ya'coob (AS) used to recite this dua.
search: For seeking Allah's help For seeking Allah's help اِنَّمَاۤ اَشۡکُوۡا بَثِّیۡ وَ حُزۡنِیۡۤ  اِلَی اللّٰہِ وَ اَعۡلَمُ مِنَ اللّٰہِ مَا لَا تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ Innama ashkoo baththee wahuzneeila Allahi waaAAlamu mina Allahi ma lataAAlamoon I only complain of my suffering and my grief to Allah, and I know from Allah that which you do not know. Surah Yusuf - 12:86 Prophet Ya'coob (AS) used to recite this dua.
benefitsAr: وكان النبي يعقوب (ع) يقرأ هذا الدعاء.

category: At times of worry and sorry
categoryEn: At times of worry and sorry
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
transliteration: Allaahumma ‘innee ‘a’oothu bika minal-hammi walhazani, wal’ajzi walkasali, walbukhli waljubni, wa dhala’id-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijaal
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in you from grief and sadness, from weakness and from laziness, from miserliness and from cowardice, from being overcome by debt and overpowered by men (i .e . others).
search: At times of worry and sorry At times of worry and sorry اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ Allaahumma ‘innee ‘a’oothu bika minal-hammi walhazani, wal’ajzi walkasali, walbukhli waljubni, wa dhala’id-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijaal O Allah, I seek refuge in you from grief and sadness, from weakness and from laziness, from miserliness and from cowardice, from being overcome by debt and overpowered by men (i .e . others). Sahih Al-Bukhari: 6369

arabic: لَّاۤ اِلٰہَ  اِلَّاۤ اَنۡتَ سُبۡحٰنَکَ  اِنِّیۡ کُنۡتُ مِنَ الظّٰلِمِیۡنَ
transliteration: Laa ‘ilaaha ‘illaa ‘Anta subhaanaka ‘innee kuntu minadh-dhaalimeen
translation: There is none worthy of worship but You, glory is to You. Surely, I was among the wrongdoers.
benefits: Prophet Yunus supplicate this Dua to Allah when he was in the belly of the whale.
search: When in distress When in distress لَّاۤ اِلٰہَ  اِلَّاۤ اَنۡتَ سُبۡحٰنَکَ  اِنِّیۡ کُنۡتُ مِنَ الظّٰلِمِیۡنَ Laa ‘ilaaha ‘illaa ‘Anta subhaanaka ‘innee kuntu minadh-dhaalimeen There is none worthy of worship but You, glory is to You. Surely, I was among the wrongdoers. Surah Al-Anbiya - 21:87, At-Tirmidhi: 3505 Prophet Yunus supplicate this Dua to Allah when he was in the belly of the whale.
benefitsAr: النبي يونس دعا الله بهذا الدعاء وهو في بطن الحوت.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَحْمَتَكَ أَرْجُو فَلاَ تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ وَأَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
transliteration: Allaahumma rahmataka ‘arjoo falaa takilnee ‘ilaa nafsee tarfata ‘aynin, wa ‘aslih lee sha’nee kullahu, laa’ilaaha ‘illaa ‘Anta
translation: O Allah, I hope for Your mercy. Do not leave me to myself even for the blinking of an eye (i.e. a moment). Correct all of my affairs for me. There is none worthy of worship but You.
search: When in distress When in distress اللَّهُمَّ رَحْمَتَكَ أَرْجُو فَلاَ تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ وَأَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ Allaahumma rahmataka ‘arjoo falaa takilnee ‘ilaa nafsee tarfata ‘aynin, wa ‘aslih lee sha’nee kullahu, laa’ilaaha ‘illaa ‘Anta O Allah, I hope for Your mercy. Do not leave me to myself even for the blinking of an eye (i.e. a moment). Correct all of my affairs for me. There is none worthy of worship but You. Abu Dawud: 5090

arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللّٰهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللّٰهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللّٰهُ رَبُّ السَّمَوَاتِ، وَرَبُّ الأَرْضِ، وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ
transliteration: Laa ‘ilaaha ‘illallaahul-’Adheemul-Haleem, laa ‘ilaaha ‘illallaahu Rabbul-’Arshil-’Adheem, laa ‘ilaaha ‘illallaahu Rabbus-samaawaati wa Rabbul-’ardhi wa Rabbul-’Arshil-Kareem
translation: There is none worthy of worship but Allah the Mighty, the Forbearing. There is none worthy of worship but Allah, Lord of the Magnificent Throne. There is none worthy of worship but Allah, Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, and Lord of the Noble Throne.
search: When in distress When in distress لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللّٰهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللّٰهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللّٰهُ رَبُّ السَّمَوَاتِ، وَرَبُّ الأَرْضِ، وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ Laa ‘ilaaha ‘illallaahul-’Adheemul-Haleem, laa ‘ilaaha ‘illallaahu Rabbul-’Arshil-’Adheem, laa ‘ilaaha ‘illallaahu Rabbus-samaawaati wa Rabbul-’ardhi wa Rabbul-’Arshil-Kareem There is none worthy of worship but Allah the Mighty, the Forbearing. There is none worthy of worship but Allah, Lord of the Magnificent Throne. There is none worthy of worship but Allah, Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, and Lord of the Noble Throne. Sahih Al-Bukhari: 6346

arabic: يَا حَىُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ، يَا ذَا الْجَلاَلِ وَالإِكْرَامِ
transliteration: Ya hayyu ya qayyoom, birahmatika astagheeth, Ya Dhal-Jalali wal-Ikram
translation: O Ever Living, O Self-Sustaining Sustainer! In Your Mercy do I seek relief, O Possessor of Majesty and Honor.
search: When in distress When in distress يَا حَىُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ، يَا ذَا الْجَلاَلِ وَالإِكْرَامِ Ya hayyu ya qayyoom, birahmatika astagheeth, Ya Dhal-Jalali wal-Ikram O Ever Living, O Self-Sustaining Sustainer! In Your Mercy do I seek relief, O Possessor of Majesty and Honor. At-Tirmidhi: 3524

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
transliteration: Allaahumma ‘innee ‘a’oothu bika minal-hammi walhazani, wal’ajzi walkasali, walbukhli waljubni, wa dhala’id-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijaal
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in you from grief and sadness, from weakness and from laziness, from miserliness and from cowardice, from being overcome by debt and overpowered by men (i .e . others).
search: For overcoming your weaknesses For overcoming your weaknesses اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ Allaahumma ‘innee ‘a’oothu bika minal-hammi walhazani, wal’ajzi walkasali, walbukhli waljubni, wa dhala’id-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijaal O Allah, I seek refuge in you from grief and sadness, from weakness and from laziness, from miserliness and from cowardice, from being overcome by debt and overpowered by men (i .e . others). Sahih Al-Bukhari: 6369

arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ
transliteration: Alhamdu lillaahi ‘alaa kulli haal
translation: Praise is to Allah in all circumstances.
search: On hearing a bad news On hearing a bad news الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ Alhamdu lillaahi ‘alaa kulli haal Praise is to Allah in all circumstances. Ibn Majah: 3803

arabic: رَبَّنَاۤ اَفۡرِغۡ عَلَیۡنَا صَبۡرًا وَّ تَوَفَّنَا مُسۡلِمِیۡنَ
transliteration: Rabbanaaa Afrigh A’laynaa S’abraw Wa Tawaffanaa Muslimeen
translation: Our Lord! pour out on us patience, and cause us to die as Muslims.
search: For patience during difficult times For patience during difficult times رَبَّنَاۤ اَفۡرِغۡ عَلَیۡنَا صَبۡرًا وَّ تَوَفَّنَا مُسۡلِمِیۡنَ Rabbanaaa Afrigh A’laynaa S’abraw Wa Tawaffanaa Muslimeen Our Lord! pour out on us patience, and cause us to die as Muslims. Surah Al-A'raf - 7:126

arabic: رَبِّ احۡکُمۡ بِالۡحَقِّ وَ رَبُّنَا الرَّحۡمٰنُ الۡمُسۡتَعَانُ عَلٰی مَا تَصِفُوۡنَ
transliteration: Rabbi ohkum bilhaqqi wa rabbuna arrahmanul musta’aanu alaa ma tasifoon
translation: My Lord, judge [between us] in truth. And our Lord is the Most Merciful, the one whose help is sought against that which you describe.
benefits: Read this dua if you are bullied at school or the workplace or are under the rule of tyrants! Prophet (SAW) recited this dua when the disbelievers mocked him and said terrible things about him.
search: When someone insults you When someone insults you رَبِّ احۡکُمۡ بِالۡحَقِّ وَ رَبُّنَا الرَّحۡمٰنُ الۡمُسۡتَعَانُ عَلٰی مَا تَصِفُوۡنَ Rabbi ohkum bilhaqqi wa rabbuna arrahmanul musta’aanu alaa ma tasifoon My Lord, judge [between us] in truth. And our Lord is the Most Merciful, the one whose help is sought against that which you describe. Surah Al-Anbiya - 21:112 Read this dua if you are bullied at school or the workplace or are under the rule of tyrants! Prophet (SAW) recited this dua when the disbelievers mocked him and said terrible things about him.
benefitsAr: إقرأ هذا الدعاء إذا كنت تتعرض للتنمر في المدرسة أو مكان العمل أو كنت تحت حكم الطغاة! وقد قرأ النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم هذا الدعاء عندما سخر منه الكفار وقالوا عنه أشياء فظيعة.

arabic: حَسۡبِیَ اللّٰہُ  لَاۤ اِلٰہَ اِلَّا ہُوَ   ؕ عَلَیۡہِ تَوَکَّلۡتُ وَ ہُوَ رَبُّ الۡعَرۡشِ الۡعَظِیۡمِ
transliteration: Hasbiyal-lahu la ilaha illa huwa, AAalayhi tawakkalt, wahuwa rabbul-AAarshil-Aaatheem
translation: Allah is Sufficient for me, none has the right to be worshipped except Him, upon Him I rely and He is Lord of the exalted throne.
search: To trust upon Allah To trust upon Allah حَسۡبِیَ اللّٰہُ  لَاۤ اِلٰہَ اِلَّا ہُوَ   ؕ عَلَیۡہِ تَوَکَّلۡتُ وَ ہُوَ رَبُّ الۡعَرۡشِ الۡعَظِیۡمِ Hasbiyal-lahu la ilaha illa huwa, AAalayhi tawakkalt, wahuwa rabbul-AAarshil-Aaatheem Allah is Sufficient for me, none has the right to be worshipped except Him, upon Him I rely and He is Lord of the exalted throne. Surah Taubah 9:129

arabic: وَ اُفَوِّضُ اَمۡرِیۡۤ اِلَی اللّٰہِ ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰہَ بَصِیۡرٌۢ بِالۡعِبَادِ
transliteration: wa ufawwidhu amree ila Allahi innallaha baseerun bil ibaad
translation: And you will remember what I [now] say to you, and I entrust my affair to Allah . Indeed, Allah is Seeing of [His] servants.
search: To trust upon Allah To trust upon Allah وَ اُفَوِّضُ اَمۡرِیۡۤ اِلَی اللّٰہِ ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰہَ بَصِیۡرٌۢ بِالۡعِبَادِ wa ufawwidhu amree ila Allahi innallaha baseerun bil ibaad And you will remember what I [now] say to you, and I entrust my affair to Allah . Indeed, Allah is Seeing of [His] servants. Surah Ghafir - 40:44

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لاَ تُؤَاخِذْنِي بِمَا يَقُولُونَ، وَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا لا يَعْلَمُونَ‏
transliteration: Allaahumma laa tu’aakhithnee bimaa yaqooloona, waghfir lee maa laa ya’lamoon
translation: O Allah, do not call me to account for what they say and forgive me for what they have no knowledge of.
search: When someone praises you When someone praises you اللَّهُمَّ لاَ تُؤَاخِذْنِي بِمَا يَقُولُونَ، وَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا لا يَعْلَمُونَ‏ Allaahumma laa tu’aakhithnee bimaa yaqooloona, waghfir lee maa laa ya’lamoon O Allah, do not call me to account for what they say and forgive me for what they have no knowledge of. Al-Adab Al-Mufrad: 761

arabic: لَّاۤ اِلٰہَ اِلَّاۤ اللّٰہُ
transliteration: Laa ‘ilaaha ‘illallaahu
translation: There is none worthy of worship but Allah.
search: When feeling frightened When feeling frightened لَّاۤ اِلٰہَ اِلَّاۤ اللّٰہُ Laa ‘ilaaha ‘illallaahu There is none worthy of worship but Allah. Sahih Al-Bukhari: 3346

arabic: رَبَّنَاۤ اَفۡرِغۡ عَلَیۡنَا صَبۡرًا وَّ ثَبِّتۡ اَقۡدَامَنَا وَ انۡصُرۡنَا عَلَی الۡقَوۡمِ الۡکٰفِرِیۡنَ
transliteration: Rabbana Afrigh A’layna Sabran wa Thabbit Aqdamana Wansurna A’lal Qawmil Kafireen
translation: Our Lord! Bestow on us endurance, make our foothold sure, and give us help against the disbelieving folk.
search: For patience For patience رَبَّنَاۤ اَفۡرِغۡ عَلَیۡنَا صَبۡرًا وَّ ثَبِّتۡ اَقۡدَامَنَا وَ انۡصُرۡنَا عَلَی الۡقَوۡمِ الۡکٰفِرِیۡنَ Rabbana Afrigh A’layna Sabran wa Thabbit Aqdamana Wansurna A’lal Qawmil Kafireen Our Lord! Bestow on us endurance, make our foothold sure, and give us help against the disbelieving folk. Al-Baqarah - 2:250

arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللّٰهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطانِ الرَّجِيْمِ
transliteration: A’oothu billaahi minash-Shaytaanir-rajeem
translation: I seek refuge with Allah against the Satan, the outcast.
search: For controlling your anger For controlling your anger أَعُوذُ بِاللّٰهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطانِ الرَّجِيْمِ A’oothu billaahi minash-Shaytaanir-rajeem I seek refuge with Allah against the Satan, the outcast. Abu Dawud: 4781

arabic: اِنَّا لِلّٰہِ وَ اِنَّاۤ اِلَیۡہِ رٰجِعُوۡنَ
transliteration: Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raajioon
translation: Indeed we belong to Allah, and indeed to Him we will return.
search: When a loss occurs When a loss occurs اِنَّا لِلّٰہِ وَ اِنَّاۤ اِلَیۡہِ رٰجِعُوۡنَ Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raajioon Indeed we belong to Allah, and indeed to Him we will return. Surah Al-Baqarah 2:156, At-Tirmidhi: 3511

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلاَلِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
transliteration: Allaahummak-finee bihalaalika ‘an haraamika wa ‘aghninee bifadhlika ‘amman siwaaka
translation: O Allah, suffice me with what You have allowed instead of what You have forbidden, and make me independent of all others besides You.
search: Settle a debt Settle a debt اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلاَلِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ Allaahummak-finee bihalaalika ‘an haraamika wa ‘aghninee bifadhlika ‘amman siwaaka O Allah, suffice me with what You have allowed instead of what You have forbidden, and make me independent of all others besides You. At-Tirmidhi: 3563

category: For someone who lends you money
categoryEn: For someone who lends you money
arabic: بَارَكَ اللّٰهُ لَكَ فِي أَهْلِكَ وَمَالِكَ إِنَّمَا جَزَاءُ السَّلَفِ الْحَمْدُ وَالأَدَاءُ
transliteration: Baarakallaahu laka fee ‘ahlika wa maalika, ‘innamaa jazaa’us-salafil-hamdu wal’adaa’
translation: May Allah bless you in your family and your wealth, surely the reward for a loan is praise and returning (what was borrowed).
search: For someone who lends you money For someone who lends you money بَارَكَ اللّٰهُ لَكَ فِي أَهْلِكَ وَمَالِكَ إِنَّمَا جَزَاءُ السَّلَفِ الْحَمْدُ وَالأَدَاءُ Baarakallaahu laka fee ‘ahlika wa maalika, ‘innamaa jazaa’us-salafil-hamdu wal’adaa’ May Allah bless you in your family and your wealth, surely the reward for a loan is praise and returning (what was borrowed). An-Nasai: 4683

arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغۡ قُلُوۡبَنَا بَعۡدَ اِذۡ ہَدَیۡتَنَا وَ ہَبۡ لَنَا مِنۡ لَّدُنۡکَ رَحۡمَۃً ۚ اِنَّکَ اَنۡتَ الۡوَہَّابُ
transliteration: Rabbanaa Laa Tuzigh Quloobanaa Ba’-Da Id’hadaytanaa Wa Hab Lanaa Mil Ladunka Rah’mah Innaka Antal Wahaab
translation: Our Lord! Let not our hearts deviate (from the truth) after You have guided us, and grant us mercy from You. Truly, You are the Bestower.
search: Strengthen your Imaan Strengthen your Imaan رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغۡ قُلُوۡبَنَا بَعۡدَ اِذۡ ہَدَیۡتَنَا وَ ہَبۡ لَنَا مِنۡ لَّدُنۡکَ رَحۡمَۃً ۚ اِنَّکَ اَنۡتَ الۡوَہَّابُ Rabbanaa Laa Tuzigh Quloobanaa Ba’-Da Id’hadaytanaa Wa Hab Lanaa Mil Ladunka Rah’mah Innaka Antal Wahaab Our Lord! Let not our hearts deviate (from the truth) after You have guided us, and grant us mercy from You. Truly, You are the Bestower. Surah Al-Imran - 3:8

arabic: رَبَّنَا اغۡفِرۡ لَنَا ذُنُوۡبَنَا وَ اِسۡرَافَنَا فِیۡۤ اَمۡرِنَا وَ ثَبِّتۡ اَقۡدَامَنَا وَ انۡصُرۡنَا عَلَی الۡقَوۡمِ الۡکٰفِرِیۡنَ
transliteration: Rabbanaghfir lanaa d’unoobanaa wa israafanaa fee amrinaa wa thabbit aqdaamanaa wan s’urnaa a’lal qawmil kaafireen
translation: Our Lord! Forgive us our sins and our transgressions (in keeping our duties to You), establish our feet firmly, and give us victory over the disbelieving folk.
search: Strengthen your Imaan Strengthen your Imaan رَبَّنَا اغۡفِرۡ لَنَا ذُنُوۡبَنَا وَ اِسۡرَافَنَا فِیۡۤ اَمۡرِنَا وَ ثَبِّتۡ اَقۡدَامَنَا وَ انۡصُرۡنَا عَلَی الۡقَوۡمِ الۡکٰفِرِیۡنَ Rabbanaghfir lanaa d’unoobanaa wa israafanaa fee amrinaa wa thabbit aqdaamanaa wan s’urnaa a’lal qawmil kaafireen Our Lord! Forgive us our sins and our transgressions (in keeping our duties to You), establish our feet firmly, and give us victory over the disbelieving folk. Surah Al-Imran - 3:147

arabic: رَضِيتُ بِاللّٰهِ رَبًّا وَبِالإِسْلاَمِ دِينًا وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيًّا
transliteration: Radeetu billahi rabban wabil-islami deenan wabiMuhammadin nabiyya.
translation: I am pleased with Allah as a Lord, and Islam as a religion and Muhammad peace be upon to him as a Prophet.
search: Strengthen your Imaan Strengthen your Imaan رَضِيتُ بِاللّٰهِ رَبًّا وَبِالإِسْلاَمِ دِينًا وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيًّا Radeetu billahi rabban wabil-islami deenan wabiMuhammadin nabiyya. I am pleased with Allah as a Lord, and Islam as a religion and Muhammad peace be upon to him as a Prophet. Ibn Majah: 3870

arabic: اَعُوۡذُ بِاللّٰہ
transliteration: `A’udhu billah
translation: I seek refuge in Allah.
search: Strengthen your Imaan Strengthen your Imaan اَعُوۡذُ بِاللّٰہ `A’udhu billah I seek refuge in Allah. Abu Dawud: 5

arabic: آمَنْتُ بِاللّٰهِ وَرُسُلِهِ
transliteration: Aamantu billaahi wa Rusulihi
translation: I believe in Allah and His Messenger.
search: Strengthen your Imaan Strengthen your Imaan آمَنْتُ بِاللّٰهِ وَرُسُلِهِ Aamantu billaahi wa Rusulihi I believe in Allah and His Messenger. Sahih Al-Bukhari: 3055

arabic: رَبَّنَاۤ اٰمَنَّا بِمَاۤ اَنۡزَلۡتَ وَ اتَّبَعۡنَا الرَّسُوۡلَ فَاکۡتُبۡنَا مَعَ الشّٰہِدِیۡنَ
transliteration: Rabbana amanna bima anzalta wattaba ‘nar-Rusula fak-tubna ma’ash-Shahideen
translation: Our Lord! We believe in what Thou hast revealed, and we follow the Messenger. Then write us down among those who bear witness.
benefits: This dua was asked by the companions of Prophet Isa (AS).
search: To make us practicing Muslims To make us practicing Muslims رَبَّنَاۤ اٰمَنَّا بِمَاۤ اَنۡزَلۡتَ وَ اتَّبَعۡنَا الرَّسُوۡلَ فَاکۡتُبۡنَا مَعَ الشّٰہِدِیۡنَ Rabbana amanna bima anzalta wattaba ‘nar-Rusula fak-tubna ma’ash-Shahideen Our Lord! We believe in what Thou hast revealed, and we follow the Messenger. Then write us down among those who bear witness. Surah Al-Imran - 3:53 This dua was asked by the companions of Prophet Isa (AS).
benefitsAr: هذا الدعاء سأله أصحاب النبي عيسى (ع).

category: Seek forgiveness and strengthen your Imaan
categoryEn: Seek forgiveness and strengthen your Imaan
arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذۡنَاۤ اِنۡ نَّسِیۡنَاۤ اَوۡ اَخۡطَاۡنَا، رَبَّنَا وَ لَا تَحۡمِلۡ عَلَیۡنَاۤ اِصۡرًا کَمَا حَمَلۡتَہٗ عَلَی الَّذِیۡنَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِنَا، رَبَّنَا وَ لَا تُحَمِّلۡنَا مَا لَا طَاقَۃَ لَنَا بِہٖ، وَ اعۡفُ عَنَّا، وَ اغۡفِرۡ لَنَا، وَ ارۡحَمۡنَا، اَنۡتَ مَوۡلٰىنَا فَانۡصُرۡنَا عَلَی الۡقَوۡمِ الۡکٰفِرِیۡنَ
transliteration: Rabbanaa Laa Too-Akhid’naaa In-Naseenaa Aw Akht’aanaa Rabbanaa wa Laa Tah’mil A’laynaaa Is’ran Kamaa Ha’maltahoo A’lal Lad’eena min Qablinaa Rabbanaa wa Laa Tuh’ammilnaa Maa Laa T’aaqata Lanaa Bih Wa’-Fu A’nnaa Waghfirlanaa Warh’amnaa Anta Mawlaanaa Fans’urnaa A’lal Qawmil Kaafireen
translation: Our Lord! Punish us not if we forget or fall into error, our Lord! Lay not on us a burden like that which You did lay on those before us; our Lord! Put not on us a burden greater than we have strength to bear. Pardon us and grant us Forgiveness. Have mercy on us. You are our Maula (Patron, Supporter and Protector, etc.) and give us victory over the disbelieving people.
search: Seek forgiveness and strengthen your Imaan Seek forgiveness and strengthen your Imaan رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذۡنَاۤ اِنۡ نَّسِیۡنَاۤ اَوۡ اَخۡطَاۡنَا، رَبَّنَا وَ لَا تَحۡمِلۡ عَلَیۡنَاۤ اِصۡرًا کَمَا حَمَلۡتَہٗ عَلَی الَّذِیۡنَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِنَا، رَبَّنَا وَ لَا تُحَمِّلۡنَا مَا لَا طَاقَۃَ لَنَا بِہٖ، وَ اعۡفُ عَنَّا، وَ اغۡفِرۡ لَنَا، وَ ارۡحَمۡنَا، اَنۡتَ مَوۡلٰىنَا فَانۡصُرۡنَا عَلَی الۡقَوۡمِ الۡکٰفِرِیۡنَ Rabbanaa Laa Too-Akhid’naaa In-Naseenaa Aw Akht’aanaa Rabbanaa wa Laa Tah’mil A’laynaaa Is’ran Kamaa Ha’maltahoo A’lal Lad’eena min Qablinaa Rabbanaa wa Laa Tuh’ammilnaa Maa Laa T’aaqata Lanaa Bih Wa’-Fu A’nnaa Waghfirlanaa Warh’amnaa Anta Mawlaanaa Fans’urnaa A’lal Qawmil Kaafireen Our Lord! Punish us not if we forget or fall into error, our Lord! Lay not on us a burden like that which You did lay on those before us; our Lord! Put not on us a burden greater than we have strength to bear. Pardon us and grant us Forgiveness. Have mercy on us. You are our Maula (Patron, Supporter and Protector, etc.) and give us victory over the disbelieving people. Surah Al-Baqarah - 2:286

arabic: اِنِّیۡ وَجَّہۡتُ وَجۡہِیَ لِلَّذِیۡ فَطَرَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الۡاَرۡضَ حَنِیۡفًا وَّ مَاۤ اَنَا مِنَ الۡمُشۡرِکِیۡنَ
transliteration: Innee wajjahtu wajhiya lillathee fataraassamawati wal-arda haneefanwama ana mina almushrikeen
translation: Indeed, I have turned my face toward He who created the heavens and the earth, inclining toward truth, and I am not of those who associate others with Allah.
search: Pledge to Allah Pledge to Allah اِنِّیۡ وَجَّہۡتُ وَجۡہِیَ لِلَّذِیۡ فَطَرَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الۡاَرۡضَ حَنِیۡفًا وَّ مَاۤ اَنَا مِنَ الۡمُشۡرِکِیۡنَ Innee wajjahtu wajhiya lillathee fataraassamawati wal-arda haneefanwama ana mina almushrikeen Indeed, I have turned my face toward He who created the heavens and the earth, inclining toward truth, and I am not of those who associate others with Allah. Surah Al-An'am - 6:79

arabic: اِنَّ صَلَاتِیۡ وَ نُسُکِیۡ وَ مَحۡیَایَ وَ مَمَاتِیۡ  لِلّٰہِ  رَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِیۡنَ لَا شَرِیۡکَ لَہٗ، وَ بِذٰلِکَ اُمِرۡتُ وَ اَنَا اَوَّلُ الۡمُسۡلِمِیۡنَ
transliteration: inna salatee wanusukee wamahyaya wamamatee lillahi rabbil aalameen. La shareeka lahu wa bithalika omirtu wa ana aw walul muslimeen
translation: Indeed, my prayer, my rites of sacrifice, my living and my dying are for Allah, Lord of the worlds. He has no partner. And of this I have been commanded, and I am the first of the Muslims.
search: Pledge to Allah Pledge to Allah اِنَّ صَلَاتِیۡ وَ نُسُکِیۡ وَ مَحۡیَایَ وَ مَمَاتِیۡ  لِلّٰہِ  رَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِیۡنَ لَا شَرِیۡکَ لَہٗ، وَ بِذٰلِکَ اُمِرۡتُ وَ اَنَا اَوَّلُ الۡمُسۡلِمِیۡنَ inna salatee wanusukee wamahyaya wamamatee lillahi rabbil aalameen. La shareeka lahu wa bithalika omirtu wa ana aw walul muslimeen Indeed, my prayer, my rites of sacrifice, my living and my dying are for Allah, Lord of the worlds. He has no partner. And of this I have been commanded, and I am the first of the Muslims. Surah Al-An'am - 6:162-163

arabic: فَاطِرَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الۡاَرۡضِ ۟ اَنۡتَ وَلِیّٖ فِی الدُّنۡیَا وَ الۡاٰخِرَۃِ ۚ تَوَفَّنِیۡ مُسۡلِمًا وَّ اَلۡحِقۡنِیۡ بِالصّٰلِحِیۡنَ
transliteration: fatira assamawatiwal-ardi anta waliyyee fee addunyawal-akhirati tawaffanee musliman waalhiqneebissaliheen
translation: Creator of the heavens and earth, You are my protector in this world and in the Hereafter. Cause me to die a Muslim and join me with the righteous.
benefits: Read this dua for good and righteous company. Prophet Yusuf (AS) recited this dua.
search: For righteous company For righteous company فَاطِرَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الۡاَرۡضِ ۟ اَنۡتَ وَلِیّٖ فِی الدُّنۡیَا وَ الۡاٰخِرَۃِ ۚ تَوَفَّنِیۡ مُسۡلِمًا وَّ اَلۡحِقۡنِیۡ بِالصّٰلِحِیۡنَ fatira assamawatiwal-ardi anta waliyyee fee addunyawal-akhirati tawaffanee musliman waalhiqneebissaliheen Creator of the heavens and earth, You are my protector in this world and in the Hereafter. Cause me to die a Muslim and join me with the righteous. Surah Yusuf - 12:101 Read this dua for good and righteous company. Prophet Yusuf (AS) recited this dua.
benefitsAr: إقرأ هذا الدعاء من أجل الرفقة الصالحة. قرأ النبي يوسف (ع) هذا الدعاء.

arabic: رَبَّنَاۤ اٰمَنَّا فَاکۡتُبۡنَا مَعَ الشّٰہِدِیۡنَ
transliteration: Rabbana aamana faktubna ma’ ash-shahideen
translation: Our Lord! We believe; write us down among the witnesses.
search: For righteous company For righteous company رَبَّنَاۤ اٰمَنَّا فَاکۡتُبۡنَا مَعَ الشّٰہِدِیۡنَ Rabbana aamana faktubna ma’ ash-shahideen Our Lord! We believe; write us down among the witnesses. Surah Al-Ma'ida - 5:83

arabic: رَّبِّ زِدۡنِیۡ عِلۡمًا
transliteration: Rabbi Zidnee I’lmaa.
translation: My Lord! Increase me in knowledge.
search: Increase in knowledge Increase in knowledge رَّبِّ زِدۡنِیۡ عِلۡمًا Rabbi Zidnee I’lmaa. My Lord! Increase me in knowledge. Surah Taha - 20:114

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْماً نَافِعاً،  وَرِزْقاً طَيِّباً،  وَعَمَلاً مُتَقَبَّلاً
transliteration: Allaahumma ‘innee ‘as’aluka ‘ilman naafi’an, wa rizqan tayyiban, wa ‘amalan mutaqabbalan
translation: O Allah, I ask You for knowledge that is of benefit, a good provision, and deeds that will be accepted.
search: Increase in knowledge Increase in knowledge اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْماً نَافِعاً،  وَرِزْقاً طَيِّباً،  وَعَمَلاً مُتَقَبَّلاً Allaahumma ‘innee ‘as’aluka ‘ilman naafi’an, wa rizqan tayyiban, wa ‘amalan mutaqabbalan O Allah, I ask You for knowledge that is of benefit, a good provision, and deeds that will be accepted. Ibn Majah: 925

arabic: رَبِّ ہَبۡ لِیۡ حُکۡمًا وَّ اَلۡحِقۡنِیۡ بِالصّٰلِحِیۡنَ، وَ اجۡعَلۡ لِّیۡ لِسَانَ صِدۡقٍ فِی الۡاٰخِرِیۡنَ، وَ اجۡعَلۡنِیۡ مِنۡ وَّرَثَۃِ جَنَّۃِ النَّعِیۡمِ، وَ اغۡفِرۡ لِاَبِیۡۤ اِنَّہٗ کَانَ مِنَ الضَّآلِّیۡنَ، وَ لَا تُخۡزِنِیۡ یَوۡمَ یُبۡعَثُوۡنَ، یَوۡمَ لَا یَنۡفَعُ مَالٌ وَّ لَا بَنُوۡنَ، اِلَّا مَنۡ اَتَی اللّٰہَ بِقَلۡبٍ سَلِیۡمٍ
transliteration: Rabbi hab lee hukman wa alhiqnee bis saliheen. Waj’al lee lisana sidqin fil akhireen. Waj’al nee min warathati jannatin na’eem. Waghfir li-abee innahu kanamina addalleen. Wala tukhzinee yawma yub’asoon. Yawma la yanfa’u malun walaa banoon. Illa man ata Allah bi qalbin saleem.
translation: My Lord! Bestow Hukman (religious knowledge, right judgement of the affairs and Prophethood) on me, and join me with the righteous. And grant me an honourable mention in later generations. And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Pleasure. And forgive my father. Indeed, he has been of those astray. And disgrace me not on the Day when (all the creatures) will be resurrected. The Day when there will not benefit [anyone] wealth or children, But only one who comes to Allah with a sound heart.
benefits: This was Prophet Ibrahim's (AS) favorite Dua
search: Increase in knowledge Increase in knowledge رَبِّ ہَبۡ لِیۡ حُکۡمًا وَّ اَلۡحِقۡنِیۡ بِالصّٰلِحِیۡنَ، وَ اجۡعَلۡ لِّیۡ لِسَانَ صِدۡقٍ فِی الۡاٰخِرِیۡنَ، وَ اجۡعَلۡنِیۡ مِنۡ وَّرَثَۃِ جَنَّۃِ النَّعِیۡمِ، وَ اغۡفِرۡ لِاَبِیۡۤ اِنَّہٗ کَانَ مِنَ الضَّآلِّیۡنَ، وَ لَا تُخۡزِنِیۡ یَوۡمَ یُبۡعَثُوۡنَ، یَوۡمَ لَا یَنۡفَعُ مَالٌ وَّ لَا بَنُوۡنَ، اِلَّا مَنۡ اَتَی اللّٰہَ بِقَلۡبٍ سَلِیۡمٍ Rabbi hab lee hukman wa alhiqnee bis saliheen. Waj’al lee lisana sidqin fil akhireen. Waj’al nee min warathati jannatin na’eem. Waghfir li-abee innahu kanamina addalleen. Wala tukhzinee yawma yub’asoon. Yawma la yanfa’u malun walaa banoon. Illa man ata Allah bi qalbin saleem. My Lord! Bestow Hukman (religious knowledge, right judgement of the affairs and Prophethood) on me, and join me with the righteous. And grant me an honourable mention in later generations. And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Pleasure. And forgive my father. Indeed, he has been of those astray. And disgrace me not on the Day when (all the creatures) will be resurrected. The Day when there will not benefit [anyone] wealth or children, But only one who comes to Allah with a sound heart. Surah Ash-Shu'araa - 26:83-89 This was Prophet Ibrahim's (AS) favorite Dua
benefitsAr: كان هذا الدعاء المفضل للنبي إبراهيم (ع).

arabic: رَبِّ اشۡرَحۡ لِیۡ صَدۡرِیۡ، وَ یَسِّرۡ لِیۡۤ اَمۡرِیۡ، وَ احۡلُلۡ عُقۡدَۃً  مِّنۡ لِّسَانِیۡ، یَفۡقَہُوۡا قَوۡلِیۡ
transliteration: Rabbishrah’ Lee S’adree wa Yassir Leee Amree Wah’–Lul U’qdatam Mil Lisaanee Yafqahoo Qawlee
translation: O my Lord! Open for me my chest. And ease my task for me.  And make loose the knot from my tongue, that they understand my speech.
search: Grant me confidence and eloquence Grant me confidence and eloquence رَبِّ اشۡرَحۡ لِیۡ صَدۡرِیۡ، وَ یَسِّرۡ لِیۡۤ اَمۡرِیۡ، وَ احۡلُلۡ عُقۡدَۃً  مِّنۡ لِّسَانِیۡ، یَفۡقَہُوۡا قَوۡلِیۡ Rabbishrah’ Lee S’adree wa Yassir Leee Amree Wah’–Lul U’qdatam Mil Lisaanee Yafqahoo Qawlee O my Lord! Open for me my chest. And ease my task for me.  And make loose the knot from my tongue, that they understand my speech. Surah Ta'ha - 20:25-28

arabic: سُبۡحٰنَکَ لَا عِلۡمَ لَنَاۤ اِلَّا مَا عَلَّمۡتَنَا ؕ اِنَّکَ اَنۡتَ الۡعَلِیۡمُ الۡحَکِیۡمُ
transliteration: Subhanaka laAAilma lana illa ma AAallamtanainnaka anta alAAaleemu alhakeem
translation: Glory be to You, we have no knowledge except what you have taught us. Verily, it is You, the All-Knower, the All-Wise.
search: Grant me confidence and eloquence Grant me confidence and eloquence سُبۡحٰنَکَ لَا عِلۡمَ لَنَاۤ اِلَّا مَا عَلَّمۡتَنَا ؕ اِنَّکَ اَنۡتَ الۡعَلِیۡمُ الۡحَکِیۡمُ Subhanaka laAAilma lana illa ma AAallamtanainnaka anta alAAaleemu alhakeem Glory be to You, we have no knowledge except what you have taught us. Verily, it is You, the All-Knower, the All-Wise. Surah Al-Baqarah - 2:32

arabic: اَعُوۡذُ بِاللّٰہِ اَنۡ اَکُوۡنَ مِنَ الۡجٰہِلِیۡنَ
transliteration: Aoothu billahi an akoona minal jahileen
translation: I seek refuge in Allah from being among the ignorant.
search: For protection from ignorance For protection from ignorance اَعُوۡذُ بِاللّٰہِ اَنۡ اَکُوۡنَ مِنَ الۡجٰہِلِیۡنَ Aoothu billahi an akoona minal jahileen I seek refuge in Allah from being among the ignorant. Surah Al-Baqarah - 2:67

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَضِلَّ أَوْ أُضَلَّ أَوْ أَزِلَّ أَوْ أُزَلَّ أَوْ أَظْلِمَ أَوْ أُظْلَمَ أَوْ أَجْهَلَ أَوْ يُجْهَلَ عَلَىَّ
transliteration: Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika an adilla aw odal, aw azilla aw ozall, aw athlima aw othlam, aw ajhala aw yujhala AAalay.
translation: O Allah, I take refuge with You lest I should stray or be led astray, or slip or be tripped, or oppress or be oppressed, or behave foolishly or be treated foolishly.’ slip: i.e. to commit a sin unintentionally
search: Protection from foolishness Protection from foolishness اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَضِلَّ أَوْ أُضَلَّ أَوْ أَزِلَّ أَوْ أُزَلَّ أَوْ أَظْلِمَ أَوْ أُظْلَمَ أَوْ أَجْهَلَ أَوْ يُجْهَلَ عَلَىَّ Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika an adilla aw odal, aw azilla aw ozall, aw athlima aw othlam, aw ajhala aw yujhala AAalay. O Allah, I take refuge with You lest I should stray or be led astray, or slip or be tripped, or oppress or be oppressed, or behave foolishly or be treated foolishly.’ slip: i.e. to commit a sin unintentionally Abu Dawud: 5094

arabic: رَبَّنَاۤ اِنَّنَاۤ اٰمَنَّا فَاغۡفِرۡ لَنَا ذُنُوۡبَنَا وَ قِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
transliteration: Rabbana innana amanna faghfir lana dhunuubana wa qinna ‘adhaban-Naar
translation: Our Lord! We have indeed believed, so forgive us our sins and save us from the punishment of the Fire.

arabic: رَبَّنَا وَسِعۡتَ کُلَّ شَیۡءٍ رَّحۡمَۃً وَّ عِلۡمًا فَاغۡفِرۡ لِلَّذِیۡنَ تَابُوۡا وَ اتَّبَعُوۡا سَبِیۡلَکَ وَ قِہِمۡ عَذَابَ الۡجَحِیۡمِ
transliteration: Rabbana wasi’ta kulla sha’ir Rahmatanw wa ‘ilman faghfir lilladhina tabu wattaba’u sabilaka waqihim ‘adhabal-Jahiim
translation: Our Lord, You have encompassed all things in mercy and knowledge, so forgive those who have repented and followed Your way and protect them from the punishment of Hellfire.
search: Seek forgiveness and protection from hell Seek forgiveness and protection from hell رَبَّنَا وَسِعۡتَ کُلَّ شَیۡءٍ رَّحۡمَۃً وَّ عِلۡمًا فَاغۡفِرۡ لِلَّذِیۡنَ تَابُوۡا وَ اتَّبَعُوۡا سَبِیۡلَکَ وَ قِہِمۡ عَذَابَ الۡجَحِیۡمِ Rabbana wasi’ta kulla sha’ir Rahmatanw wa ‘ilman faghfir lilladhina tabu wattaba’u sabilaka waqihim ‘adhabal-Jahiim Our Lord, You have encompassed all things in mercy and knowledge, so forgive those who have repented and followed Your way and protect them from the punishment of Hellfire. Surah Ghafir - 40:7

arabic: رَبَّنَا مَا خَلَقۡتَ ہٰذَا بَاطِلًا ۚ سُبۡحٰنَکَ فَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ، رَبَّنَاۤ اِنَّکَ مَنۡ تُدۡخِلِ النَّارَ فَقَدۡ اَخۡزَیۡتَہٗ، وَ مَا لِلظّٰلِمِیۡنَ مِنۡ اَنۡصَارٍ، رَبَّنَاۤ اِنَّنَا سَمِعۡنَا مُنَادِیًا یُّنَادِیۡ لِلۡاِیۡمَانِ اَنۡ اٰمِنُوۡا بِرَبِّکُمۡ فَاٰمَنَّا ٭ۖ رَبَّنَا فَاغۡفِرۡ لَنَا ذُنُوۡبَنَا وَ کَفِّرۡ عَنَّا سَیِّاٰتِنَا وَ تَوَفَّنَا مَعَ الۡاَبۡرَارِ، رَبَّنَا وَ اٰتِنَا مَا وَعَدۡتَّنَا عَلٰی رُسُلِکَ وَ لَا تُخۡزِنَا یَوۡمَ الۡقِیٰمَۃِ، اِنَّکَ لَا تُخۡلِفُ الۡمِیۡعَادَ
transliteration: Rabbana ma khalaqta hadha batila Subhanaka faqina ‘adhaban-Naar. Rabbana innaka man tudkhilin nara faqad akhzaytah wa ma liDh-dhalimeena min ansar. Rabbanaa Innanaa Sami’-Naa Munaadiyay Yunaadee Lil – Eemaani An Aaminoo Birabbikum Fa- Aamannaa Rabbanaa Faghfir Lanaa D’unoobanaa Wa Kaffir A’nnaaa Sayyi- Aatinaa Wa Tawaffanaa Ma-A’l Abraaar. Rabbanaa Wa Aatinaa Maa Wa-A’ttanaa A’laa Rusulika Wa Laa Tukhzinaa Yawal Qiyaamah Innak Laa Tukhliful Mee’a’ad.
translation: Our Lord! You have not created (all) this without purpose, glory to You! (Exalted be You above all that they associate with You as partners). Give us salvation from the torment of the Fire. *Our Lord! Verily, whom You admit to the Fire, indeed, You have disgraced him, and never will the Zaalimoon (polytheists and wrong-doers) find any helpers. *Our Lord! Verily, we have heard the call of one (Muhammad p.b.u.h.) calling to Faith: ‘Believe in your Lord,’ and we have believed. *Our Lord! Forgive us our sins and remit from us our evil deeds, and make us die in the state of righteousness along with Al-Abraar (those who are obedient to Allah and follow strictly His Orders). *Our Lord! Grant us what You promised unto us through Your Messengers and disgrace us not on the Day of Resurrection, for You never break (Your) Promise.

arabic: رَبَّنَا اصۡرِفۡ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَہَنَّمَ ٭ۖ اِنَّ عَذَابَہَا کَانَ غَرَامًا، اِنَّہَا سَآءَتۡ مُسۡتَقَرًّا وَّ مُقَامًا
transliteration: Rabbanas-rif ‘anna ‘adhaba jahannama inna ‘adhabaha kana gharama innaha sa’at musta-qarranw wa muqama
translation: Our Lord! Avert from us the Wrath of Hell, for its Wrath is indeed an affliction grievous,- Evil indeed is it as an abode, and as a place to rest in.
search: For Jannah For Jannah رَبَّنَا اصۡرِفۡ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَہَنَّمَ ٭ۖ اِنَّ عَذَابَہَا کَانَ غَرَامًا، اِنَّہَا سَآءَتۡ مُسۡتَقَرًّا وَّ مُقَامًا Rabbanas-rif ‘anna ‘adhaba jahannama inna ‘adhabaha kana gharama innaha sa’at musta-qarranw wa muqama Our Lord! Avert from us the Wrath of Hell, for its Wrath is indeed an affliction grievous,- Evil indeed is it as an abode, and as a place to rest in. Surah Al-Furqan - 25:65-66

arabic: رَبَّنَا وَ اَدۡخِلۡہُمۡ جَنّٰتِ عَدۡنِۣ الَّتِیۡ وَعَدۡتَّہُمۡ وَ مَنۡ صَلَحَ مِنۡ اٰبَآئِہِمۡ وَ اَزۡوَاجِہِمۡ وَ ذُرِّیّٰتِہِمۡ، اِنَّکَ اَنۡتَ الۡعَزِیۡزُ الۡحَکِیۡمُ وَ قِہِمُ السَّیِّاٰتِ وَ مَنۡ تَقِ السَّیِّاٰتِ یَوۡمَئِذٍ فَقَدۡ رَحِمۡتَہٗ وَ ذٰلِکَ ہُوَ الۡفَوۡزُ الۡعَظِیۡمُ
transliteration: Rabbana wa adhkhilhum Jannati ‘adninil-lati wa’attahum wa man salaha min aba’ihim wa azwajihim wa dhuriyyatihim innaka antal ‘Azizul-Hakim, waqihimus sayyi’at wa man taqis-sayyi’ati yawma’idhin faqad rahimatahu wa dhalika huwal fawzul-’Adheem
translation: Our Lord! And make them enter the ‘Adn (Eden) Paradise (everlasting Gardens) which you have promised them, and to the righteous among their fathers, their wives, and their offspring! Verily, You are the All-Mighty, the All-Wise. And save them from (the punishment, because of what they did of) the sins, and whomsoever You save from (the punishment, because of what they did of) the sins (i.e. excuse them) that Day, him verily, You have taken into mercy.’ And that is the supreme success.’

arabic: لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ، إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ وَالنِّعْمَةَ لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ، لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ
transliteration: Labbayk Allaahumma labbayk, labbayk laa shareeka laka labbayk, ‘innal-hamda, wanni’mata, laka walmulk, laa shareeka laka.
translation: Ever at Your service, O Allah, every at Your service. Ever at Your Service, You have no partner, ever at Your service. Verily all praise, blessings and dominions are Yours. You have no partner.
search: Talbiyah Talbiyah لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ، إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ وَالنِّعْمَةَ لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ، لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ Labbayk Allaahumma labbayk, labbayk laa shareeka laka labbayk, ‘innal-hamda, wanni’mata, laka walmulk, laa shareeka laka. Ever at Your service, O Allah, every at Your service. Ever at Your Service, You have no partner, ever at Your service. Verily all praise, blessings and dominions are Yours. You have no partner. Sahih Muslim: 1218 (a)

category: Takbeer when passing the black stone
categoryEn: Takbeer when passing the black stone
arabic: اَللّٰہُ اَکۡبَرُ
transliteration: Allahu Akbar
translation: Allah is the Most Great!
benefits: Say Takbeer every time you pass the Black Stone. The Prophet (SAW) performed At-Tawaaf riding a camel. Every time he passed the corner (containing the Black Stone), he would point to it with something that he was holding and say Allahu Akbar.
search: Takbeer when passing the black stone Takbeer when passing the black stone اَللّٰہُ اَکۡبَرُ Allahu Akbar Allah is the Most Great! Sahih Al-Bukhari: 1613 Say Takbeer every time you pass the Black Stone. The Prophet (SAW) performed At-Tawaaf riding a camel. Every time he passed the corner (containing the Black Stone), he would point to it with something that he was holding and say Allahu Akbar.
benefitsAr: كبر في كل مرة تمر فيها بالحجر الأسود. وقد طاف النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم على الجمل. وكان كلما مر على الركن الذي فيه الحجر الأسود أشار إليه بشيء في يده وكبر.

category: Upon reaching the Yemeni corner during Tawaf
categoryEn: Upon reaching the Yemeni corner during Tawaf
arabic: رَبَّنَاۤ اٰتِنَا فِی الدُّنۡیَا حَسَنَۃً وَّ فِی الۡاٰخِرَۃِ حَسَنَۃً وَّ قِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
transliteration: Rabbanaaa Aatinaa Fiddunyaa H’asanah Wa Fil Aakhirati H’asanah Wa Qinaa A’d’aaban Naar
translation: Our Lord! Give us in this world that which is good and in the Hereafter that which is good, and save us from the torment of the Fire!
benefits: Messenger of Allah (S.A.W.) used to say between the two corners (between Yemani Corner and Black Stone) of Kaaba during Tawaf.
search: Upon reaching the Yemeni corner during Tawaf Upon reaching the Yemeni corner during Tawaf رَبَّنَاۤ اٰتِنَا فِی الدُّنۡیَا حَسَنَۃً وَّ فِی الۡاٰخِرَۃِ حَسَنَۃً وَّ قِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ Rabbanaaa Aatinaa Fiddunyaa H’asanah Wa Fil Aakhirati H’asanah Wa Qinaa A’d’aaban Naar Our Lord! Give us in this world that which is good and in the Hereafter that which is good, and save us from the torment of the Fire! Abu Dawud: 1892 Messenger of Allah (S.A.W.) used to say between the two corners (between Yemani Corner and Black Stone) of Kaaba during Tawaf.
categoryAr: عند الوصول إلى الركن اليماني أثناء الطواف
benefitsAr: كان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول بين الركنين (بين الركن اليماني والحجر الأسود) للكعبة أثناء الطواف.

category: When at Mount Safa and Mount Marwah
categoryEn: When at Mount Safa and Mount Marwah
arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كَلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ أَنْجَزَ وَعْدَهُ وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ وَهَزَمَ الأَحْزَابَ وَحْدَهُ
transliteration: laa ilaaha ill-allaahu waḥdahu laa shareeka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamdu wa huwa ‛alaa kulli shay’in qadeer, laa ilaaha ill-allaahu waḥdahu, anjaza wa‛dahu, wa naṣara ‛abdahu, wa hazam-al-’aḥzaaba waḥdah
translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things omnipotent. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone. He fulfilled His promise, aided His Servant and single-handedly defeated the allies.
benefits: Recite this at Mount Safa and Mount Marwah. Whenever the Prophet (SAW) approached Mount Safa, he would recite: Innas-Safaa wal-Marwata ... Then he started to climb Mount Safa until he could see the House. He then faced the Qiblah repeating these words: Laa 'ilaaha 'illallaah, Allaahu 'Akbar Then he said: Laa 'ilaaha 'illallaahu wahdahu ... And then he would ask Allah for what he liked, repeating the same thing like this three times. He did this at Mount Marwah as well.

benefitsAr: كانت له عدل عشر رقاب، وكتبت له مئة حسنة، ومحيت عنه مئة سيئة، وكانت له حرزا من الشيطان.

arabic: اَللّٰہُ اَکۡبَرُ، اَللّٰہُ اَحَدٌ، لَّاۤ اِلٰہَ اِلَّاۤ اللّٰہُ
transliteration: Allaahu ‘Akbar, Allaahu ‘Ahad, Laa ‘ilaaha ‘illallaah
translation: Allah is the Most Great. Allah is One. There is none worthy of worship but Allah.
benefits: Recite this once you reach Al-Mash'ar Al-Haraam (Muzdalifah). The Prophet (SAW) rode his camel, Al-Qaswa', until he reached the sacred area (Al-Mash'ar Al-Haraam). Then he faced the Qiblah and invoked Allah, and repeatedly said these words!
search: For reciting at Al-Mash'ar Al-Haraam (Muzdalifah) For reciting at Al-Mash'ar Al-Haraam (Muzdalifah) اَللّٰہُ اَکۡبَرُ، اَللّٰہُ اَحَدٌ، لَّاۤ اِلٰہَ اِلَّاۤ اللّٰہُ Allaahu ‘Akbar, Allaahu ‘Ahad, Laa ‘ilaaha ‘illallaah Allah is the Most Great. Allah is One. There is none worthy of worship but Allah. Sahih Muslim: 1218 (a) Recite this once you reach Al-Mash'ar Al-Haraam (Muzdalifah). The Prophet (SAW) rode his camel, Al-Qaswa', until he reached the sacred area (Al-Mash'ar Al-Haraam). Then he faced the Qiblah and invoked Allah, and repeatedly said these words!
benefitsAr: اقرأ هذا عندما تصل إلى المشعر الحرام (مزدلفة). فركب النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ناقته القصواء حتى وصل إلى المشعر الحرام. ثم استقبل القبلة ودعا الله وكرر هذه الكلمات!

arabic: اَللّٰہُ اَکۡبَرُ
transliteration: Allahu Akbar
translation: Allah is the Most Great!
benefits: Recite this Dua when throwing stones at Satan during Hajj! Every time the Prophet (SAW) threw stone at any of the jamaraat, he would say Allahu Akbar. On the completion of first & second Jamaraat, he went forward, stood facing the Qiblah, raised his hands and made duas.
search: When throwing stones at Jamaraat When throwing stones at Jamaraat اَللّٰہُ اَکۡبَرُ Allahu Akbar Allah is the Most Great! Sahih Al-Bukhari: 1753 Recite this Dua when throwing stones at Satan during Hajj! Every time the Prophet (SAW) threw stone at any of the jamaraat, he would say Allahu Akbar. On the completion of first & second Jamaraat, he went forward, stood facing the Qiblah, raised his hands and made duas.
benefitsAr: اقرأ هذا الدعاء عند رمي الجمرات على الشيطان في الحج! وكان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم إذا رمى شيئاً من الجمار كبر. ولما قضى الجمار الأولى والثانية تقدم ووقف مستقبل القبلة ورفع يديه ودعا.

arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللّٰهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
transliteration: Laa ilaaha ill-allaahu, waḥdahu laa shareeka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamdu, wa huwa ‛alaa kulli shay’in qadeer
translation: None has the right to be worshiped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs sovereignty and all praise and He is over all things omnipotent.
benefits: Recite this dua at Arafat. The Prophet (SAW) said: The best of duas id the dua on the Day of Arafat and the best that anyone can say is what I and the Prophets before me have said
search: At Arafat At Arafat لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللّٰهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ Laa ilaaha ill-allaahu, waḥdahu laa shareeka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamdu, wa huwa ‛alaa kulli shay’in qadeer None has the right to be worshiped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs sovereignty and all praise and He is over all things omnipotent. At-Tirmidhi: 3585 Recite this dua at Arafat. The Prophet (SAW) said: The best of duas id the dua on the Day of Arafat and the best that anyone can say is what I and the Prophets before me have said
benefitsAr: اقرءوا هذا الدعاء على عرفات. قال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم: أفضل الدعاء يوم عرفة وخير ما يقول أحد ما قلت أنا والنبيون من قبلي.

arabic: بِسْمِ اللّٰہِ، اَللّٰہُ اَکۡبَرُ
transliteration: Bismillaahi, Allaahu ‘Akbar
translation: With the Name of Allah, Allah is the Most Great
search: When sacrificing an animal When sacrificing an animal بِسْمِ اللّٰہِ، اَللّٰہُ اَکۡبَرُ Bismillaahi, Allaahu ‘Akbar With the Name of Allah, Allah is the Most Great Sahih Muslim: 1966

arabic: اِنَّ الصَّفَا وَ الۡمَرۡوَۃَ مِنۡ شَعَآئِرِ اللّٰہِ
transliteration: Inna alssafa waalmarwata min shaAAairi Allah
translation: Indeed, as-Safa and al-Marwah are among the symbols of Allah.
search: While going to Mount Safa While going to Mount Safa اِنَّ الصَّفَا وَ الۡمَرۡوَۃَ مِنۡ شَعَآئِرِ اللّٰہِ Inna alssafa waalmarwata min shaAAairi Allah Indeed, as-Safa and al-Marwah are among the symbols of Allah. Surah Al-Baqarah - 2:158, Sahih Muslim: 1218 (a)

category: On the sighting of the crescent moon
categoryEn: On the sighting of the crescent moon
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَهْلِلْهُ عَلَيْنَا بِالْيُمْنِ وَالإِيمَانِ وَالسَّلاَمَةِ وَالإِسْلاَمِ رَبِّي وَرَبُّكَ اللّٰهُ
transliteration: Allahumma ahlilhu `alaina bil-yumni wal-iman, wassalamati wal-Islam, rabbi wa rabbuk Allah
translation: O Allah, bring it over us with blessing and faith, and security and Islam. My Lord and your Lord is Allah
search: On the sighting of the crescent moon On the sighting of the crescent moon اللَّهُمَّ أَهْلِلْهُ عَلَيْنَا بِالْيُمْنِ وَالإِيمَانِ وَالسَّلاَمَةِ وَالإِسْلاَمِ رَبِّي وَرَبُّكَ اللّٰهُ Allahumma ahlilhu `alaina bil-yumni wal-iman, wassalamati wal-Islam, rabbi wa rabbuk Allah O Allah, bring it over us with blessing and faith, and security and Islam. My Lord and your Lord is Allah At-Tirmidhi: 3451

category: For the night of destiny (Lailatul Qadr)
categoryEn: For the night of destiny (Lailatul Qadr)
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ كَرِيمٌ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
transliteration: Allahumma innaka Afuwwun [Karimun ] tuhibbul `afwa fa`fu `annee
translation: O Allah, indeed You are Pardoning, [Generous,] You love pardon, so pardon me
benefits: Recite this Dua on Laylatul Qadr! Aisha, may Allah be pleased with her, said: I asked the Messenger of Allah: 'O Messenger of Allah, if I know what night is the night of Qadr, what should I say during it?' Prophet (PBUH) recited this dua.
search: For the night of destiny (Lailatul Qadr) For the night of destiny (Lailatul Qadr) اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ كَرِيمٌ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي Allahumma innaka Afuwwun [Karimun ] tuhibbul `afwa fa`fu `annee O Allah, indeed You are Pardoning, [Generous,] You love pardon, so pardon me At-Tirmidhi: 3513 Recite this Dua on Laylatul Qadr! Aisha, may Allah be pleased with her, said: I asked the Messenger of Allah: 'O Messenger of Allah, if I know what night is the night of Qadr, what should I say during it?' Prophet (PBUH) recited this dua.
benefitsAr: إقرأوا هذا الدعاء في ليلة القدر! قالت عائشة رضي الله عنها: سألت رسول الله: يا رسول الله، أرأيت إن علمت أي ليلة هي ليلة القدر ما أقول فيها؟ وقد قرأ النبي (ص) هذا الدعاء.

arabic: إِنَّ لِلّٰهِ مَا أَخَذَ وَلَهُ مَا أَعْطَى وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍ عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ بِأَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى فَلْتَصْبِرْ وَلْتَحْتَسِبْ
transliteration: Inna lillaahi maa ‘akhatha, wa lahu maa ‘a’taa, wa kullu shay’in ‘inda’llahi bi’ajalin musamman. Faltasbir waltahtasib
translation: Surely, Allah takes what is His, and what He gives is His, and to all things He has appointed a time. So, have patience and be rewarded.
search: When offering condolence When offering condolence إِنَّ لِلّٰهِ مَا أَخَذَ وَلَهُ مَا أَعْطَى وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍ عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ بِأَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى فَلْتَصْبِرْ وَلْتَحْتَسِبْ Inna lillaahi maa ‘akhatha, wa lahu maa ‘a’taa, wa kullu shay’in ‘inda’llahi bi’ajalin musamman. Faltasbir waltahtasib Surely, Allah takes what is His, and what He gives is His, and to all things He has appointed a time. So, have patience and be rewarded. An-Nasai: 1869

categoryEn: When closing the eyes of the deceased
arabic: اللَّهمَّ اغْفِرْ لِفُلانٍ (باسْمِهِ)، وارْفَعْ دَرَجَتهُ فِي الـمَهْدِيِّيْنَ، واخْلُفْهُ فِي عَقِبِهِ فِي الغَابِريْنَ، واغْفِرْ لَـنَا ولَهُ يَا رَبَّ العَالَـمِيْنَ، وافْسَحْ لَهُ فِي قَبْرِهِ وَنَوِّرْ لَهُ فِيْهِ
transliteration: Allaahummaghfir li (name of the deceased person) warfa’ darajatahu fil-mahdiyyeena, wakhlufhu fee ‘aqibihi fil-ghaabireena, waghfir-lanaa wa lahu yaa Rabbal-’aalameena, wafsah lahu fee qabrihi wa nawwir lahu feehi
translation: O Allah, forgive [name of the deceased person] and elevate his station among those who are guided. Send him along the path of those who came before, and forgive us and him, O Lord of the worlds. Enlarge for him his grave and shed light upon him in it.
search: When closing the eyes of the deceased When closing the eyes of the deceased اللَّهمَّ اغْفِرْ لِفُلانٍ (باسْمِهِ)، وارْفَعْ دَرَجَتهُ فِي الـمَهْدِيِّيْنَ، واخْلُفْهُ فِي عَقِبِهِ فِي الغَابِريْنَ، واغْفِرْ لَـنَا ولَهُ يَا رَبَّ العَالَـمِيْنَ، وافْسَحْ لَهُ فِي قَبْرِهِ وَنَوِّرْ لَهُ فِيْهِ Allaahummaghfir li (name of the deceased person) warfa’ darajatahu fil-mahdiyyeena, wakhlufhu fee ‘aqibihi fil-ghaabireena, waghfir-lanaa wa lahu yaa Rabbal-’aalameena, wafsah lahu fee qabrihi wa nawwir lahu feehi O Allah, forgive [name of the deceased person] and elevate his station among those who are guided. Send him along the path of those who came before, and forgive us and him, O Lord of the worlds. Enlarge for him his grave and shed light upon him in it. Sahih Muslim: 920 (a)

category: For the deceased at the funeral prayer
categoryEn: For the deceased at the funeral prayer
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ وَعَافِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنْهُ وَأَكْرِمْ نُزُلَهُ وَوَسِّعْ مُدْخَلَهُ وَاغْسِلْهُ بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ وَنَقِّهِ مِنَ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا نَقَّيْتَ الثَّوْبَ الأَبْيَضَ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ وَأَبْدِلْهُ دَارًا خَيْرًا مِنْ دَارِهِ وَأَهْلاً خَيْرًا مِنْ أَهْلِهِ وَزَوْجًا خَيْرًا مِنْ زَوْجِهِ وَأَدْخِلْهُ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعِذْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ أَوْ مِنْ عَذَابِ النَّارِ
transliteration: Allaahum-maghfir lahu warhamhu, wa ‘aafihi, wa’fu ‘anhu, wa ‘akrim nuzulahu, wa wassi’ mudkhalahu, waghsilhu bilmaa’i waththalji walbaradi, wa naqqihi minal-khataayaa kamaa naqqaytath-thawbal-’abyadha minad-danasi, wa ‘abdilhu daaran khayran min daarihi, wa ‘ahlan khayran min ‘ahlihi, wa zawjan khayran min zawjihi, wa ‘adkhilhul-jannata, wa. ‘a’ithhu min ‘athaabil-qabri[wa ‘athaabin-naar]
translation: O Allah, forgive him and have mercy on him and give him strength and pardon him. Be generous to him and cause his entrance to be wide and wash him with water and snow and hail. Cleanse him of his transgressions as white cloth is cleansed of stains. Give him an abode better than his home, and a family better than his family and a wife better than his wife. Take him into Paradise and protect him from the punishment of the grave [and from the punishment of Hell-fire].

Give him an abode better than his home, and a family better than his family and a wife better than his wife. Take him into Paradise and protect him from the punishment of the grave [and from the punishment of Hell-fire]. Sahih Muslim: 963

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِحَيِّنَا وَمَيِّتِنَا وَشَاهِدِنَا وَغَائِبِنَا وَصَغِيرِنَا وَكَبِيرِنَا وَذَكَرِنَا وَأُنْثَانَا اللَّهُمَّ مَنْ أَحْيَيْتَهُ مِنَّا فَأَحْيِهِ عَلَى الإِسْلاَمِ وَمَنْ تَوَفَّيْتَهُ مِنَّا فَتَوَفَّهُ عَلَى الإِيمَانِ اللَّهُمَّ لاَ تَحْرِمْنَا أَجْرَهُ وَلاَ تُضِلَّنَا بَعْدَهُ
transliteration: Allaahum-maghfir lihayyinaa, wa mayyitinaa, wa shaahidinaa, wa ghaa’ibinaa, wa sagheerinaa wa kabeerinaa, wa thakarinaa wa ‘unthaanaa. Allaahumma man ‘ahyaytahu minnaa fa’ahyihi ‘alal-’Islaami, wa man tawaffaytahu minnaa fatawaffahu ‘alal-’eemaani, Allaahumma laa tahrimnaa ‘ajrahu wa laa tudhillanaa ba’dahu
translation: O Allah forgive our living and our dead, those who are with us and those who are absent, our young and our old, our menfolk and our womenfolk. O Allah, whomever you give life from among us give him life in Islam, and whomever you take way from us take him away in Faith. O Allah, do not forbid us their reward and do not send us astray after them.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ {فُلاَنَ بْنَ فُلاَنٍ} فِي ذِمَّتِكَ وَحَبْلِ جِوَارِكَ فَقِهِ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْقَبْرِ وَعَذَابِ النَّارِ وَأَنْتَ أَهْلُ الْوَفَاءِ وَالْحَقِّ فَاغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
transliteration: Allaahumma ‘inna [name the person] fee thimmatika, wa habli jiwaarika, faqihi min fitnatil-qabri wa ‘athaabin-naari, wa ‘Anta ‘ahlul-wafaa’i walhaqqi. Faghfir lahu warhaw.hu ‘innaka ‘Antal-Ghafoorur-Raheem
translation: O Allah, surely [name the person] is under Your protection, and in the rope of Your security, so save him from the trial of the grave and from the punishment of the Fire. You fulfill promises and grant rights, so forgive him and have mercy on him. Surely You are Most Forgiving, Most Merciful.

translation: With the Name of Allah and according to the Sunnah of the Messenger of Allah

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اسْقِنَا غَيْثًا مُغِيثًا مَرِيئًا مَرِيعاً نَافِعًا غَيْرَ ضَارٍّ عَاجِلاً غَيْرَ آجِلٍ
transliteration: Allaahumma ‘asqinaa ghaythan mugheethan maree’an muree’an, naafi’an ghayra dhaarrin, ‘aajilan ghayra ‘aajilin.
translation: O Allah! give us rain which will replenish us, abundant, fertilising and profitable, not injurious, granting it now without delayd not delayed.
search: For rain For rain اللَّهُمَّ اسْقِنَا غَيْثًا مُغِيثًا مَرِيئًا مَرِيعاً نَافِعًا غَيْرَ ضَارٍّ عَاجِلاً غَيْرَ آجِلٍ Allaahumma ‘asqinaa ghaythan mugheethan maree’an muree’an, naafi’an ghayra dhaarrin, ‘aajilan ghayra ‘aajilin. O Allah! give us rain which will replenish us, abundant, fertilising and profitable, not injurious, granting it now without delayd not delayed. Abu Dawud: 1169

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ صَيِّبًا نَافِعًا
transliteration: Allahummaj’alhu Sayyiban nafi`a
translation: O Allah, make it beneficial rain.
search: When it rains When it rains اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ صَيِّبًا نَافِعًا Allahummaj’alhu Sayyiban nafi`a O Allah, make it beneficial rain. An-Nasai: 1523

arabic: مُطِرْنَا بِفَضْلِ اللّٰهِ وَرَحْمَتِهِ
transliteration: Mutirnaa bifadhlillaahi wa rahmatihi.
translation: We have been given rain by the grace and mercy of Allah.
search: After rainfall After rainfall مُطِرْنَا بِفَضْلِ اللّٰهِ وَرَحْمَتِهِ Mutirnaa bifadhlillaahi wa rahmatihi. We have been given rain by the grace and mercy of Allah. Sahih Muslim: 71

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ حَوَالَيْنَا وَلاَ عَلَيْنَا، اللَّهُمَّ عَلَى الآكَامِ وَالظِّرَابِ وَبُطُونِ الأَوْدِيَةِ وَمَنَابِتِ الشَّجَر
transliteration: Allaahumma hawaalaynaa wa laa ‘alaynaa. Allaahumma ‘alal-’aakaami wadh-dhiraabi, wa butoonil-’awdiyati, wa manaabitish-shajari
translation: O Allah, let it pass us and not fall upon us, but upon the hills and mountains, and the center of the valleys, and upon the forested lands.
search: When there is excessive rain When there is excessive rain اللَّهُمَّ حَوَالَيْنَا وَلاَ عَلَيْنَا، اللَّهُمَّ عَلَى الآكَامِ وَالظِّرَابِ وَبُطُونِ الأَوْدِيَةِ وَمَنَابِتِ الشَّجَر Allaahumma hawaalaynaa wa laa ‘alaynaa. Allaahumma ‘alal-’aakaami wadh-dhiraabi, wa butoonil-’awdiyati, wa manaabitish-shajari O Allah, let it pass us and not fall upon us, but upon the hills and mountains, and the center of the valleys, and upon the forested lands. Sahih Al-Bukhari: 1014

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا تَقْتُلْنَا بِغَضَبِكَ وَلَا تُهْلِكْنَا بِعَذَابِكَ وَعَافِنَا قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ
transliteration: Allahumma la taqtulna bi-ghadabika wa la tuhlikna bi-`adhabika wa `afina qabla dhalik
translation: O Allah, do not kill us with Your wrath, and do not destroy us with Your punishment, and pardon us before that.
search: Upon hearing thunder Upon hearing thunder اللَّهُمَّ لَا تَقْتُلْنَا بِغَضَبِكَ وَلَا تُهْلِكْنَا بِعَذَابِكَ وَعَافِنَا قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ Allahumma la taqtulna bi-ghadabika wa la tuhlikna bi-`adhabika wa `afina qabla dhalik O Allah, do not kill us with Your wrath, and do not destroy us with Your punishment, and pardon us before that. At-Tirmidhi: 3450

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِهَا وَخَيْرِ مَا فِيهَا وَخَيْرِ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا وَشَرِّ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ
transliteration: Allahumma inniias’aluka min khairiha wa khairi ma fiha, wa khairi ma ursilat bihi, wa aaudhu bika min sharriha wa sharri ma fiha, wa sharri ma ursilat bih
translation: O Allah, indeed, I ask You for its good, the good of what is in it, and the good of what it has been sent with. And I seek refuge in You from its evil, the evil of what is in it, and the evil of what it has been sent with.
search: During a windstorm During a windstorm اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِهَا وَخَيْرِ مَا فِيهَا وَخَيْرِ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا وَشَرِّ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ Allahumma inniias’aluka min khairiha wa khairi ma fiha, wa khairi ma ursilat bihi, wa aaudhu bika min sharriha wa sharri ma fiha, wa sharri ma ursilat bih O Allah, indeed, I ask You for its good, the good of what is in it, and the good of what it has been sent with. And I seek refuge in You from its evil, the evil of what is in it, and the evil of what it has been sent with. At-Tirmidhi: 3449

arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللّٰهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
transliteration: Assalamu ‘alaikum wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuh
translation: May the peace, mercy, and blessings of Allah be upon you
search: For greeting people For greeting people السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللّٰهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ Assalamu ‘alaikum wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuh May the peace, mercy, and blessings of Allah be upon you Sunnah of Prophet (S.A.W.)

arabic: وَعَلَيْكُمُ السَّلاَمُ وَرَحْمَةُ اللّٰهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
transliteration: Wa’alaikum assalam wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuh
translation: Peace and mercy and blessings of Allah be upon you
search: When responding to Salam When responding to Salam وَعَلَيْكُمُ السَّلاَمُ وَرَحْمَةُ اللّٰهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ Wa’alaikum assalam wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuh Peace and mercy and blessings of Allah be upon you Sunnah of Prophet (S.A.W.)

arabic: جَزَاكَ اللّٰهُ خَيْرًا
transliteration: Jazaakallaahu khayran
translation: May Allah reward you with good.
search: For thanking someone For thanking someone جَزَاكَ اللّٰهُ خَيْرًا Jazaakallaahu khayran May Allah reward you with good. At-Tirmidhi: 2035

arabic: اَلۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰہِ
transliteration: Alhamdu lillaahi
translation: All praise is for Allah.
search: Upon sneezing Upon sneezing اَلۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰہِ Alhamdu lillaahi All praise is for Allah. Abu Dawud: 5033

arabic: يَرْحَمُكَ اللّٰهُ
transliteration: Yar hamu kal-laahu.
translation: May Allah have mercy upon you
search: Upon hearing someone sneeze Upon hearing someone sneeze يَرْحَمُكَ اللّٰهُ Yar hamu kal-laahu. May Allah have mercy upon you Abu Dawud: 5033

arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لَا يَمُوتُ بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٍ
transliteration: Laa ilaaha illallaahu wahdahu laa shareeka lahu, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu, yuhyee wa yumeetu, wa Huwa hayyun laa yamootu, biyadihil-khayru, wa Huwa alaa kulli shayin Qadeer.
translation: There is no Lord except Allah. He is One and has no partners. His is the Kingdom and for Him are all praises. He gives life and gives death. He is eternal and everlasting In His control is goodness, and He has power over everything.
search: When entering the marketplace When entering the marketplace لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لَا يَمُوتُ بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٍ Laa ilaaha illallaahu wahdahu laa shareeka lahu, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu, yuhyee wa yumeetu, wa Huwa hayyun laa yamootu, biyadihil-khayru, wa Huwa alaa kulli shayin Qadeer. There is no Lord except Allah. He is One and has no partners. His is the Kingdom and for Him are all praises. He gives life and gives death. He is eternal and everlasting In His control is goodness, and He has power over everything. At-Tirmidhi: 3428

arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ
transliteration: Subhaanaka Allaahumma wa bihamdika, ‘ash-hadu ‘an laa ‘ilaaha ‘illaa ‘Anta, ‘astaghfiruka wa ‘atoobu ‘ilayka
translation: Glory is to You, O Allah, and praise is to You. I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship but You. I seek Your forgiveness and repent to You.
benefits: Whosoever recites the following dua after sitting in a gathering will be forgiven for whatever wrongs were done by him in that gathering
search: At the end of a Gathering/Majlis At the end of a Gathering/Majlis سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ Subhaanaka Allaahumma wa bihamdika, ‘ash-hadu ‘an laa ‘ilaaha ‘illaa ‘Anta, ‘astaghfiruka wa ‘atoobu ‘ilayka Glory is to You, O Allah, and praise is to You. Abu Dawud: 4859 Whosoever recites the following dua after sitting in a gathering will be forgiven for whatever wrongs were done by him in that gathering
benefitsAr: ومن قرأ هذا الدعاء بعد جلوسه في مجلس غفر له ما كان منه في ذلك المجلس

arabic: يَهْدِيكُمُ اللّٰهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمْ
transliteration: Yahdeekumul-lahu wayuslihu balakum
translation: May Allah guide you and set right your affairs.
search: Sneezers replies back Sneezers replies back يَهْدِيكُمُ اللّٰهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمْ Yahdeekumul-lahu wayuslihu balakum May Allah guide you and set right your affairs. Abu Dawud: 5033

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ وَأَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ،  وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ الْعَظِيمِ،  فَإِنَّكَ تَقْدِرُ وَلاَ أَقْدِرُ وَتَعْلَمُ وَلاَ أَعْلَمُ وَأَنْتَ عَلاَّمُ الْغُيُوبِ،  اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الأَمْرَ خَيْرٌ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي ـ  أَوْ قَالَ عَاجِلِ أَمْرِي وَآجِلِهِ ـ  فَاقْدُرْهُ لِي وَيَسِّرْهُ لِي ثُمَّ بَارِكْ لِي فِيهِ،  وَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الأَمْرَ شَرٌّ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي ـ  أَوْ قَالَ فِي عَاجِلِ أَمْرِي وَآجِلِهِ ـ  فَاصْرِفْهُ عَنِّي وَاصْرِفْنِي عَنْهُ،  وَاقْدُرْ لِي الْخَيْرَ حَيْثُ كَانَ ثُمَّ أَرْضِنِي بِهِ
transliteration: Allaahumma 'innee 'astakheeruka bi'ilmika, wa 'astaqdiruka biqudratika, wa 'as'aluka min fadhtikal-'Adheemi, fa'innaka taqdiru wa laa 'aqdiru, wa ta'lamu, wa laa 'a'lamu, wa 'Anta 'Allaamul-Ghuyoobi, Allaahumma 'in kunta ta'lamu 'anna haathal-'amra-[then mention the thing to be decided] Khayrun lee fee deenee wa ma'aashee wa 'aaqibati 'amree - [or say] 'Aajilihi wa 'aajilihi - Faqdurhu lee wa yassirhu lee thumma baarik lee feehi, wa 'in kunta ta'lamu 'anna haathal-'amra sharrun lee fee deenee wa ma'aashee wa 'aaqibati 'amree - [or say] 'Aajilihi wa 'aajilihi - Fasrifhu 'annee wasrifnee 'anhu waqdur liyal-khayra haythu kaana thumma 'ardhinee bihi
translation: O Allah, I seek the counsel of Your Knowledge, and I seek the help of Your Omnipotence, and I beseech You for Your Magnificent Grace. Surely, You are Capable and I am not. You know and I know not, and You are the Knower of the unseen. O Allah, if You know that this matter [then mention the thing to be decided] is good for me in my religion and in my life and for my welfare in the life to come, - [or say: in this life and the afterlife] - then ordain it for me and make it easy for me, then bless me in it. And if You know that this matter is bad for me in my religion and in my life and for my welfare in the life to come, - [or say: in this life and the afterlife] - then distance it from me, and distance me from it, and ordain for me what is good wherever it may be, and help me to be content with it. Whoever seeks the counsel of the Creator will not regret it and whoever seeks the advice of the believers will feel confident about his decisions. Allah said in the Qur’an: ‘And consult them in the affair. Then when you have taken a decision, put your trust in Allah.’
benefits: Prophet (S.A.W.) said, "If anyone of you thinks of doing any job, he should offer a two rak`at prayer other than the compulsory ones and say this dua (after the prayer)."

arabic: رَبَّنَا افۡتَحۡ بَیۡنَنَا وَ بَیۡنَ قَوۡمِنَا بِالۡحَقِّ وَ اَنۡتَ خَیۡرُ الۡفٰتِحِیۡنَ
transliteration: Rabbanaf-tah baynana wa bayna qawmina bil haqqi wa anta Khayrul Fatiheen
translation: Our Lord! Decide Thou between us and our people in truth, for Thou art the best to decide.
search: Get justice in this world Get justice in this world رَبَّنَا افۡتَحۡ بَیۡنَنَا وَ بَیۡنَ قَوۡمِنَا بِالۡحَقِّ وَ اَنۡتَ خَیۡرُ الۡفٰتِحِیۡنَ Rabbanaf-tah baynana wa bayna qawmina bil haqqi wa anta Khayrul Fatiheen Our Lord! Decide Thou between us and our people in truth, for Thou art the best to decide. Surah Al-A'raf - 7:89
