arabic: اَلۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰہِ الَّذِیۡ ہَدٰىنَا لِہٰذَا ۟ وَ مَا کُنَّا لِنَہۡتَدِیَ لَوۡ لَاۤ اَنۡ ہَدٰىنَا اللّٰہُ
transliteration: Alhamdu lillahi allathee hadaana lihatha wama kunna linahtadiya lawlaa an hadaana Allahu
translation: Praise to Allah, who has guided us to this; and we would never have been guided if Allah had not guided us.
benefits: The people in paradise will ask this dua after they have attained paradise.
search: Seek Allah's guidance Seek Allah's guidance اَلۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰہِ الَّذِیۡ ہَدٰىنَا لِہٰذَا ۟ وَ مَا کُنَّا لِنَہۡتَدِیَ لَوۡ لَاۤ اَنۡ ہَدٰىنَا اللّٰہُ Alhamdu lillahi allathee hadaana lihatha wama kunna linahtadiya lawlaa an hadaana Allahu Praise to Allah, who has guided us to this; and we would never have been guided if Allah had not guided us. Surah Al-A'raf - 7:43 The people in paradise will ask this dua after they have attained paradise.
benefitsAr: سيسأل أهل الجنة هذا الدعاء بعد دخولهم الجنة.

arabic: فَاللّٰہُ خَیۡرٌ حٰفِظًا وَّ ہُوَ اَرۡحَمُ الرّٰحِمِیۡنَ
transliteration: fallahu khayrun hafithan wahuwa arhamu arrahimeen
translation: Allah is the best guardian, and He is the most merciful of the merciful.
benefits: This dua was asked by Prophet Ya'coob (AS). Recite this dua to seek guidance from Allah SWT.
search: Seek Allah's guidance Seek Allah's guidance فَاللّٰہُ خَیۡرٌ حٰفِظًا وَّ ہُوَ اَرۡحَمُ الرّٰحِمِیۡنَ fallahu khayrun hafithan wahuwa arhamu arrahimeen Allah is the best guardian, and He is the most merciful of the merciful. Surah Yusuf - 12:64 This dua was asked by Prophet Ya'coob (AS). Recite this dua to seek guidance from Allah SWT.
benefitsAr: هذا الدعاء سأله النبي يعقوب (ع). اقرأ هذا الدعاء لطلب الهداية من الله سبحانه وتعالى.

arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِنْ نَسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا
transliteration: Rabbana la tu'akhidhna in nasina aw akhta'na
translation: Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we have forgotten or erred.
search: Seeking Forgiveness for Sins Seeking Forgiveness for Sins رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِنْ نَسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا Rabbana la tu'akhidhna in nasina aw akhta'na Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we have forgotten or erred. Surah Al-Baqarah 2:286

arabic: رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِنَا
transliteration: Rabbana wa la tahmil 'alayna isran kama hamaltahu 'alalladhina min qablina
translation: Our Lord, and lay not upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us.
search: Seeking Forgiveness for Sins Seeking Forgiveness for Sins رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِنَا Rabbana wa la tahmil 'alayna isran kama hamaltahu 'alalladhina min qablina Our Lord, and lay not upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us. Surah Al-Baqarah 2:286

arabic: رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا أَنْتَ مَوْلَانَا فَانْصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
transliteration: Rabbana wa la tuhammilna ma la taqata lana bihi wa'fu 'anna waghfir lana warhamna anta mawlana fansurna 'alal-qawmil-kafireen
translation: Our Lord, and burden us not with that which we have no ability to bear. And pardon us; and forgive us; and have mercy upon us. You are our protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people.
search: Seeking Forgiveness for Sins Seeking Forgiveness for Sins رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا أَنْتَ مَوْلَانَا فَانْصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ Rabbana wa la tuhammilna ma la taqata lana bihi wa'fu 'anna waghfir lana warhamna anta mawlana fansurna 'alal-qawmil-kafireen Our Lord, and burden us not with that which we have no ability to bear. And pardon us; and forgive us; and have mercy upon us. You are our protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people. Surah Al-Baqarah 2:286

arabic: رَبَّنَا إِنَّنَا آمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
transliteration: Rabbana innana amanna faghfir lana dhunubana wa qina 'adhaban-nar
translation: Our Lord, indeed we have believed, so forgive us our sins and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
search: Seeking Forgiveness for Sins Seeking Forgiveness for Sins رَبَّنَا إِنَّنَا آمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ Rabbana innana amanna faghfir lana dhunubana wa qina 'adhaban-nar Our Lord, indeed we have believed, so forgive us our sins and protect us from the punishment of the Fire. Surah Al-Imran 3:16

arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَإِسْرَافَنَا فِي أَمْرِنَا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَانصُرْنَا عَلَى القَوْمِ الكَافِرِينَ
transliteration: Rabbanaghfir lana dhunubana wa israfana fi amrina wa thabbit aqdamana wansurna 'alal-qawmil-kafireen
translation: Our Lord, forgive us our sins and our excesses in our affairs, plant firmly our feet, and give us victory over the disbelieving people.
search: Seeking Forgiveness for Sins Seeking Forgiveness for Sins رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَإِسْرَافَنَا فِي أَمْرِنَا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَانصُرْنَا عَلَى القَوْمِ الكَافِرِينَ Rabbanaghfir lana dhunubana wa israfana fi amrina wa thabbit aqdamana wansurna 'alal-qawmil-kafireen Our Lord, forgive us our sins and our excesses in our affairs, plant firmly our feet, and give us victory over the disbelieving people. Surah Al-Imran 3:147

arabic: رَبَّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّئَاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ الْأَبْرَارِ
transliteration: Rabbana faghfir lana dhunubana wa kaffir 'anna sayyi'atina wa tawaffana ma'al-abrar
translation: Our Lord, so forgive us our sins and remove from us our misdeeds and cause us to die with the righteous.
search: Seeking Forgiveness for Sins Seeking Forgiveness for Sins رَبَّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّئَاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ الْأَبْرَارِ Rabbana faghfir lana dhunubana wa kaffir 'anna sayyi'atina wa tawaffana ma'al-abrar Our Lord, so forgive us our sins and remove from us our misdeeds and cause us to die with the righteous. Surah Al-Imran 3:193

arabic: رَبِّ ٱغۡفِرۡلِي وَلِأَخِى وَأَدۡخِلۡنَا فِى رَحۡمَتِكَ‌ وَأَنتَ أَرۡحَمُ ٱلرَّٲحِمِينَ
transliteration: Rabbighfir lee wa li-akhi wa adkhilna fi rahmatika wa anta arhamur-rahimeen
translation: My Lord, forgive me and my brother and admit us into Your mercy, for You are the most merciful of the merciful.
search: Seeking Forgiveness for Sins Seeking Forgiveness for Sins رَبِّ ٱغۡفِرۡلِي وَلِأَخِى وَأَدۡخِلۡنَا فِى رَحۡمَتِكَ‌ وَأَنتَ أَرۡحَمُ ٱلرَّٲحِمِينَ Rabbighfir lee wa li-akhi wa adkhilna fi rahmatika wa anta arhamur-rahimeen My Lord, forgive me and my brother and admit us into Your mercy, for You are the most merciful of the merciful. Surah Al-A'raf 7:151

arabic: رَبَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَا وَٱرۡحَمۡنَا وَأَنتَ خَيۡرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
transliteration: Rabbana amanna faghfir lana warhamna wa anta khayrur-rahimeen
translation: Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us and have mercy upon us, and You are the best of the merciful.
search: Seeking Forgiveness for Sins Seeking Forgiveness for Sins رَبَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَا وَٱرۡحَمۡنَا وَأَنتَ خَيۡرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ Rabbana amanna faghfir lana warhamna wa anta khayrur-rahimeen Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us and have mercy upon us, and You are the best of the merciful. Surah Al-Mu'minun 23:109

arabic: رَّبِّ ٱغۡفِرۡ وَٱرۡحَمۡ وَأَنتَ خَيۡرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
transliteration: Rabbighfir warham wa anta khayrur-rahimeen
translation: My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful.
search: Seeking Forgiveness for Sins Seeking Forgiveness for Sins رَّبِّ ٱغۡفِرۡ وَٱرۡحَمۡ وَأَنتَ خَيۡرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ Rabbighfir warham wa anta khayrur-rahimeen My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful. Surah Al-Mu'minun 23:118

arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِإِخْوَانِنَا الَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِالْإِيمَانِ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ فِي قُلُوبِنَا غِلًّا لِّلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوا
transliteration: Rabbanaghfir lana wa li-ikhwaninalladhina sabaquna bil-eemani wa la taj'al fi qulubina ghillan lilladhina amanu
translation: Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith and put not in our hearts [any] resentment toward those who have believed.
search: Seeking Forgiveness for Sins Seeking Forgiveness for Sins رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِإِخْوَانِنَا الَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِالْإِيمَانِ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ فِي قُلُوبِنَا غِلًّا لِّلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوا Rabbanaghfir lana wa li-ikhwaninalladhina sabaquna bil-eemani wa la taj'al fi qulubina ghillan lilladhina amanu Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith and put not in our hearts [any] resentment toward those who have believed. Surah Al-Hashr 59:10

arabic: رَبَّنَا وَسِعۡتَ كُلَّ شَيۡءٖ رَّحۡمَةٗ وَعِلۡمٗا فَٱغۡفِرۡ لِلَّذِينَ تَابُواْ وَٱتَّبَعُواْ سَبِيلَكَ وَقِهِمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
transliteration: Rabbana wasi'ta kulla shay'in rahmatan wa 'ilman faghfir lilladhina tabu wattaba'u sabeelaka wa qihim 'adhabal-jaheem
translation: Our Lord, You have encompassed all things in mercy and knowledge, so forgive those who have repented and followed Your way and protect them from the punishment of Hellfire.
search: Seeking Forgiveness for Sins Seeking Forgiveness for Sins رَبَّنَا وَسِعۡتَ كُلَّ شَيۡءٖ رَّحۡمَةٗ وَعِلۡمٗا فَٱغۡفِرۡ لِلَّذِينَ تَابُواْ وَٱتَّبَعُواْ سَبِيلَكَ وَقِهِمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ Rabbana wasi'ta kulla shay'in rahmatan wa 'ilman faghfir lilladhina tabu wattaba'u sabeelaka wa qihim 'adhabal-jaheem Our Lord, You have encompassed all things in mercy and knowledge, so forgive those who have repented and followed Your way and protect them from the punishment of Hellfire. Surah Ghafir 40:7

arabic: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
transliteration: Rabbana zhalamna anfusana wa il lam taghfir lana wa tarhamna lanakunanna minal-khasireen
translation: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers.
search: Acknowledging Wrongdoing Acknowledging Wrongdoing رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ Rabbana zhalamna anfusana wa il lam taghfir lana wa tarhamna lanakunanna minal-khasireen Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers. Surah Al-A'raf 7:23

arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمۡتُ نَفۡسِي فَٱغۡفِرۡ لِى فَغَفَرَ لَهُ ۥ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
transliteration: Rabbi inni dhalamtu nafsee faghfir lee faghafara lahu innahu huwal-ghafoorur-raheem
translation: My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, so forgive me, and He forgave him. Indeed, He is the Forgiving, the Merciful.
search: Acknowledging Wrongdoing Acknowledging Wrongdoing رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمۡتُ نَفۡسِي فَٱغۡفِرۡ لِى فَغَفَرَ لَهُ ۥ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ Rabbi inni dhalamtu nafsee faghfir lee faghafara lahu innahu huwal-ghafoorur-raheem My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, so forgive me, and He forgave him. Indeed, He is the Forgiving, the Merciful. Surah Al-Qasas 28:16

arabic: لَّآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبۡحَـٰنَكَ إِنِّى كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
transliteration: La ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minadh-dhalimeen
translation: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.
benefits: This is the dua of Prophet Yunus (AS) when he was in the belly of the whale. The Prophet (SAW) said that no Muslim supplicates with this dua but Allah answers it.
search: Acknowledging Wrongdoing Acknowledging Wrongdoing لَّآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبۡحَـٰنَكَ إِنِّى كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ La ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minadh-dhalimeen There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers. Surah Al-Anbiya 21:87 This is the dua of Prophet Yunus (AS) when he was in the belly of the whale. The Prophet (SAW) said that no Muslim supplicates with this dua but Allah answers it.
benefitsAr: هذا دعاء النبي يونس (ع) عندما كان في بطن الحوت. وقد أخبر النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أنه ما من مسلم يدعو بهذا الدعاء إلا استجاب الله له.

arabic: رَبَّنَا مَا خَلَقْتَ هَذَا بَاطِلًا سُبْحَانَكَ فَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
transliteration: Rabbana ma khalaqta hadha batilan subhanaka faqina 'adhaban-nar
translation: Our Lord, You did not create this [universe] in vain. Exalted are You! So protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
search: Protection from Hellfire Protection from Hellfire رَبَّنَا مَا خَلَقْتَ هَذَا بَاطِلًا سُبْحَانَكَ فَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ Rabbana ma khalaqta hadha batilan subhanaka faqina 'adhaban-nar Our Lord, You did not create this [universe] in vain. Exalted are You! So protect us from the punishment of the Fire. Surah Al-Imran 3:191

arabic: رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ مَن تُدْخِلِ النَّارَ فَقَدْ أَخْزَيْتَهُ وَمَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِنْ أَنصَارٍ
transliteration: Rabbana innaka man tudkhilin-nara faqad akhzaytahu wa maliz-zalimeena min ansar
translation: Our Lord, indeed whoever You admit to the Fire - You have disgraced him, and for the wrongdoers there are no helpers.
search: Protection from Hellfire Protection from Hellfire رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ مَن تُدْخِلِ النَّارَ فَقَدْ أَخْزَيْتَهُ وَمَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِنْ أَنصَارٍ Rabbana innaka man tudkhilin-nara faqad akhzaytahu wa maliz-zalimeena min ansar Our Lord, indeed whoever You admit to the Fire - You have disgraced him, and for the wrongdoers there are no helpers. Surah Al-Imran 3:192

arabic: رَبَّنَا اصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا إِنَّهَا سَآءَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَمُقَامًا
transliteration: Rabbanasrif 'anna 'adhaba jahannama inna 'adhabaha kana gharaman innaha sa'at mustaqarran wa maqaman
translation: Our Lord, avert from us the punishment of Hell. Indeed, its punishment is a lasting torment. Indeed, it is evil as a settlement and residence.
search: Protection from Hellfire Protection from Hellfire رَبَّنَا اصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا إِنَّهَا سَآءَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَمُقَامًا Rabbanasrif 'anna 'adhaba jahannama inna 'adhabaha kana gharaman innaha sa'at mustaqarran wa maqaman Our Lord, avert from us the punishment of Hell. Indeed, its punishment is a lasting torment. Indeed, it is evil as a settlement and residence. Surah Al-Furqan 25:65-66

arabic: رَبَّنَآ أَخۡرِجۡنَا مِنۡ هَـٰذِهِ ٱلۡقَرۡيَةِ ٱلظَّالِمِ أَهۡلُهَاۤ وَٱجۡعَل لَّنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّ۬ا وَٱجۡعَل لَّنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ نَصِيرًا
transliteration: Rabbana akhrijna min hadhihil-qaryatidh-zalimu ahluha waj'al lana min ladunka waliyyan waj'al lana min ladunka naseeran
translation: Our Lord, take us out of this city of oppressive people and appoint for us from Yourself a protector and appoint for us from Yourself a helper.
search: Protection from Oppressors & Wrongdoers Protection from Oppressors & Wrongdoers رَبَّنَآ أَخۡرِجۡنَا مِنۡ هَـٰذِهِ ٱلۡقَرۡيَةِ ٱلظَّالِمِ أَهۡلُهَاۤ وَٱجۡعَل لَّنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّ۬ا وَٱجۡعَل لَّنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ نَصِيرًا Rabbana akhrijna min hadhihil-qaryatidh-zalimu ahluha waj'al lana min ladunka waliyyan waj'al lana min ladunka naseeran Our Lord, take us out of this city of oppressive people and appoint for us from Yourself a protector and appoint for us from Yourself a helper. Surah An-Nisa 4:75

arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجۡعَلۡنَا مَعَ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
transliteration: Rabbana la taj'alna ma'al-qawmidh-zalimeen
translation: Our Lord, do not place us with the wrongdoing people.
search: Protection from Oppressors & Wrongdoers Protection from Oppressors & Wrongdoers رَبَّنَا لَا تَجۡعَلۡنَا مَعَ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ Rabbana la taj'alna ma'al-qawmidh-zalimeen Our Lord, do not place us with the wrongdoing people. Surah Al-A'raf 7:47

arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِّلْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ وَنَجِّنَا بِرَحْمَتِكَ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
transliteration: Rabbana la taj'alna fitnatan lil-qawmidh-zalimeen wa najjina birahmatika minal-qawmil-kafireen
translation: Our Lord, do not make us a trial for the wrongdoing people. And save us by Your mercy from the disbelieving people.
search: Protection from Oppressors & Wrongdoers Protection from Oppressors & Wrongdoers رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِّلْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ وَنَجِّنَا بِرَحْمَتِكَ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ Rabbana la taj'alna fitnatan lil-qawmidh-zalimeen wa najjina birahmatika minal-qawmil-kafireen Our Lord, do not make us a trial for the wrongdoing people. And save us by Your mercy from the disbelieving people. Surah Yunus 10:85-86

arabic: رَبِّ فَلَا تَجۡعَلۡنِى فِى ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
transliteration: Rabbi fala taj'alni fil-qawmidh-zalimeen
translation: My Lord, do not place me among the wrongdoing people.
search: Protection from Oppressors & Wrongdoers Protection from Oppressors & Wrongdoers رَبِّ فَلَا تَجۡعَلۡنِى فِى ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ Rabbi fala taj'alni fil-qawmidh-zalimeen My Lord, do not place me among the wrongdoing people. Surah Al-Mu'minun 23:94

arabic: رَبِّ نَجِّنِي مِنَ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
transliteration: Rabbi najjini minal-qawmidh-zalimeen
translation: My Lord, save me from the wrongdoing people.
search: Protection from Oppressors & Wrongdoers Protection from Oppressors & Wrongdoers رَبِّ نَجِّنِي مِنَ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ Rabbi najjini minal-qawmidh-zalimeen My Lord, save me from the wrongdoing people. Surah Al-Qasas 28:21

arabic: رَبِّ ٱبۡنِ لِى عِندَكَ بَيۡتٗا فِى ٱلۡجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
transliteration: Rabbibni lee 'indaka baytan fil-jannati wa najjini min fir'awna wa 'amalihi wa najjini minal-qawmidh-zalimeen
translation: My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people.
search: Protection from Oppressors & Wrongdoers Protection from Oppressors & Wrongdoers رَبِّ ٱبۡنِ لِى عِندَكَ بَيۡتٗا فِى ٱلۡجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ Rabbibni lee 'indaka baytan fil-jannati wa najjini min fir'awna wa 'amalihi wa najjini minal-qawmidh-zalimeen My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people. Surah At-Tahrim 66:11

arabic: اِنِّيْ عُذْتُ بِرَبِّيْ وَرَبِّكُمْ مِّنْ كُلِّ مُتَكَبِّرٍ لَّا يُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنُ بِيَوْمِ الْحِسَابِ
transliteration: Innee 'uztu bi Rabbee wa Rabbikum min kulli mutakabbiril laayu'minu bi Yawmil Hisaab
translation: Indeed, I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord from every arrogant one who does not believe in the Day of Account.
benefits: This dua was made by Prophet Musa (AS) when Pharaoh ultimately decided to kill him. It teaches us to seek Allah's protection when facing powerful, arrogant, and oppressive enemies. By putting complete trust in Allah, Musa (AS) was miraculously saved, and Allah parted the sea for him. Recite this dua when you feel threatened or overwhelmed by an unjust authority or an arrogant individual.
search: Protection from Oppressors & Wrongdoers Protection from Oppressors & Wrongdoers اِنِّيْ عُذْتُ بِرَبِّيْ وَرَبِّكُمْ مِّنْ كُلِّ مُتَكَبِّرٍ لَّا يُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنُ بِيَوْمِ الْحِسَابِ Innee 'uztu bi Rabbee wa Rabbikum min kulli mutakabbiril laayu'minu bi Yawmil Hisaab Indeed, I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord from every arrogant one who does not believe in the Day of Account. Surah Ghafir 40:27 This dua was made by Prophet Musa (AS) when Pharaoh ultimately decided to kill him. It teaches us to seek Allah's protection when facing powerful, arrogant, and oppressive enemies. By putting complete trust in Allah, Musa (AS) was miraculously saved, and Allah parted the sea for him. Recite this dua when you feel threatened or overwhelmed by an unjust authority or an arrogant individual.
benefitsAr: هذا الدعاء قاله النبي موسى (ع) عندما قرر فرعون قتله. إنه يعلمنا أن نطلب الحماية من الله عند مواجهة أعداء أقوياء ومتغطرسين وظالمين. بالتوكل على الله نجا موسى (ع) بأعجوبة، وشق الله له البحر. ردد هذا الدعاء عندما تشعر بالتهديد أو الإرهاق من قبل سلطة ظالمة أو شخص متكبر.

arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِنْ لَدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْوَهَّابُ
transliteration: Rabbana la tuzigh qulubana ba'da idh hadaytana wahab lana min ladunka rahmatan innaka antal-wahhab
translation: Our Lord, let not our hearts deviate after You have guided us and grant us from Yourself mercy. Indeed, You are the Bestower.
search: Seeking Guidance & Steadfastness Seeking Guidance & Steadfastness رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِنْ لَدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْوَهَّابُ Rabbana la tuzigh qulubana ba'da idh hadaytana wahab lana min ladunka rahmatan innaka antal-wahhab Our Lord, let not our hearts deviate after You have guided us and grant us from Yourself mercy. Indeed, You are the Bestower. Surah Al-Imran 3:8

arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا
transliteration: Rabbana atina min ladunka rahmatan wa hayyi' lana min amrina rashadan
translation: Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance.
search: Seeking Guidance & Steadfastness Seeking Guidance & Steadfastness رَبَّنَا آتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا Rabbana atina min ladunka rahmatan wa hayyi' lana min amrina rashadan Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance. Surah Al-Kahf 18:10

arabic: رَبَّنَآ إِنَّنَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِيًا يُنَادِي لِلْإِيمَانِ أَنْ آمِنُوا بِرَبِّكُمْ فَآمَنَّا
transliteration: Rabbana innana sami'na munadiyan yunadi lil-eemani an aminu birabbikum fa-amanna
translation: Our Lord, indeed we have heard a caller calling to faith, saying, 'Believe in your Lord,' and we have believed.
search: Seeking Guidance & Steadfastness Seeking Guidance & Steadfastness رَبَّنَآ إِنَّنَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِيًا يُنَادِي لِلْإِيمَانِ أَنْ آمِنُوا بِرَبِّكُمْ فَآمَنَّا Rabbana innana sami'na munadiyan yunadi lil-eemani an aminu birabbikum fa-amanna Our Lord, indeed we have heard a caller calling to faith, saying, 'Believe in your Lord,' and we have believed. Surah Al-Imran 3:193

arabic: رَّبِّ زِدۡنِي عِلۡمٗا
transliteration: Rabbi zidnee 'ilman
translation: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.
benefits: This is one of the most comprehensive duas for seeking knowledge. The Prophet (SAW) emphasized the importance of seeking knowledge throughout one's life.
search: Seeking Increase in Knowledge Seeking Increase in Knowledge رَّبِّ زِدۡنِي عِلۡمٗا Rabbi zidnee 'ilman My Lord, increase me in knowledge. Surah Ta-Ha 20:114 This is one of the most comprehensive duas for seeking knowledge. The Prophet (SAW) emphasized the importance of seeking knowledge throughout one's life.
benefitsAr: وهذا من أشمل أدعية طلب العلم. وقد أكد النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم على أهمية طلب العلم في حياة المرء.

arabic: رَبِّ ٱشۡرَحۡ لِى صَدۡرِى ٢٥ وَيَسِّرۡ لِيٓ أَمۡرِى ٢٦ وَٱحۡلُلۡ عُقۡدَةً۬ مِّن لِّسَانِي ٢٧ يَفۡقَهُواْ قَوۡلِىٓ ٢٨
transliteration: Rabbishrah lee sadree wa yassir lee amree wah lul 'uqdatan min lisani yafqahu qawlee
translation: My Lord, expand for me my breast [with assurance] and ease for me my task and untie the knot from my tongue that they may understand my speech.
benefits: This dua was made by Prophet Musa (AS) before going to Pharaoh. It is excellent for anyone facing difficult tasks or public speaking.
search: Seeking Ease in Affairs Seeking Ease in Affairs رَبِّ ٱشۡرَحۡ لِى صَدۡرِى ٢٥ وَيَسِّرۡ لِيٓ أَمۡرِى ٢٦ وَٱحۡلُلۡ عُقۡدَةً۬ مِّن لِّسَانِي ٢٧ يَفۡقَهُواْ قَوۡلِىٓ ٢٨ Rabbishrah lee sadree wa yassir lee amree wah lul 'uqdatan min lisani yafqahu qawlee My Lord, expand for me my breast [with assurance] and ease for me my task and untie the knot from my tongue that they may understand my speech. Surah Ta-Ha 20:25-28 This dua was made by Prophet Musa (AS) before going to Pharaoh. It is excellent for anyone facing difficult tasks or public speaking.
benefitsAr: هذا الدعاء دعاه موسى (ع) قبل الذهاب إلى فرعون. إنه ممتاز لأي شخص يواجه مهام صعبة أو التحدث أمام الجمهور.

arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَسْأَلَكَ مَا لَيْسَ لِي بِهِ عِلْمٌ وَإِلَّا تَغْفِرْ لِي وَتَرْحَمْنِي أَكُن مِّنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
transliteration: Rabbi inni a'udhu bika an as'alaka ma laysa lee bihi 'ilmun wa il lam taghfir lee wa tarhamni akun minal-khasireen
translation: My Lord, I seek refuge in You from asking that of which I have no knowledge. And unless You forgive me and have mercy upon me, I will be among the losers.
search: Seeking Ease in Affairs Seeking Ease in Affairs رَبِّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَسْأَلَكَ مَا لَيْسَ لِي بِهِ عِلْمٌ وَإِلَّا تَغْفِرْ لِي وَتَرْحَمْنِي أَكُن مِّنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ Rabbi inni a'udhu bika an as'alaka ma laysa lee bihi 'ilmun wa il lam taghfir lee wa tarhamni akun minal-khasireen My Lord, I seek refuge in You from asking that of which I have no knowledge. And unless You forgive me and have mercy upon me, I will be among the losers. Surah Hud 11:47

arabic: رَبِّ هَبۡ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ ذُرِّيَّةً۬ طَيِّبَةً‌ إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ
transliteration: Rabbi hab lee min ladunka dhurriyyatan tayyibatan innaka samee'ud-du'a
translation: My Lord, grant me from Yourself a good offspring. Indeed, You are the Hearer of supplication.
benefits: This dua was made by Prophet Zakariyya (AS) when he was old and his wife was barren, and Allah blessed him with Prophet Yahya (AS).
search: For Righteous Children For Righteous Children رَبِّ هَبۡ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ ذُرِّيَّةً۬ طَيِّبَةً‌ إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ Rabbi hab lee min ladunka dhurriyyatan tayyibatan innaka samee'ud-du'a My Lord, grant me from Yourself a good offspring. Indeed, You are the Hearer of supplication. Surah Al-Imran 3:38 This dua was made by Prophet Zakariyya (AS) when he was old and his wife was barren, and Allah blessed him with Prophet Yahya (AS).
benefitsAr: هذا الدعاء دعاه النبي زكريا (ع) عندما كبر وكانت زوجته عاقراً، ورزقه الله بالنبي يحيى (ع).

arabic: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
transliteration: Rabbana hab lana min azwajina wa dhurriyyatina qurrata a'yunin waj'alna lil-muttaqeena imaman
translation: Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us an example for the righteous.
search: For Righteous Children For Righteous Children رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا Rabbana hab lana min azwajina wa dhurriyyatina qurrata a'yunin waj'alna lil-muttaqeena imaman Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us an example for the righteous. Surah Al-Furqan 25:74

arabic: رَبِّ هَبۡ لِى مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
transliteration: Rabbi hab lee minas-saliheen
translation: My Lord, grant me [a child] from among the righteous.
benefits: This is the dua of Prophet Ibrahim (AS) when he prayed for a righteous child, and Allah blessed him with Prophet Ismail (AS).
search: For Righteous Children For Righteous Children رَبِّ هَبۡ لِى مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ Rabbi hab lee minas-saliheen My Lord, grant me [a child] from among the righteous. Surah Al-Saffat 37:100 This is the dua of Prophet Ibrahim (AS) when he prayed for a righteous child, and Allah blessed him with Prophet Ismail (AS).
benefitsAr: هذا دعاء النبي إبراهيم (ع) عندما دعا للولد الصالح ورزقه الله بالنبي إسماعيل (ع).

arabic: رََّبِّ ٱرۡحَمۡهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِى صَغِيرًا
transliteration: Rabbirhamhuma kama rabbayani sagheeran
translation: My Lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up [when I was] small.
benefits: This is part of the Quranic instruction to be kind to parents. It should be recited for parents whether they are alive or deceased.
search: For Parents For Parents رََّبِّ ٱرۡحَمۡهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِى صَغِيرًا Rabbirhamhuma kama rabbayani sagheeran My Lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up [when I was] small. Surah Al-Isra 17:24 This is part of the Quranic instruction to be kind to parents. It should be recited for parents whether they are alive or deceased.
benefitsAr: وهذا جزء من التعليمات القرآنية ببر الوالدين. وينبغي أن يقرأ على الوالدين سواء كانوا أحياء أو أمواتا.

arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ
transliteration: Rabbanaghfir lee wa liwalidayya wal-mu'mineena yawma yaqumul-hisab
translation: Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers the Day the account is established.
search: For Parents For Parents رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ Rabbanaghfir lee wa liwalidayya wal-mu'mineena yawma yaqumul-hisab Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers the Day the account is established. Surah Ibrahim 14:41

arabic: رَّبِّ ٱغۡفِرۡ لِي وَلِوَٰلِدَيَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيۡتِيَ مُؤۡمِنً۬ا وَلِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَـٰتِ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَـٰرًا
transliteration: Rabbighfir lee wa liwalidayya wa li-man dakhala baytiya mu'minan wal-mu'mineena wal-mu'minati wa la tazididh-zalimeena illa tabaran
translation: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women. And do not increase the wrongdoers except in destruction.
search: For Parents For Parents رَّبِّ ٱغۡفِرۡ لِي وَلِوَٰلِدَيَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيۡتِيَ مُؤۡمِنً۬ا وَلِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَـٰتِ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَـٰرًا Rabbighfir lee wa liwalidayya wa li-man dakhala baytiya mu'minan wal-mu'mineena wal-mu'minati wa la tazididh-zalimeena illa tabaran My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women. And do not increase the wrongdoers except in destruction. Surah Nuh 71:28

arabic: رَبَّنَا وَاجْعَلْنَا مُسْلِمَيْنِ لَكَ وَمِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِنَا أُمَّةً مُسْلِمَةً لَكَ وَأَرِنَا مَنَاسِكَنَا وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَا إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
transliteration: Rabbana waj'alna muslimayni laka wa min dhurriyyatina ummatan muslimatan laka wa arina manasikana wa tub 'alayna innaka antat-tawwabur-raheem
translation: Our Lord, and make us Muslims [in submission] to You and from our descendants a Muslim nation [in submission] to You. And show us our rites and accept our repentance. Indeed, You are the Accepting of repentance, the Merciful.
search: For Family's Faith & Righteousness For Family's Faith & Righteousness رَبَّنَا وَاجْعَلْنَا مُسْلِمَيْنِ لَكَ وَمِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِنَا أُمَّةً مُسْلِمَةً لَكَ وَأَرِنَا مَنَاسِكَنَا وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَا إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ Rabbana waj'alna muslimayni laka wa min dhurriyyatina ummatan muslimatan laka wa arina manasikana wa tub 'alayna innaka antat-tawwabur-raheem Our Lord, and make us Muslims [in submission] to You and from our descendants a Muslim nation [in submission] to You. And show us our rites and accept our repentance. Indeed, You are the Accepting of repentance, the Merciful. Surah Al-Baqarah 2:128

arabic: رَبِّ ٱجۡعَلۡ هَـٰذَا ٱلۡبَلَدَ ءَامِنً۬ا وَٱجۡنُبۡنِى وَبَنِىَّ أَن نَّعۡبُدَ ٱلۡأَصۡنَامَ
transliteration: Rabbij'al hadhal-balada aminan wajnubnee wa banayya an na'budal-asnam
translation: My Lord, make this city [Makkah] secure, and keep me and my children away from worshipping idols.
search: For Family's Faith & Righteousness For Family's Faith & Righteousness رَبِّ ٱجۡعَلۡ هَـٰذَا ٱلۡبَلَدَ ءَامِنً۬ا وَٱجۡنُبۡنِى وَبَنِىَّ أَن نَّعۡبُدَ ٱلۡأَصۡنَامَ Rabbij'al hadhal-balada aminan wajnubnee wa banayya an na'budal-asnam My Lord, make this city [Makkah] secure, and keep me and my children away from worshipping idols. Surah Ibrahim 14:35

arabic: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِي رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ
transliteration: Rabbij'alni muqeemas-salati wa min dhurriyyati rabbana wa taqabbal du'a
translation: My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and [many] from my descendants. Our Lord, and accept my supplication.
search: For Family's Faith & Righteousness For Family's Faith & Righteousness رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِي رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ Rabbij'alni muqeemas-salati wa min dhurriyyati rabbana wa taqabbal du'a My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and [many] from my descendants. Our Lord, and accept my supplication. Surah Ibrahim 14:40

arabic: رَبِّ أَوۡزِعۡنِيٓ أَنۡ أَشۡكُرَ نِعۡمَتَكَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنۡعَمۡتَ عَلَىَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَٲلِدَىَّ وَأَنۡ أَعۡمَلَ صَـٰلِحً۬ا تَرۡضَٮٰهُ وَأَصۡلِحۡ لِى فِى ذُرِّيَّتِىٓ إِنِّى تُبۡتُ إِلَيۡكَ وَإِنِّى مِنَ ٱلۡمُسۡلِمِينَ
transliteration: Rabbi awzi'nee an ashkura ni'mataka allatee an'amta 'alayya wa 'ala walidayya wa an a'mala salihan tardahu wa aslih lee fi dhurriyyati inni tubtu ilayka wa inni minal-muslimeen
translation: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to work righteousness of which You will approve and make righteous for me my offspring. Indeed, I have repented to You, and indeed, I am of the Muslims.
search: For Family's Faith & Righteousness For Family's Faith & Righteousness رَبِّ أَوۡزِعۡنِيٓ أَنۡ أَشۡكُرَ نِعۡمَتَكَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنۡعَمۡتَ عَلَىَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَٲلِدَىَّ وَأَنۡ أَعۡمَلَ صَـٰلِحً۬ا تَرۡضَٮٰهُ وَأَصۡلِحۡ لِى فِى ذُرِّيَّتِىٓ إِنِّى تُبۡتُ إِلَيۡكَ وَإِنِّى مِنَ ٱلۡمُسۡلِمِينَ Rabbi awzi'nee an ashkura ni'mataka allatee an'amta 'alayya wa 'ala walidayya wa an a'mala salihan tardahu wa aslih lee fi dhurriyyati inni tubtu ilayka wa inni minal-muslimeen My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to work righteousness of which You will approve and make righteous for me my offspring. Indeed, I have repented to You, and indeed, I am of the Muslims. Surah Al-Ahqaf 46:15

arabic: رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَانْصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
transliteration: Rabbana afrigh 'alayna sabran wa thabbit aqdamana wansurna 'alal-qawmil-kafireen
translation: Our Lord, pour upon us patience and plant firmly our feet and give us victory over the disbelieving people.
search: Seeking Patience & Steadfastness Seeking Patience & Steadfastness رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَانْصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ Rabbana afrigh 'alayna sabran wa thabbit aqdamana wansurna 'alal-qawmil-kafireen Our Lord, pour upon us patience and plant firmly our feet and give us victory over the disbelieving people. Surah Al-Baqarah 2:250

arabic: رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَتَوَفَّنَا مُسْلِمِينَ
transliteration: Rabbana afrigh 'alayna sabran wa tawaffana muslimin
translation: Our Lord, pour upon us patience and let us die as Muslims [in submission to You].
search: Seeking Patience & Steadfastness Seeking Patience & Steadfastness رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَتَوَفَّنَا مُسْلِمِينَ Rabbana afrigh 'alayna sabran wa tawaffana muslimin Our Lord, pour upon us patience and let us die as Muslims [in submission to You]. Surah Al-A'raf 7:126

arabic: رَبَّنَآ إِنَّنَا نَخَافُ أَن يَفْرُطَ عَلَيْنَآ أَوْ أَن يَطْغَى
transliteration: Rabbana innana nakhafu an yafruta 'alayna aw an yatgha
translation: Our Lord, indeed we fear that he will hasten [punishment] against us or that he will transgress.
search: Seeking Patience & Steadfastness Seeking Patience & Steadfastness رَبَّنَآ إِنَّنَا نَخَافُ أَن يَفْرُطَ عَلَيْنَآ أَوْ أَن يَطْغَى Rabbana innana nakhafu an yafruta 'alayna aw an yatgha Our Lord, indeed we fear that he will hasten [punishment] against us or that he will transgress. Surah Ta-Ha 20:45

arabic: رَبَّنَا ٱفۡتَحۡ بَيۡنَنَا وَبَيۡنَ قَوۡمِنَا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَأَنتَ خَيۡرُ ٱلۡفَٰتِحِينَ
transliteration: Rabbanaftah baynana wa bayna qawmina bil-haqqi wa anta khayrul-fatiheen
translation: Our Lord, decide between us and our people in truth, and You are the best of those who give decision.
search: Seeking Victory & Justice Seeking Victory & Justice رَبَّنَا ٱفۡتَحۡ بَيۡنَنَا وَبَيۡنَ قَوۡمِنَا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَأَنتَ خَيۡرُ ٱلۡفَٰتِحِينَ Rabbanaftah baynana wa bayna qawmina bil-haqqi wa anta khayrul-fatiheen Our Lord, decide between us and our people in truth, and You are the best of those who give decision. Surah Al-A'raf 7:89

arabic: رَبِّ ٱنصُرۡنِي عَلَى ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلۡمُفۡسِدِينَ
transliteration: Rabbinsurni 'alal-qawmil-mufsideen
translation: My Lord, support me against the corrupting people.
search: Seeking Victory & Justice Seeking Victory & Justice رَبِّ ٱنصُرۡنِي عَلَى ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلۡمُفۡسِدِينَ Rabbinsurni 'alal-qawmil-mufsideen My Lord, support me against the corrupting people. Surah Al-Ankabut 29:30

arabic: سَمِعۡنَا وَأَطَعۡنَاۤ‌ غُفۡرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيۡكَ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ
transliteration: Sami'na wa ata'na, ghufranaka rabbana wa ilaykal-maseer
translation: We hear and we obey. [We seek] Your forgiveness, our Lord, and to You is the [final] destination.
search: Declaration of Faith & Obedience Declaration of Faith & Obedience سَمِعۡنَا وَأَطَعۡنَاۤ‌ غُفۡرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيۡكَ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ Sami'na wa ata'na, ghufranaka rabbana wa ilaykal-maseer We hear and we obey. [We seek] Your forgiveness, our Lord, and to You is the [final] destination. Surah Al-Baqarah 2:285

arabic: رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ جَامِعُ النَّاسِ لِيَوْمٍ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ
transliteration: Rabbana innaka jami'un-nasi liyawmin la rayba fih innallaha la yukhliful-mee'ad
translation: Our Lord, surely You will gather the people for a Day about which there is no doubt. Indeed, Allah does not fail in His promise.
search: Declaration of Faith & Obedience Declaration of Faith & Obedience رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ جَامِعُ النَّاسِ لِيَوْمٍ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ Rabbana innaka jami'un-nasi liyawmin la rayba fih innallaha la yukhliful-mee'ad Our Lord, surely You will gather the people for a Day about which there is no doubt. Indeed, Allah does not fail in His promise. Surah Al-Imran 3:9

arabic: رَبَّنَا آمَنَّا بِمَا أَنْزَلْتَ وَاتَّبَعْنَا الرَّسُولَ فَاكْتُبْنَا مَعَ الشَّاهِدِينَ
transliteration: Rabbana amanna bima anzalta wataba'nar-rasula faktubna ma'ash-shahideen
translation: Our Lord, we have believed in what You revealed and have followed the messenger, so register us among the witnesses [to truth].
search: Declaration of Faith & Obedience Declaration of Faith & Obedience رَبَّنَا آمَنَّا بِمَا أَنْزَلْتَ وَاتَّبَعْنَا الرَّسُولَ فَاكْتُبْنَا مَعَ الشَّاهِدِينَ Rabbana amanna bima anzalta wataba'nar-rasula faktubna ma'ash-shahideen Our Lord, we have believed in what You revealed and have followed the messenger, so register us among the witnesses [to truth]. Surah Al-Imran 3:53

arabic: رَبَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَٱكْتُبْنَا مَعَ ٱلشَّٰهِدِينَ
transliteration: Rabbana amanna faktubna mash-shahideen
translation: Our Lord, we have believed, so register us among the witnesses.
search: Declaration of Faith & Obedience Declaration of Faith & Obedience رَبَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَٱكْتُبْنَا مَعَ ٱلشَّٰهِدِينَ Rabbana amanna faktubna mash-shahideen Our Lord, we have believed, so register us among the witnesses. Surah Al-Maidah 5:83

arabic: رَبُّنَا رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ لَن نَّدۡعُوَاْ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ إِلَـٰهً۬ا‌ لَّقَدۡ قُلۡنَآ إِذً۬ا شَطَطً۬آ
transliteration: Rabbuna rabbus-samawati wal-ardi lan nad'uwa min dunihi ilahan laqad qulna idhan shatatan
translation: Our Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth. Never will we invoke besides Him any deity. We would have certainly spoken, then an excessive transgression.
search: Declaration of Faith & Obedience Declaration of Faith & Obedience رَبُّنَا رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ لَن نَّدۡعُوَاْ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ إِلَـٰهً۬ا‌ لَّقَدۡ قُلۡنَآ إِذً۬ا شَطَطً۬آ Rabbuna rabbus-samawati wal-ardi lan nad'uwa min dunihi ilahan laqad qulna idhan shatatan Our Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth. Never will we invoke besides Him any deity. We would have certainly spoken, then an excessive transgression. Surah Al-Kahf 18:14

arabic: رَّبَّنَا عَلَيۡكَ تَوَكَّلۡنَا وَإِلَيۡكَ أَنَبۡنَا وَإِلَيۡكَ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ
transliteration: Rabbana 'alayka tawakkalna wa ilayka anabna wa ilaykal-maseer
translation: Our Lord, upon You we have relied, and to You we have returned, and to You is the destination.
search: Declaration of Faith & Obedience Declaration of Faith & Obedience رَّبَّنَا عَلَيۡكَ تَوَكَّلۡنَا وَإِلَيۡكَ أَنَبۡنَا وَإِلَيۡكَ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ Rabbana 'alayka tawakkalna wa ilayka anabna wa ilaykal-maseer Our Lord, upon You we have relied, and to You we have returned, and to You is the destination. Surah Al-Mumtahanah 60:4

arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
transliteration: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan wafil-akhirati hasanatan wa qina 'adhaban-nar
translation: Our Lord, give us in this world [that which is] good and in the Hereafter [that which is] good and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
benefits: This is one of the most comprehensive duas that encompasses all good in this life and the next. The Prophet (SAW) used to recite this dua frequently.
search: Goodness in Both Worlds Goodness in Both Worlds رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan wafil-akhirati hasanatan wa qina 'adhaban-nar Our Lord, give us in this world [that which is] good and in the Hereafter [that which is] good and protect us from the punishment of the Fire. Surah Al-Baqarah 2:201 This is one of the most comprehensive duas that encompasses all good in this life and the next. The Prophet (SAW) used to recite this dua frequently.
categoryAr: الدعاء بين الركن اليماني والحجر الأسود
benefitsAr: وهذا من أجمع الأدعية الجامعة لكل خير في الدنيا والآخرة. وكان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يكثر من قراءة هذا الدعاء.

arabic: رَبَّنَا وَءَاتِنَا مَا وَعَدتَّنَا عَلَى رُسُلِكَ وَلَا تُخْزِنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ
transliteration: Rabbana wa atina ma wa'adtana 'ala rusulika wa la tukhzina yawmal-qiyamati innaka la tukhliful-mee'ad
translation: Our Lord, grant us what You promised us through Your messengers and do not disgrace us on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed, You do not fail in [Your] promise.
search: Goodness in Both Worlds Goodness in Both Worlds رَبَّنَا وَءَاتِنَا مَا وَعَدتَّنَا عَلَى رُسُلِكَ وَلَا تُخْزِنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ Rabbana wa atina ma wa'adtana 'ala rusulika wa la tukhzina yawmal-qiyamati innaka la tukhliful-mee'ad Our Lord, grant us what You promised us through Your messengers and do not disgrace us on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed, You do not fail in [Your] promise. Surah Al-Imran 3:194

arabic: رَبَّنَآ أَتۡمِمۡ لَنَا نُورَنَا وَٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَآ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٞ
transliteration: Rabbana atimm lana nuranana waghfir lana innaka 'ala kulli shay'in qadeerun
translation: Our Lord, perfect for us our light and forgive us. Indeed, You are over all things competent.
search: Goodness in Both Worlds Goodness in Both Worlds رَبَّنَآ أَتۡمِمۡ لَنَا نُورَنَا وَٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَآ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٞ Rabbana atimm lana nuranana waghfir lana innaka 'ala kulli shay'in qadeerun Our Lord, perfect for us our light and forgive us. Indeed, You are over all things competent. Surah At-Tahrim 66:8

arabic: رَبَّنَا وَأَدۡخِلۡهُمۡ جَنَّـٰتِ عَدۡنٍ ٱلَّتِي وَعَدتَّهُمۡ وَمَن صَلَحَ مِنۡ ءَابَآئِهِمۡ وَأَزۡوَٰجِهِمۡ وَذُرِّيَّـٰتِهِمۡۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ وَقِهِمُ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ
transliteration: Rabbana wa adkhilhum jannatin 'adin allatee wa'adtahum wa man salaha min aba'ihim wa azwajihim wa dhurriyyatihim innaka antal-azeezul-hakeem wa qihimus-sayyi'ati
translation: Our Lord, and admit them to gardens of perpetual residence which You have promised them and whoever was righteous among their fathers, their spouses and their offspring. Indeed, it is You who is the Exalted in Might, the Wise. And protect them from the evil consequences [of their deeds].
search: Goodness in Both Worlds Goodness in Both Worlds رَبَّنَا وَأَدۡخِلۡهُمۡ جَنَّـٰتِ عَدۡنٍ ٱلَّتِي وَعَدتَّهُمۡ وَمَن صَلَحَ مِنۡ ءَابَآئِهِمۡ وَأَزۡوَٰجِهِمۡ وَذُرِّيَّـٰتِهِمۡۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ وَقِهِمُ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ Rabbana wa adkhilhum jannatin 'adin allatee wa'adtahum wa man salaha min aba'ihim wa azwajihim wa dhurriyyatihim innaka antal-azeezul-hakeem wa qihimus-sayyi'ati Our Lord, and admit them to gardens of perpetual residence which You have promised them and whoever was righteous among their fathers, their spouses and their offspring. Indeed, it is You who is the Exalted in Might, the Wise. And protect them from the evil consequences [of their deeds]. Surah Ghafir 40:8-9

arabic: أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ ٱلضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرۡحَمُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
transliteration: Annani massaniyad-durru wa anta arhamur-rahimeen
translation: Indeed, adversity has touched me, and You are the Most Merciful of the merciful.
benefits: This is the dua of Prophet Ayyub (AS) during his illness. It teaches us to turn to Allah in times of hardship.
search: Gratitude & Mercy Gratitude & Mercy أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ ٱلضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرۡحَمُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ Annani massaniyad-durru wa anta arhamur-rahimeen Indeed, adversity has touched me, and You are the Most Merciful of the merciful. Surah Al-Anbiya 21:83 This is the dua of Prophet Ayyub (AS) during his illness. It teaches us to turn to Allah in times of hardship.
benefitsAr: هذا دعاء النبي أيوب (ع) في مرضه. يعلمنا اللجوء إلى الله في أوقات الشدة.

arabic: رَبِّ أَوۡزِعۡنِيٓ أَنۡ أَشۡكُرَ نِعۡمَتَكَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنۡعَمۡتَ عَلَىَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَٲلِدَىَّ وَأَنۡ أَعۡمَلَ صَـٰلِحً۬ا تَرۡضَٮٰهُ وَأَدۡخِلۡنِى بِرَحۡمَتِكَ فِى عِبَادِكَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
transliteration: Rabbi awzi'nee an ashkura ni'mataka allatee an'amta 'alayya wa 'ala walidayya wa an a'mala salihan tardahu wa adkhilni birahmatika fi 'ibadikas-saliheen
translation: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to work righteousness of which You will approve and make righteous for me my offspring. Indeed, I have repented to You, and indeed, I am of the Muslims.
benefits: This is the dua of Prophet Sulaiman (AS) showing gratitude for the blessings bestowed upon him.
search: Gratitude & Mercy Gratitude & Mercy رَبِّ أَوۡزِعۡنِيٓ أَنۡ أَشۡكُرَ نِعۡمَتَكَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنۡعَمۡتَ عَلَىَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَٲلِدَىَّ وَأَنۡ أَعۡمَلَ صَـٰلِحً۬ا تَرۡضَٮٰهُ وَأَدۡخِلۡنِى بِرَحۡمَتِكَ فِى عِبَادِكَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ Rabbi awzi'nee an ashkura ni'mataka allatee an'amta 'alayya wa 'ala walidayya wa an a'mala salihan tardahu wa adkhilni birahmatika fi 'ibadikas-saliheen My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to work righteousness of which You will approve and make righteous for me my offspring. Indeed, I have repented to You, and indeed, I am of the Muslims. Surah Al-Naml 27:19 This is the dua of Prophet Sulaiman (AS) showing gratitude for the blessings bestowed upon him.
benefitsAr: وهذا دعاء النبي سليمان (ع) في شكر النعم التي أنعم بها عليه.

arabic: رَبَّنَا لَغَفُورٌ شَكُورٌ
transliteration: Rabbana laghfoorun shakoorun
translation: Our Lord is Forgiving and Appreciative.
search: Gratitude & Mercy Gratitude & Mercy رَبَّنَا لَغَفُورٌ شَكُورٌ Rabbana laghfoorun shakoorun Our Lord is Forgiving and Appreciative. Surah Fatir 35:34

arabic: رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ رَءُوفٞ رَّحِيمٌ
transliteration: Rabbana innaka ra'oofun raheemun
translation: Our Lord, indeed You are Kind and Merciful.
search: Gratitude & Mercy Gratitude & Mercy رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ رَءُوفٞ رَّحِيمٌ Rabbana innaka ra'oofun raheemun Our Lord, indeed You are Kind and Merciful. Surah Al-Hashr 59:10

arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
transliteration: Rabbana la taj'alna fitnatan lilladhina kafaru waghfir lana rabbana innaka antal-azeezul-hakeem
translation: Our Lord, do not make us a trial for those who have disbelieved. And forgive us, our Lord. Indeed, You are the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
search: Seeking Protection from Trials Seeking Protection from Trials رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ Rabbana la taj'alna fitnatan lilladhina kafaru waghfir lana rabbana innaka antal-azeezul-hakeem Our Lord, do not make us a trial for those who have disbelieved. And forgive us, our Lord. Indeed, You are the Exalted in Might, the Wise. Surah Al-Mumtahanah 60:5

arabic: رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
transliteration: Rabbana taqabbal minna innaka antas-samee'ul-'aleem
translation: Our Lord, accept [this] from us. Indeed, You are the Hearing, the Knowing.
benefits: This dua was made by Prophet Ibrahim (AS) and Prophet Ismail (AS) after laying the foundation of the Kaaba.
search: Miscellaneous Quranic Duas Miscellaneous Quranic Duas رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ Rabbana taqabbal minna innaka antas-samee'ul-'aleem Our Lord, accept [this] from us. Indeed, You are the Hearing, the Knowing. Surah Al-Baqarah 2:127 This dua was made by Prophet Ibrahim (AS) and Prophet Ismail (AS) after laying the foundation of the Kaaba.
benefitsAr: هذا الدعاء دعاه النبي إبراهيم (ع) والنبي إسماعيل (ع) بعد وضع أساس الكعبة.

arabic: فَاطِرَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَنتَ وَلِىِّۦ فِى ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَٱلۡأَخِرَةِ‌ تَوَفَّنِى مُسۡلِمً۬ا وَأَلۡحِقۡنِى بِٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
transliteration: Fatiras-samawati wal-ardi anta waliyyee fid-dunya wal-akhirati tawaffani musliman wa alhiqnee bis-saliheen
translation: ˹O˺ Originator of the heavens and the earth! You are my Guardian in this world and the Hereafter. Allow me to die as one who submits and join me with the righteous.
benefits: This is the dua of Prophet Yusuf (AS) at the end of his life, expressing complete submission to Allah.
search: Miscellaneous Quranic Duas Miscellaneous Quranic Duas فَاطِرَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَنتَ وَلِىِّۦ فِى ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَٱلۡأَخِرَةِ‌ تَوَفَّنِى مُسۡلِمً۬ا وَأَلۡحِقۡنِى بِٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ Fatiras-samawati wal-ardi anta waliyyee fid-dunya wal-akhirati tawaffani musliman wa alhiqnee bis-saliheen ˹O˺ Originator of the heavens and the earth! You are my Guardian in this world and the Hereafter. Allow me to die as one who submits and join me with the righteous. Surah Yusuf 12:101 This is the dua of Prophet Yusuf (AS) at the end of his life, expressing complete submission to Allah.
benefitsAr: هذا هو دعاء النبي يوسف (ع) في آخر حياته معبراً عن التسليم الكامل لله.

arabic: رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ تَعْلَمُ مَا نُخْفِي وَمَا نُعْلِنُ وَمَا يَخْفَى عَلَى ٱللَّهِ مِن شَىْءٍۢ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ
transliteration: Rabbana innaka ta'lamu ma nukhfi wa ma nu'linu wa ma yakhfa 'alallahi min shay'in fil-ardi wa la fis-sama'
translation: Our Lord, You know what we conceal and what we declare, and nothing is hidden from Allah on the earth or in the heaven.
search: Miscellaneous Quranic Duas Miscellaneous Quranic Duas رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ تَعْلَمُ مَا نُخْفِي وَمَا نُعْلِنُ وَمَا يَخْفَى عَلَى ٱللَّهِ مِن شَىْءٍۢ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ Rabbana innaka ta'lamu ma nukhfi wa ma nu'linu wa ma yakhfa 'alallahi min shay'in fil-ardi wa la fis-sama' Our Lord, You know what we conceal and what we declare, and nothing is hidden from Allah on the earth or in the heaven. Surah Ibrahim 14:38

arabic: رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِي فَرْدًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلۡوَٲرِثِينَ
transliteration: Rabbi la tadharni fardan wa anta khayrul-waritheen
translation: My Lord, do not leave me alone [with no heir], while You are the best of inheritors.
benefits: This dua was made by Prophet Zakariyya (AS) when he feared dying without a successor.
search: Miscellaneous Quranic Duas Miscellaneous Quranic Duas رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِي فَرْدًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلۡوَٲرِثِينَ Rabbi la tadharni fardan wa anta khayrul-waritheen My Lord, do not leave me alone [with no heir], while You are the best of inheritors. Surah Al-Anbiya 21:89 This dua was made by Prophet Zakariyya (AS) when he feared dying without a successor.
benefitsAr: هذا الدعاء دعاه النبي زكريا (ع) عندما كان يخشى الموت بلا خليفة.

arabic: رَّبِّ أَنزِلۡنِي مُنزَلً۬ا مُّبَارَكً۬ا وَأَنتَ خَيۡرُ ٱلۡمُنزِلِينَ
transliteration: Rabbi anzilni munzalan mubarakan wa anta khayrul-munzileen
translation: My Lord, cause me to land at a blessed landing place, and You are the best to accommodate [us].
search: Miscellaneous Quranic Duas Miscellaneous Quranic Duas رَّبِّ أَنزِلۡنِي مُنزَلً۬ا مُّبَارَكً۬ا وَأَنتَ خَيۡرُ ٱلۡمُنزِلِينَ Rabbi anzilni munzalan mubarakan wa anta khayrul-munzileen My Lord, cause me to land at a blessed landing place, and You are the best to accommodate [us]. Surah Al-Mu'minun 23:29

arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّى لِمَآ أَنزَلۡتَ إِلَىَّ مِنۡ خَيۡرٖ فَقِيرٌ
transliteration: Rabbi inni lima anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqeerun
translation: My Lord, indeed I am, for whatever good You would send down to me, in need.
benefits: This is the dua of Prophet Musa (AS) when he was in need after leaving Egypt.
search: Miscellaneous Quranic Duas Miscellaneous Quranic Duas رَبِّ إِنِّى لِمَآ أَنزَلۡتَ إِلَىَّ مِنۡ خَيۡرٖ فَقِيرٌ Rabbi inni lima anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqeerun My Lord, indeed I am, for whatever good You would send down to me, in need. Surah Al-Qasas 28:24 This is the dua of Prophet Musa (AS) when he was in need after leaving Egypt.
benefitsAr: هذا دعاء النبي موسى (ع) عندما كان في حاجة بعد خروجه من مصر.

arabic: رَبَّنَآ أَنزِلْ عَلَيْنَا مَآئِدَةً مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ تَكُونُ لَنَا عِيدًا لِّأَوَّلِنَا وَءَاخِرِنَا وَءَايَةً مِّنكَ ۖ وَٱرْزُقْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيۡرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ
transliteration: Rabbana anzil 'alayna ma'idatan minas-sama'i takunu lana 'idan li-awwalina wa akhirina wa ayatan minka warzuqna wa anta khayrur-zaqeen
translation: Our Lord, send down upon us a table [spread with food] from the heaven to be for us a festival for the first of us and the last of us and a sign from You. And provide for us, and You are the best of providers.
benefits: This is the dua of the disciples of Prophet Isa (AS) requesting a table from heaven.
search: Miscellaneous Quranic Duas Miscellaneous Quranic Duas رَبَّنَآ أَنزِلْ عَلَيْنَا مَآئِدَةً مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ تَكُونُ لَنَا عِيدًا لِّأَوَّلِنَا وَءَاخِرِنَا وَءَايَةً مِّنكَ ۖ وَٱرْزُقْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيۡرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ Rabbana anzil 'alayna ma'idatan minas-sama'i takunu lana 'idan li-awwalina wa akhirina wa ayatan minka warzuqna wa anta khayrur-zaqeen Our Lord, send down upon us a table [spread with food] from the heaven to be for us a festival for the first of us and the last of us and a sign from You. And provide for us, and You are the best of providers. Surah Al-Maidah 5:114 This is the dua of the disciples of Prophet Isa (AS) requesting a table from heaven.
benefitsAr: هذا دعاء أصحاب النبي عيسى (ع) في طلب المائدة من السماء.
